descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni su UBP Asset Management UBP Asset Management è un manager di investimento internazionale con competenze nelle classi di asset tradizionali e alternative. Il team Iberia & LATAM sviluppa relazioni a lungo termine con investitori istituzionali, banche private, gestori patrimoniali e uffici familiari in tutta la regione. Unire UBP offre l'opportunità di lavorare in un ambiente imprenditoriale e internazionale, mentre la costruzione di una carriera a lungo termine nella distribuzione di asset management. Informazioni sul ruolo Siamo alla ricerca di un professionista di vendite Junior motivato e ambizioso per aderire al team Iberia & LATAM Distribution di Madrid. Questa è un'ottima opportunità per un professionista di prima assistenza (3-8 anni di esperienza) che è appassionato di mercati finanziari e asset management e vuole sviluppare una carriera nelle vendite istituzionali e all'ingrosso. Il candidato di successo sosterrà il team di vendita nello sviluppo di relazioni con investitori istituzionali, banche private, gestori di ricchezza, distributori e uffici di famiglia in Iberia e America Latina. Il ruolo offre un'esposizione significativa alle interazioni dei clienti, ai prodotti di investimento e alla collaborazione internazionale nell'ambito dell'attività di gestione patrimoniale di UBP. Principali responsabilità Sviluppo aziendale e assistenza commerciale
• Sostenere il team di vendita nello sviluppo e nel mantenimento delle relazioni con clienti istituzionali, banche private, gestori patrimoniali, uffici familiari e altri partner di distribuzione in Iberia e LATAM.
• Assistere nell'individuazione di nuove opportunità di business e contribuire a iniziative di acquisizione clienti.
• Preparare presentazioni dei clienti, materiali di marketing, agenda delle riunioni e documentazione di follow-up.
• Coordinate riunioni dei clienti, roadshow e eventi del settore.
• Mantenere i record CRM e le pipeline di vendita, assicurando la segnalazione accurata dell'attività del cliente.
• Risposte di supporto a RFI, RFP e questionari di due diligence. Gestione delle relazioni con i clienti
• Costruire relazioni forti con i clienti esistenti e potenziali.
• Fornire un alto standard di servizio client.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con specialisti di investimento, specialisti del prodotto, marketing, operazioni e servizi client.
• Partecipare alle riunioni dei clienti insieme ai colleghi di vendita senior e progressivamente prendere possesso di relazioni selezionate. Intelligenza del mercato
• Monitorare le tendenze del mercato, l'attività dei concorrenti e gli sviluppi del settore.
• Assistere nell'individuazione delle opportunità di vendita e dei nuovi segmenti di mercato.
• Contribuisci idee per migliorare le iniziative di vendita e il coinvolgimento dei clienti. Esperienza e requisiti Esperienza essenziale
• 3-8 anni di esperienza in Asset Management, Private Banking, Wealth Management o Financial Services.
• L'esperienza precedente nel supporto vendite, lo sviluppo aziendale, la gestione del rapporto cliente o la distribuzione è preferita.
• Forte interesse nei mercati degli investimenti e nella gestione degli asset.
• Buona comprensione dei prodotti di investimento, compresi i fondi comuni, il reddito fisso, le azioni e le soluzioni multi-asset.
• Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali.
• Forte capacità analitiche, organizzative e Microsoft Office. Istruzione
• Laurea magistrale in Finanza, Economia, Business Administration o disciplina relativa.
• Il progresso CFA o CAIA è un vantaggio. Lingue
• Spagnolo fluido e inglese professionale.
• Il portoghese è un forte vantaggio. Attributi personali
• Mindset commerciale con un autentico interesse per lo sviluppo aziendale.
• L'atteggiamento positivo e la volontà di imparare.
• Automotivata e proattiva.
• Forte giocatore di squadra.
• Curioso sui mercati finanziari.
• Presenza professionale e elevati standard etici.
descriptionByLocale.en:
About UBP Asset Management
UBP Asset Management is an international investment manager with expertise across traditional and alternative asset classes. The Iberia & LATAM team develops long-term relationships with institutional investors, private banks, wealth managers and family offices throughout the region.

Joining UBP offers the opportunity to work in an entrepreneurial and international environment while building a long-term career in asset management distribution.
About the Role
We are looking for a motivated and ambitious Junior Sales professional to join the Iberia & LATAM Distribution team in Madrid.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional (3–8 years of experience) who is passionate about financial markets and asset management and wants to develop a career in institutional and wholesale sales.

The successful candidate will support the sales team in developing relationships with institutional investors, private banks, wealth managers, distributors and family offices across Iberia and Latin America. The role offers significant exposure to client interactions, investment products, and international collaboration within UBP's Asset Management business.
Key Responsibilities
Business Development & Sales Support
• Support the sales team in developing and maintaining relationships with institutional clients, private banks, wealth managers, family offices and other distribution partners across Iberia and LATAM.
• Assist in identifying new business opportunities and contribute to client acquisition initiatives.
• Prepare client presentations, marketing materials, meeting agendas and follow-up documentation.
• Coordinate client meetings, roadshows and industry events.
• Maintain CRM records and sales pipelines, ensuring accurate reporting of client activity.
• Support responses to RFIs, RFPs and due diligence questionnaires.

Client Relationship Management
• Build strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
• Deliver a high standard of client service.
• Work closely with Investment Specialists, Product Specialists, Marketing, Operations and Client Services.
• Participate in client meetings alongside senior sales colleagues and progressively take ownership of selected relationships.

Market Intelligence
• Monitor market trends, competitor activity and industry developments.
• Assist in identifying sales opportunities and new market segments.
• Contribute ideas to improve sales initiatives and client engagement.
Experience & Requirements
Essential Experience
• 3–8 years of experience in Asset Management, Private Banking, Wealth Management or Financial Services.
• Previous experience in sales support, business development, client relationship management or distribution is preferred.
• Strong interest in investment markets and asset management.
• Good understanding of investment products including mutual funds, fixed income, equities and multi-asset solutions.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Strong analytical, organisational and Microsoft Office skills.

Education
• Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or related discipline.
• CFA or CAIA progress is an advantage.

Languages
• Fluent Spanish and professional English.
• Portuguese is a strong advantage.
Personal Attributes
• Commercial mindset with a genuine interest in business development.
• Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
• Self-motivated and proactive.
• Strong team player.
• Curious about financial markets.
• Professional presence and high ethical standards.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Über UBP Asset Management UBP Asset Management ist ein internationaler Investmentmanager mit Expertise in traditionellen und alternativen Anlageklassen. Das Team von Iberia & LATAM entwickelt langfristige Beziehungen zu institutionellen Investoren, Privatbanken, Vermögensverwaltern und Family Offices in der gesamten Region. Der Beitritt zu UBP bietet die Möglichkeit, in einem unternehmerischen und internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig eine langfristige Karriere in der Vermögensverwaltung aufzubauen. Über die Rolle Wir suchen einen motivierten und ambitionierten Junior Sales Professional, der dem Iberia & LATAM Distribution Team in Madrid beitritt. Dies ist eine hervorragende Gelegenheit für einen Berufseinsteiger (3-8 Jahre Erfahrung), der sich für Finanzmärkte und Vermögensverwaltung begeistert und eine Karriere im institutionellen und Großhandel entwickeln möchte. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird das Verkaufsteam bei der Entwicklung von Beziehungen zu institutionellen Investoren, Privatbanken, Vermögensverwaltern, Distributoren und Family Offices in ganz Iberia und Lateinamerika unterstützen. Die Rolle bietet ein erhebliches Engagement in Bezug auf Kundeninteraktionen, Anlageprodukte und internationale Zusammenarbeit im Asset Management-Geschäft von UBP. Hauptzuständigkeiten Business Development & Sales Support
• Unterstützen Sie das Verkaufsteam bei der Entwicklung und Pflege von Beziehungen zu institutionellen Kunden, Privatbanken, Vermögensverwaltern, Family Offices und anderen Vertriebspartnern in Iberia und LATAM.

• Bereiten Sie Kundenpräsentationen, Marketingmaterialien, Besprechungsagenden und Folgedokumentation vor.
• Koordinieren Sie Kundentreffen, Roadshows und Branchenveranstaltungen.
• Pflegen Sie CRM-Aufzeichnungen und Vertriebspipelines, um eine genaue Berichterstattung über die Kundenaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.
• Unterstützungsantworten auf RFIs, RFPs und Due-Diligence-Fragebögen. Client Relationship Management
• Bauen Sie starke Beziehungen zu bestehenden und potenziellen Kunden auf.
• Liefern Sie einen hohen Standard des Kundenservice.
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit Investmentspezialisten, Produktspezialisten, Marketing, Operations und Kundenservice zusammen.
• Nehmen Sie an Kundenbesprechungen neben leitenden Vertriebskollegen teil und übernehmen Sie schrittweise ausgewählte Beziehungen. Marktinformationen
• Überwachen Sie Markttrends, Wettbewerberaktivitäten und Branchenentwicklungen.
• Unterstützung bei der Identifizierung von Absatzmöglichkeiten und neuen Marktsegmenten.
• Tragen Sie Ideen bei, um Verkaufsinitiativen und Kundenbindung zu verbessern. Erfahrung & Anforderungen Wesentliche Erfahrung
• 3-8 Jahre Erfahrung in Asset Management, Private Banking, Wealth Management oder Financial Services.
• Frühere Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Vertriebsunterstützung, Geschäftsentwicklung, Kundenbeziehungsmanagement oder Vertrieb werden bevorzugt.
• Starkes Interesse an Investmentmärkten und Asset Management.
• Gutes Verständnis von Anlageprodukten, einschließlich Investmentfonds, Fixed Income, Aktien und Multi-Asset-Lösungen.
• Hervorragende Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten.
• Starke analytische, organisatorische und Microsoft Office Fähigkeiten. Bildung
• Master-Abschluss in Finanzen, Wirtschaft, Betriebswirtschaft oder verwandte Disziplin.
• CFA oder CAIA Fortschritt ist ein Vorteil. Sprachen
• fließend Spanisch und professionelles Englisch.
• Portugiesisch ist ein großer Vorteil. Persönliche Attribute
• Kommerzielle Denkweise mit einem echten Interesse an der Geschäftsentwicklung.
• Positive Einstellung und Lernbereitschaft.
• Selbstmotiviert und proaktiv.
• Starker Teamplayer.
• Neugierig auf die Finanzmärkte.
• Professionelle Präsenz und hohe ethische Standards.

À propos de UBP Asset Management UBP Asset Management est un gestionnaire d'investissement international ayant une expertise dans les classes d'actifs traditionnelles et alternatives. L'équipe d'Iberia & LATAM développe des relations à long terme avec des investisseurs institutionnels, des banques privées, des gestionnaires de patrimoine et des bureaux familiaux dans toute la région. L'adhésion à l'UBP offre la possibilité de travailler dans un environnement entrepreneurial et international tout en construisant une carrière à long terme dans la distribution de la gestion d'actifs. À propos du rôle Nous recherchons un professionnel des ventes juniors motivé et ambitieux pour rejoindre l'équipe de distribution Iberia & LATAM à Madrid. C'est une excellente occasion pour un professionnel en début de carrière (3-8 ans d'expérience) passionné par les marchés financiers et la gestion d'actifs et qui souhaite développer une carrière dans les ventes institutionnelles et de gros. Le candidat retenu aidera l'équipe de vente à développer des relations avec des investisseurs institutionnels, des banques privées, des gestionnaires de patrimoine, des distributeurs et des bureaux familiaux à travers Iberia et en Amérique latine. Ce rôle offre une exposition importante aux interactions avec les clients, aux produits d'investissement et à la collaboration internationale au sein des activités de gestion d'actifs de l'UBP. Principales responsabilités Développement des affaires et soutien aux ventes
• Soutenir l'équipe de vente dans le développement et le maintien de relations avec les clients institutionnels, les banques privées, les gestionnaires de patrimoine, les bureaux familiaux et d'autres partenaires de distribution à travers Iberia et LATAM.
• Aider à identifier de nouvelles possibilités d'affaires et contribuer aux initiatives d'acquisition de clients.
• Préparer les présentations des clients, les documents de marketing, les ordres du jour des réunions et la documentation de suivi.

• Tenir des registres CRM et des pipelines de vente, en veillant à ce que les rapports sur l'activité des clients soient exacts.
• Appuyer les réponses aux DDR, aux DP et aux questionnaires de diligence raisonnable. Gestion des relations avec la clientèle
• Établir des relations solides avec les clients existants et potentiels.
• Offrir un service à la clientèle de haute qualité.
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les spécialistes des investissements, les spécialistes des produits, le marketing, les opérations et les services à la clientèle.

• Suivre les tendances du marché, l'activité des concurrents et l'évolution de l'industrie.

title: Programme PMO and Delivery Lead - Consultant

titleByLocale.en: Programme PMO and Delivery Lead - Consultant
titleByLocale.fr: Programme OGP et chef de file

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Missione
Condurre la consegna di una trasformazione complessa e transfrontaliera trasformando i piani in risultati spediti. Avrete la roadmap di consegna integrata, guidare l'esecuzione a valle, e garantire release affidabili. Traduci i controlli finanziari e i dati di consegna in azioni, mantieni pronta la decisione degli stakeholder e migliora continuamente il flusso di consegna e la prevedibilità.

• Principali responsabilità
Leadership della consegna integrata

• Proprio il cross-programma di consegna roadmap, piano di rilascio e cutover/ipercare prontezza

• Eseguire il forum di consegna settimanale: sincronizzazione della dipendenza a monte, revisione del rischio e sbloccare le decisioni

• Gestire la portata attraverso il controllo dei cambiamenti strutturati; bilanciare MVP vs. valore e rischi trade-off

• Mantenere percorso critico, handoff e sequenziamento attraverso i flussi di lavoro Tech e Business

• Assicurare la definizione dei criteri di entrata/uscita e dei gate di qualità per ogni fase

Gestione dell'esecuzione e controllo del rischio

• Operare cancelli scenici/tollgate (Iniziare/Plan/Build/Test/Deploy/Hypercare) con criteri di go/no-go

• Azionamento programma-livello RAID: anticipare impatti, mitigazioni sicure, escalare presto

• Assicurare i requisiti di conformità e normative (ad esempio, privacy dei dati, SOX) nei piani di consegna

• Eseguire controlli periodici sulla salute delle consegne; implementare azioni correttive e correzioni sistemiche

Controllo finanziario

• Mantenere il bilancio pluriennale e le previsioni di rotolamento allineate alle fasi di consegna e alle uscite

• Tracciare effettivi vs. piano; gestire variazioni, accruals, capitalizzazione (CapEx/OpEx)

• Definire e tracciare vantaggi KPI con basi e piani di realizzazione legati alle versioni

• Governance finanziaria del fornitore: PO tracking, allineamento SOW, fatturazione pietre miliari, carte di tasso, bruciare.

• Partner con Finanza sui controlli, le conciliazioni e la disponibilità di audit.

Risorse, Capacità

• Costruire il modello di capacità a monte tra FTE, appaltatori e fornitori

• Equilibrio domanda / fornitura, gestire competenze mix, e ottimizzare cadenza onboard/offboarding

• Utilizzazione del tracciato, produttività e costo-per-serve; strozzature dell'indirizzo rapidamente

• Gestione delle prestazioni del fornitore di unità contro la consegna SLA e metriche di qualità

Segnalazione, Insights e Decisione Velocity

• Eseguire una cadenza di stato settimanale, le prestazioni mensili e le immersioni trimestrali

• Mantenere pacchetti e cruscotti pronti all'esecutivo: pietre miliari, rischi, capacità, finanziari

• Trasformare i dati di consegna in insight e scenari; consigliare e prendere decisioni sicure

• Mantenere una sola fonte di verità per portata, programma, bilancio, rischi, problemi e benefici

Gestione Stakeholder

• Allineare con il direttore del programma le priorità e le opzioni di decisione con i trade-off

• Gli stakeholder della mappa ed eseguire un piano di comunicazione in tutte le regioni/funzioni

Strumenti e dati per il flusso di consegna

• Alzare e utilizzare gli strumenti di consegna Jira/Xray, Confluence, RAID, dashboard)

• Assicurare la qualità dei dati, il controllo delle versioni e la governance di accesso in tutti i artefatti

• Automatizzare la segnalazione laddove possibile; definire il modello KPI per flusso, prevedibilità e qualità

• Il tuo profilo
Esperienza e qualifiche

• 8–12+ anni prima della consegna o della governance del programma in trasformazioni complesse e transfrontaliere

• Responsabilità comprovata per budget significativi attraverso paesaggi multi-vendor

• Traccia record che offre risultati multi-workstream Tech + Business su scala

• Istruzione: Bachelor o Master in Business, Finanza, Ingegneria, o relativi

• Certificazioni preferenziali: PMP/PRINCE2, MSP, SAFe/Scrum, MoP/MoV; CIMA/FP&A

Competenze e competenze

• Lingue: fluente in inglese e francese

• leadership di consegna: orchestrazione a monte, gestione della dipendenza, disponibilità di taglio

• Acume finanziario: bilancio, previsione, CapEx/OpEx, benefici, economia unitaria

• Mastery di pianificazione: percorso critico, pianificazione del rilascio, modello di scenario

• Data storytelling: convertire le metriche di consegna/finanziaria in decisioni chiare

• Comunicazione: materiali croccanti e reattivi; facilitazione tra fusi orari

• Rischio e gestione dei problemi sotto ambiguità; problem solving strutturato

• Strumenti: PPM (ad esempio, Jira, Xray, Confluence), BI (Power BI), suite di collaborazione, Excel avanzato

• Fluency Agile/hybrid: pratiche Agile scalate integrate con porta-stadio

• Altri
• Residenza svizzera

Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori dell’azienda: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agility e Responsabilità - Rispetto dei regolamenti e delle direttive interne
descriptionByLocale.en:
• Mission
Lead the delivery of a complex, cross-border transformation by turning plans into shipped outcomes. You will own the integrated delivery roadmap, drive cross-stream execution, and ensure reliable releases. You translate financials controls and delivery data into actions, keep stakeholders decision-ready, and continuously improve delivery flow and predictability.

• Main responsibilities
Integrated Delivery Leadership

• Own the cross-programme delivery roadmap, release plan, and cutover/hypercare readiness

• Run the weekly delivery forum: cross-stream dependency sync, risk review, and unblock decisions

• Manage scope through structured change control; balance MVP vs. value and risk trade-offs

• Maintain critical path, handoffs, and sequencing across Tech and Business workstreams

• Ensure definition of done, entry/exit criteria, and quality gates are met for each phase

Execution Governance and Risk Control

• Operate stage gates/tollgates (Initiate/Plan/Build/Test/Deploy/Hypercare) with go/no-go criteria

• Drive programme-level RAID: anticipate impacts, secure mitigations, escalate early

• Ensure compliance and regulatory requirements (e.g., data privacy, SOX) in delivery plans

• Run periodic delivery health checks; implement corrective actions and systemic fixes

Financials Control

• Maintain multi-year budget and rolling forecast aligned to delivery phases and releases

• Track actuals vs. plan; manage variances, accruals, capitalization (CapEx/OpEx)

• Define and track benefits KPIs with baselines and realization plans tied to releases

• Vendor financial governance: PO tracking, SOW alignment, milestone billing, rate cards, burn.

• Partner with Finance on controls, reconciliations, and audit readiness.

Resource, Capacity

• Build the cross-stream capacity model across FTEs, contractors, and vendors

• Balance demand/supply, manage skills mix, and optimize onboarding/offboarding cadence

• Track utilization, productivity, and cost-to-serve; address bottlenecks swiftly

• Drive vendor performance management against delivery SLAs and quality metrics

Reporting, Insights, and Decision Velocity

• Run a cadence of weekly status, monthly performance, and quarterly deep-dives

• Maintain executive-ready packs and dashboards: milestones, risks, capacity, financials

• Turn delivery data into insights and scenarios; recommend and secure decisions

• Maintain a single source of truth for scope, schedule, budget, risks, issues, and benefits

Stakeholder Management

• Align with the Programme Director on priorities and decision options with trade-offs

• Map stakeholders and execute a communications plan across regions/functions

Tooling and Data for Delivery Flow

• Stand up and operate the delivery toolset Jira/Xray, Confluence, RAID, dashboards)

• Ensure data quality, version control, and access governance across all artefacts

• Automate reporting where possible; define KPI model for flow, predictability, and quality

• Your Profile
Experience and Qualifications

• 8–12+ years leading delivery or programme governance in complex, cross-border transformations

• Proven accountability for significant budgets across multi-vendor landscapes

• Track record delivering multi-workstream Tech + Business outcomes at scale

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Business, Finance, Engineering, or related

• Preferred certifications: PMP/PRINCE2, MSP, SAFe/Scrum, MoP/MoV; CIMA/FP&A coursework beneficial

Skills and Competencies

• Languages: Fluent in English and French

• Delivery leadership: cross-stream orchestration, dependency management, cutover readiness

• Financial acumen: budgeting, forecasting, CapEx/OpEx, benefits, unit economics

• Planning mastery: critical path, release planning, scenario modeling

• Define, evolve, and enforce delivery frameworks (Agile, hybrid, SDLC), stage gates, templates, and quality criteria.

• Implement baselines and variance management for scope, schedule, and cost.

• Maintain delivery playbooks, RACI, and onboarding for PMs/Scrum Masters across onshore/offshore teams.

• Establish integrated master schedules and release plans; manage cross-team dependencies and critical paths.

• Facilitate PI/quarterly planning with demand intake handoffs to delivery teams.

• Delivery Assurance and Reporting

• Define and Track KPIs/OKRs for delivery health (schedule adherence, burn, velocity, defect density, escaped defects, SLA attainment).

• Build and maintain automated Power BI delivery dashboards; integrate data from Jira/Azure DevOps, time tracking, and finance.

• Ensure accurate, timely status reporting; drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions.

• Operate a rigorous RAID process with heatmaps and escalation paths; maintain mitigation and contingency plans.

• Manage change control and traceability from intake to deployment; enforce scope discipline.

• Ensure compliance with security, data governance, SDLC, and audit requirements.

• Track delivery budgets, forecasts, and burn (CapEx/OpEx); partner with Finance on month-end close and accruals.

• Identify cost and productivity improvements (tooling, automation, standardization).

• Update financial systems and ensure consistency across all PMO toolsets.

• Partner with Business Change, Architecture, Delivery Support and IT Management to align on priorities and release criteria.

• Drive adoption of delivery metrics and continuous improvement programs.

• Preferred: PMP and/or PgMP; Agile certifications (PSM/CSM, SAFe Agilist/SPC); Power BI or SQL certifications are a plus.

• Proficiency with joins, aggregations, CTEs, window functions; exposure to performance tuning basics.

• Experience with SQL Server/Azure SQL, Oracle, or PostgreSQL; familiarity with views and stored procedures.

• Power BI

• Build end-to-end delivery dashboards: connect to Jira/Azure DevOps/SQL, model data, create DAX measures, drill-through.

• Définir, développer et faire respecter les cadres de prestation (Agile, hybride, SDLC), les portes d'étape, les modèles et les critères de qualité.

• Mettre en oeuvre les données de base et la gestion des écarts pour la portée, le calendrier et les coûts.

• Tenir à jour les cahiers de lecture, les RACI et l'embarquement pour les PM/Scrum Masters à travers les équipes terrestres/offshore.

• Planification, calendrier et dépendances

• Établir des calendriers directeurs intégrés et des plans de diffusion; gérer les dépendances entre les équipes et les voies critiques.

• Faciliter la planification de l'IP/trimestriel en remettant la demande aux équipes de livraison.

• Assurance de la livraison et rapports

• Définir et suivre les KPI/OKR pour la santé de la livraison (adhérence à l'horaire, brûlure, vitesse, densité de défaut, défauts échappés, réalisation de l'ALS).

• Construisez et maintenez des tableaux de bord automatisés de distribution Power BI; intégrez les données de Jira/Azure DevOps, le suivi du temps et la finance.

• Veiller à ce que les rapports soient exacts et opportuns; diriger l'analyse des causes profondes et les mesures correctives.

• Utilisation des capacités Suivi et gouvernance

• Définir les normes d'utilisation et les taxonomies (temps direct par rapport au temps indirect, projet par rapport à KT/BAU par rapport au soutien); établir les fourchettes cibles par rôle et par ancienneté.

• Mettre en oeuvre le suivi de la conformité et les vérifications de la qualité; gérer les exceptions à la politique (vacances, PTO, formation, réduction progressive).

• Surveiller l'utilisation à l'échelle individuelle, de l'équipe, du fournisseur et du portefeuille; prendre des mesures correctives en cas de sous-utilisation ou de surutilisation (rééquilibrage, arriéré de traitement, compétences croisées).

• Gestion des risques, des enjeux et du changement

• Effectuer un processus RAID rigoureux avec des cartes thermiques et des voies d'escalade; maintenir des plans d'atténuation et d'urgence.

• Gérer le contrôle du changement et la traçabilité de l'admission au déploiement; appliquer la discipline de portée.

• Assurer le respect des exigences en matière de sécurité, de gouvernance des données, de CLSD et de vérification.

• Finances et gestion des fournisseurs

• Suivre les budgets d'exécution, les prévisions et le brûlage (CapEx/OpEx); s'associer aux Finances à la clôture du mois et aux comptes d'exercice.

• Identifier les améliorations des coûts et de la productivité (outils, automatisation, normalisation).

• Mettre à jour les systèmes financiers et assurer la cohérence de tous les outils du BGP.

• Gestion des intervenants et communications

• Faciliter la lecture exec de l'état de livraison, des risques et de l'état de préparation à la libération; présenter des options et des recommandations.

• S'associer au changement d'entreprise, à l'architecture, au soutien à la prestation et à la gestion de la TI pour s'aligner sur les priorités et les critères de diffusion.

• Favoriser l'adoption de mesures de prestation et de programmes d'amélioration continue.

• Votre profil

• Éducation et certifications

• Baccalauréat en systèmes d'information, affaires, finances, génie ou domaine connexe; diplôme avancé a plus.

• Préféré: PMP et/ou PgMP; Certifications Agiles (PSM/CSM, SAFe Agilist/SPC); Certifications Power BI ou SQL sont un plus.

• ITIL Fondation ou connaissances équivalentes en gestion de services bénéfiques.

• Compétences techniques

• SQL

• Lire, dépanner et mettre à jour les requêtes SQL pour les ensembles de données de livraison/rapport.

• Compétence avec les jointures, les regroupements, les CTE, les fonctions de fenêtre; exposition aux bases de réglage de performance.

• Expérience avec SQL Server/Azure SQL, Oracle ou PostgreSQLTM ; connaissance des vues et des procédures stockées.

• Puissance BI

• Construisez des tableaux de bord de livraison de bout en bout : connectez-vous à Jira/Azure DevOps/SQL, données de modèle, créez des mesures DAX, percez.

• Mettre en œuvre la sécurité au niveau des lignes, les flux de données, les mises à jour prévues et la gouvernance de l'espace de travail.

• Concevoir des récits prêts à l'emploi (pierres, burnup/burndown, débit, tendances des défauts).

• Outillage de livraison & données

• Expérience avec les calendriers Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Tempo et CI/CD.

• Pratiques de base ETL/ELT et de qualité des données; Advanced Excel (Power Query, pivots).

• Langues - La maîtrise de l'anglais est obligatoire et la maîtrise du français est bénéfique

• Autres
• Résidence suisse

Compétences de base : Adhérence aux valeurs de l'entreprise : Dédicace, Conviction, Agilité et Responsabilité - Conformité aux règlements et directives internes

• Direct interactions with clients by phone, e-mail and occasionally in meetings

• Motivated and hardworking personality, highly service- and client-oriented, strong interpersonal and communication skills

• Good priority setting, ability to cope with pressure and high volumes

titleByLocale.fr: Fonctionnaire chargé du respect des contrats

descriptionByLocale.it:
Role Overview: This person provides support to the Hong Kong Compliance team, handling the day-to-day spectrum of compliance activities for the Hong Kong branch, to ensure that the business operations adhere to the requirements of the Hong Kong Monetary Authority, Securities and Futures Commission, the Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority (FINMA), and all relevant compliance-related laws and regulations, including anti-money laundering/sanctions/countering of terrorist financing/ anti-bribery and corruption laws and regulations; as well as internal compliance policies and procedures. Responsibilities:
• Assist the Head of Financial Crime to establish, review and update the AML related guidelines, policies and procedural manuals to ensure they are in line with Group and regulatory requirements.
• Review and investigate transactions triggered by monitoring systems or escalated by front office or other monitoring parties for potential financial crime risks. Report suspicious transactions and escalate for management oversight timely to ensure adequate follow up actions and ongoing monitoring.
• Monitor effective operation of AML tools and processes for transaction monitoring, client screening, payment screening and client risk assessment. Escalate issues for timely resolution and manage necessary remediation.
• Conduct regular recalibration and tuning of parameters and drive enhancements for AML tools and systems.
• Review escalated alerts stopped on payment screening system and escalate transactions potentially related to money laundering and sanctions.
• Review alerts from ongoing client screening and manage the escalation of true hits for risk reclassification and monitoring follow up actions.
• Trigger follow up actions and KYC updates upon irregularities noted from transaction monitoring or client screening.
• Assist the Head of AML / Compliance in preparing internal AML training materials.
• Prepare materials for periodic AML governance meetings.
• Perform ad hoc tasks as assigned by Head of AML/Compliance from time to time.
• Assist in audits and inspections, and investigations where required
• Involvement in special work projects as and when required
• Assist Head of Compliance, Hong Kong and the Compliance team in any other work matters. Competencies:
• Basic bachelor degree;
• 5 – 8 years of relevant experience in general compliance and financial crime compliance, preferably in a Hong Kong private bank
• A keen interest to learn and perform compliance matters;
• Good interactive, communication and writing skills;
• Able to provide alternative solutions to business;
• Motivated and innovative; able to handle issues and resolve challenges in collaboration with colleagues;
• Team player

title: Junior Financial Controller - Transfer Pricing & Analytics

titleByLocale.it: Controller Finanziario Junior - Trasferimenti e Analytics
titleByLocale.en: Junior Financial Controller - Transfer Pricing & Analytics
titleByLocale.de: Junior Financial Controller - Transfer Pricing & Analytics
titleByLocale.fr: Junior Financial Controller - Transfer Pricing & Analytics

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mission Supporta la funzione bank.s Management Control strutturando e governando la gerarchia profit-center, guidando i calcoli dei prezzi di trasferimento (SLA) e le assegnazioni di ricavi, e migliorando le analisi di redditività. Lead data quality e iniziative di automazione (primarily in Excel/VBA, with Business Objects/SQL/Power BI as assets) per fornire reporting, budgeting e previsione mensili affidabili in stretta collaborazione con i team Contabilità, IT e Business.

Principali responsabilità

Gerarchia e governance - Gestire e mantenere la gerarchia dei centri di profitto, inclusi gli auM e le divisioni di reddito per entità giuridiche, linee di business e geografie. - Convalidare i dati di riferimento (centri di costi/profitto, P&L da parte dei gruppi di gestione) per garantire coerenza, tracciabilità e auditability.

Transfer Pricing (SLA) - Partecipa ai calcoli dei prezzi di trasferimento e alloca i ricavi tra soggetti contabili. - Regole di assegnazione dei documenti, metodologie di traccia e contribuisce ai controlli di coerenza e alle riconciliazioni.

Calcolo della redditività - Contribuire a calcoli e modelli di redditività (formula, input, simulazioni) per prodotti, clienti e business unit. - Preparare analisi delle varianza e materiali di validazione per i comitati di revisione e governance della gestione.

Dati, strumenti e automazione - Sviluppare progetti di automazione ad hoc (Excel/VBA/Business Objects/SQL) per semplificare i flussi di dati e i processi di reporting. - Migliorare la qualità dei dati attraverso controlli, avvisi e reporting contabile rispetto alle conciliazioni di reporting gestionale. - Produce e migliora dashboard e KPI (AuM, ricavi, redditività da parte di BU/prodotto/cliente).

Supporto e coordinamento - Fornire supporto al responsabile del controllo di gestione per i cicli di reporting mensile, budget e previsione. - 21a con gli stakeholder contabili, IT e Business per allineare i processi, garantire l'integrità dei dati e fornire risultati accurati.

Il tuo profilo

Formazione - Laurea in Economia, Finanza, Management o HES (Università di Scienze Applicate) in Economia/Economia/Finanza.

Esperienza e competenze tecniche - Esperienza iniziale nel controllo di gestione, audit o finanza in un ambiente bancario. - Fondamenti solidi nella contabilità di gestione: allocazione dei costi e dei ricavi, analisi della redditività. - Eccellente padronanza di Excel con VBA e una forte voglia di automazione di processo. - Conoscenza degli oggetti aziendali, SQL e/o Power BI è un vantaggio. - Fa...

Lingue - Professionalità in inglese; ulteriori lingue sono un bene.

Capacità personali - Rigorose, analitiche, autonome e orientate ai dettagli, con un forte pensiero critico. - Forte mentalità di documentazione e attenzione alla qualità dei dati e ai controlli. - In grado di coordinare con team interfunzionali (Accounting, IT, Business). - Problema-risoluzione mentale e capacità di lavorare in un contesto di chiusura mensile.

Core Competence - Aderenza ai valori aziendali: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agiltà e Responsabilità. - Rispetto delle normative e delle direttive interne.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission
Support the bank’s Management Control function by structuring and governing the profit-center hierarchy, driving transfer pricing (SLA) calculations and revenue allocations, and enhancing profitability analyses. Lead data quality and automation initiatives (primarily in Excel/VBA, with Business Objects/SQL/Power BI as assets) to deliver reliable monthly reporting, budgeting, and forecasting in close collaboration with Accounting, IT, and Business teams.
Main responsibilities

Hierarchy and governance:

• Manage and maintain the profit-center hierarchy, including AuM and revenue splits by legal entities, business lines, and geographies.

• Validate reference data (cost/profit centers, P&L by management groups) to ensure consistency, traceability, and auditability.

Transfer pricing (SLA):

descriptionByLocale.it:
DESCRIZIONE DELLA JOB
Responsabile della piattaforma AI
Possedere piattaforma AI enterprise di UBP: gli strumenti, la governance e l'adozione che consentono a ogni divisione di utilizzare l'IA in modo sicuro ed efficace.
Titolo Role
Responsabile della piattaforma AI

Funzione / Divisione
COO

Location
Londra, Ginevra, Zurigo (viaggio fresco a Ginevra se Londra o Zurigo

Contratto
Permanente, a tempo pieno

Data di inizio
PAESI

Informazioni su UBP

Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) è una delle principali banche private della Svizzera, specializzata nella gestione patrimoniale e patrimoniale per clienti privati e istituzionali.
Fondato oltre 50 anni fa, UBP è cresciuto a più di USD 240bn in attività sotto gestione, rendendolo uno dei più grandi gruppi bancari familiari e a conduzione familiare del mondo. La banca combina la mentalità di proprietà a lungo termine, l'indipendenza e l'agilità di un'organizzazione imprenditoriale con la credibilità, la resilienza e la scala di un'istituzione finanziaria globale.
UBP serve individui ad alta qualità, uffici familiari e investitori istituzionali in oltre 20 sedi in tutto il mondo, tra cui Londra, Ginevra, Dubai, Singapore, Hong Kong e Shanghai.
Per ulteriori informazioni, visitare ubp.com .
Informazioni sul ruolo

La domanda interna di AI a UBP sta salendo velocemente in ogni divisione. Questo ruolo esiste per arrivare avanti a questo: per costruire una reale capacità AI, mettere gli strumenti giusti in modo sicuro nelle mani delle persone, e trasformare gli esperimenti sparsi in risultati che il business può misurare. Si tratta di un ruolo fondante, con lo scopo di modellare come la banca lavora con AI per anni a venire.
Come responsabile della piattaforma AI, si possiede AI come prodotto. Invece di eseguire tutti i casi di utilizzo da soli, si costruisce e gestisce la piattaforma abilitante (il tooling sanzionato, il framework di classificazione dei dati e la governance) che consente a ogni divisione di adottare l'IA in modo rapido e sicuro all'interno dei propri vincoli di sensibilità dei dati. Hai impostato la strategia, priorità dove investiamo, e lavorare di pari passo con l'IT, la sicurezza e la conformità per sviluppare e spedire soluzioni reali e ad alto impatto in tutto il gruppo proteggendo i nostri clienti, le nostre persone e la banca.
Si tratta di un ruolo di alta visibilità con una linea diretta alla leadership senior il mandato di modellare la strategia AI di UBP e la responsabilità di trasformarla in valore dimostrabile in una banca globale.

Responsabilità chiave

• Strategia e visione: definire, allineare e comunicare la visione e la strategia AI di UBP, differenziata dalla divisione e dal dominio (ad esempio, Compliance, Asset Management, Relationship Management), e mantenerla attuale man mano che la tecnologia si evolve.

• Piattaforma & investimento: definire e dare priorità agli investimenti necessari per alzare e gestire la piattaforma AI (accesso modelli e strumenti, opzioni di distribuzione, guardrails e “skills”), lavorando a stretto contatto con IT e Sicurezza per garantire che i dati vengano gestiti all’interno del controllo di UBP.

• Accesso differenziato per dominio: stabilire un chiaro approccio di classificazione degli utenti in modo che i dipendenti ricevano gli strumenti giusti per il loro accesso ai dati (ad esempio, tooling appropriato per il dominio per i team che si confrontano con il cliente rispetto alla capacità più ampia in cui sono coinvolti solo dati non riservati).

• Adozione e abilitazione: guidare l'adozione bottom-up attraverso le divisioni attraverso la comunicazione, formazione e abilitazione.

• Consegna dei casi d'uso e governance: o pera un processo di assunzione e priorità trasparente per casi d'uso ad alto impatto (risultati sull'impatto, sullo sforzo e sul rischio), promuovi casi di business finanziati e prove-di-concetto, e sostenga un comitato di orientamento della piattaforma AI per l'allineamento e le decisioni di bilancio.

• Gestione degli stakeholder: agire come il tessuto connettivo tra il business, l'IT, la sicurezza, la conformità e la gestione, leader attraverso l'influenza e la chiara priorità.

Il tuo profilo

• Provata esperienza di gestione dei prodotti, offrendo idealmente funzionalità di piattaforma o prodotti interni.

• Forte track record di priorità, gestione degli stakeholder e la proprietà dei risultati in un'organizzazione complessa.

• Esperienza comprovata della moderna tecnologia AI (LLMs, agentic / tool-using systems) e come viene implementata in modo sicuro in un'impresa, sufficiente per guadagnare credibilità con team tecnici e di rischio.

• Hands-on e soluzioni-oriented avvicinandosi, entrare nei dettagli per trovare risposte pratiche e sbloccare i problemi attraverso la tecnologia, i dati e la conformità, mantenendo la consegna in movimento piuttosto che gestire da una distanza.

• La familiarità con i vincoli di un ambiente regolamentato e sensibile ai dati; l'esperienza nei servizi finanziari è un forte vantaggio.

• Ottimo comunicatore, in grado di tradurre tra business, tecnologia e pubblico di rischio e di coinvolgere gli stakeholder senior.

• Confortevole leader attraverso l'influenza piuttosto che l'autorità diretta.

Competenze e competenze

• Prodotto e consegna: scoperta, priorità, roadmapping, sviluppo business-case e articolazione ROI.

• Fluenza tecnica: sufficiente profondità nell'attrezzo AI/LLM, nei modelli di integrazione e nella distribuzione sicura per effettuare trade-off audio con IT e Security.

• Governance & risk: classificazione dei dati, sicurezza e consapevolezza della conformità in un contesto regolamentato.

• Comunicazione: comunicazione scritta e verbale a livello esecutivo; abilitazione interna e gestione dei cambiamenti.

• Lingua: inglese richiesto; francese un vantaggio.

Cosa offriamo

• Un raro mandato di fondazione: lo scopo di progettare la capacità AI di UBP e vederlo attraverso la distribuzione reale.

• Sponsorship esecutivo dove conta:, pronto a investire in casi aziendali ROI elevati e autorità di muoversi rapidamente.

• Autonomia genuina per impostare la strategia, scegliere gli strumenti e modellare una nuova funzione, sostenuta da una banca con l'indipendenza di investire per il lungo termine.

• Impatto visibile in tutto il Gruppo: lavoro i cui risultati sono sentiti in ogni divisione e riferito alla leadership senior.

• Un pacchetto di stipendio e benefici competitivi.

JOB DESCRIPTION
Head of AI Platform
Owning UBP’s enterprise AI platform: the tools, governance and adoption that let every division use AI safely and effectively.
Role title
Head of AI Platform

Function / Division
COO

Location
London, Geneva, Zurich (frequent travel to Geneva if London or Zurich

Contract
Permanent, full-time

Start date
ASAP

About UBP

Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is one of Switzerland’s leading global private banks, specialising in wealth and asset management for private and institutional clients.
Founded over 50 years ago, UBP has grown to more than CHF 184.5 billion, making it one of the world’s largest family-owned and family-run banking groups. The bank combines the long-term ownership mindset, independence, and agility of an entrepreneurial organisation with the credibility, resilience, and scale of a global financial institution.
UBP serves high-net-worth individuals, family offices, and institutional investors across more than 20 locations worldwide, including London, Geneva, Dubai, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Shanghai.
For more information, visit ubp.com .
About the role

Internal demand for AI at UBP is climbing fast across every division. This role exists to get ahead of that: to build a real AI capability, put the right tools safely into people's hands, and turn scattered experiments into results the business can measure. It is a founding role, with the scope to shape how the bank works with AI for years to come.
As Head of AI Platform, you own AI as a product. Rather than running every use case yourself, you build and manage the enabling platform (the sanctioned tooling, data-classification framework and governance) that lets every division adopt AI quickly and safely within its own data-sensitivity constraints. You set the strategy, prioritise where we invest, and work hand-in-hand with IT, security and compliance to develop and ship real, high-impact solutions across the group while protecting our clients, our people and the bank.
It is a high-visibility role with a direct line to senior leadership the mandate to shape UBP’s AI strategy and the accountability to turn it into demonstrable value across a global bank.

Key responsibilities

• Strategy & vision: define, align and communicate UBP’s AI vision and strategy, differentiated by division and domain (e.g., Compliance, Asset Management, Relationship Management), and keep it current as the technology evolves.

• Platform & investment: define and prioritise the investments required to stand up and operate the AI platform (model and tools access, deployment options, guardrails and reusable “skills”), working closely with IT and Security to ensure data is handled within UBP’s control.

• Differentiated access by domain: establish a clear user-classification approach so employees receive the right tools for their data access (e.g., domain-appropriate tooling for client-facing teams versus broader capability where only non-confidential data is involved).

• Adoption & enablement: drive bottom-up adoption across divisions through communication, training and enablement.

• Use-case delivery & governance: o perate a transparent intake and prioritisation process for high-impact use cases (scored on impact, effort and risk), bring forward funded business cases and proofs-of-concept, and support an AI Platform Steering Committee for alignment and budget decisions.

• Stakeholder management: act as the connective tissue between the business, IT, security, Compliance and management, leading through influence and clear prioritisation.

Your profile

• Proven product management experience, ideally delivering platform or internal-product capabilities.

• Strong track record of prioritisation, stakeholder management and outcome ownership in a complex organisation.

• Proven experience of modern AI technology (LLMs, agentic / tool-using systems) and how it is deployed securely in an enterprise, sufficient to earn credibility with technical and risk teams.

• Hands-on and solutions-oriented approaching, getting into the detail to find practical answers and unblock problems across technology, data and compliance, keeping delivery moving rather than managing from a distance.

• Familiarity with the constraints of a regulated, data-sensitive environment; experience in financial services is a strong advantage.

• Excellent communicator, able to translate between business, technology and risk audiences and to engage senior stakeholders.

• Comfortable leading through influence rather than direct authority.

Skills & competencies

• Product & delivery: discovery, prioritisation frameworks, roadmapping, business-case development and ROI articulation.

• Technical fluency: enough depth in AI/LLM tooling, integration patterns and secure deployment to make sound trade-offs with IT and Security.

• Governance & risk: data classification, security and compliance awareness in a regulated setting.

• Communication: executive-level written and verbal communication; internal enablement and change management.

• Language: English required; French an advantage.

What we offer

• A rare founding mandate: the scope to design UBP’s AI capability and see it through to real deployment.

• Executive sponsorship where it counts:, ready to invest into high ROI business cases and authority to move quickly.

• Genuine autonomy to set the strategy, choose the tools and shape a new function, backed by a bank with the independence to invest for the long term.

• Visible impact across the Group: work whose results are felt in every division and reported to senior leadership.

• A competitive salary and benefits package.

BESCHREIBUNG
Leiter der AI Platform
Besitz der Enterprise AI-Plattform von UBP: die Tools, Governance und Adoption, mit denen jede Division KI sicher und effektiv nutzen kann.
Rollentitel
Leiter der AI Platform

Funktion/Abteilung
COO

Standort
London, Genf, Zürich (häufige Reisen nach Genf, wenn London oder Zürich)

Vertrag
Dauerhaft, Vollzeit

Startdatum
ASAP

Über UBP

Die Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) ist eine der weltweit führenden Privatbanken der Schweiz und spezialisiert auf Vermögensverwaltung für private und institutionelle Kunden.
Vor über 50 Jahren gegründet, ist UBP auf über 240 Mrd. USD an verwaltetem Vermögen gewachsen und damit eine der weltweit größten familiengeführten Bankengruppen. Die Bank verbindet die langfristige Eigentümerhaltung, Unabhängigkeit und Agilität einer unternehmerischen Organisation mit der Glaubwürdigkeit, Widerstandsfähigkeit und Größe eines globalen Finanzinstituts.
UBP betreut vermögende Privatpersonen, Family Offices und institutionelle Investoren an mehr als 20 Standorten weltweit, darunter London, Genf, Dubai, Singapur, Hongkong und Shanghai.
Für weitere Informationen besuchen Sie ubp.com.
Über die Rolle

Die interne Nachfrage nach KI bei UBP steigt in allen Divisionen schnell an. Diese Rolle besteht, um dem voraus zu kommen: eine echte KI-Fähigkeit aufzubauen, die richtigen Werkzeuge sicher in die Hände der Menschen zu legen und verstreute Experimente in Ergebnisse zu verwandeln, die das Unternehmen messen kann. Es ist eine Gründungsrolle, mit dem Spielraum, wie die Bank in den kommenden Jahren mit KI arbeitet.
Als Head of AI Platform besitzen Sie AI als Produkt. Anstatt jeden Anwendungsfall selbst auszuführen, erstellen und verwalten Sie die aktivierende Plattform (das sanktionierte Tooling, das Datenklassifizierungs-Framework und die Governance), mit der jede Abteilung KI schnell und sicher innerhalb ihrer eigenen Datensensibilitätsbeschränkungen übernehmen kann. Sie legen die Strategie fest, priorisieren, wo wir investieren, und arbeiten Hand in Hand mit IT, Sicherheit und Compliance, um echte, wirkungsvolle Lösungen für die gesamte Gruppe zu entwickeln und zu liefern und gleichzeitig unsere Kunden, unsere Mitarbeiter und die Bank zu schützen.
Es ist eine hoch sichtbare Rolle mit einer direkten Verbindung zur Führungsebene, dem Mandat, die KI-Strategie von UBP zu gestalten, und der Rechenschaftspflicht, sie in einen nachweisbaren Wert für eine globale Bank umzuwandeln.

Wesentliche Zuständigkeiten

• Strategie & Vision: Definieren, ausrichten und kommunizieren Sie die KI-Vision und -Strategie von UBP, differenziert nach Division und Domäne (z. B. Compliance, Asset Management, Relationship Management) und halten Sie sie auf dem neuesten Stand, wenn sich die Technologie weiterentwickelt.

• Plattform & Investition: Definieren und priorisieren Sie die Investitionen, die erforderlich sind, um die KI-Plattform zu betreiben (Zugriff auf Modelle und Tools, Bereitstellungsoptionen, Leitplanken und wiederverwendbare "Skills"), und arbeiten Sie eng mit IT und Security zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass Daten innerhalb der Kontrolle von UBP verarbeitet werden.

• Differenzierter Zugriff nach Domänen: Festlegung eines klaren Ansatzes zur Benutzerklassifizierung, damit die Mitarbeiter die richtigen Tools für ihren Datenzugriff erhalten (z. B. domänengerechte Tools für kundenorientierte Teams im Vergleich zu breiteren Fähigkeiten, bei denen nur nicht vertrauliche Daten betroffen sind).

• Adoption & Enablement: Förderung der Bottom-up-Adoption durch Kommunikation, Training und Enablement.

• Anwendungsfall-Bereitstellung und -Governance: Durchführung eines transparenten Aufnahme- und Priorisierungsprozesses für hochwirksame Anwendungsfälle (nach Auswirkungen, Aufwand und Risiko), Voranbringen von finanzierten Geschäftsfällen und Konzeptnachweisen und Unterstützung eines KI-Plattform-Lenkungsausschusses für Abstimmungs- und Budgetentscheidungen.

• Stakeholder-Management: fungieren als Bindeglied zwischen Business, IT, Security, Compliance und Management, führend durch Einflussnahme und klare Priorisierung.

Dein Profil

• Bewährte Produktmanagement-Erfahrung, idealerweise Bereitstellung von Plattform- oder internen Produktfunktionen.

• Starke Erfolgsbilanz bei Priorisierung, Stakeholder-Management und Outcome Ownership in einer komplexen Organisation.

• Bewährte Erfahrung mit moderner KI-Technologie (LLMs, Agentic / Tool-Using-Systeme) und wie sie sicher in einem Unternehmen eingesetzt wird, reicht aus, um Glaubwürdigkeit bei technischen und Risikoteams zu gewinnen.

• Hands-on und lösungsorientierte Ansatz, immer ins Detail, um praktische Antworten zu finden und entsperren Probleme über Technologie, Daten und Compliance, halten Lieferung bewegen, anstatt aus der Ferne zu verwalten.

• Vertrautheit mit den Zwängen eines regulierten, datensensiblen Umfelds; Erfahrung in Finanzdienstleistungen ist ein großer Vorteil.

• Hervorragender Kommunikator, der in der Lage ist, zwischen Unternehmen, Technologie und Risikogruppen zu übersetzen und hochrangige Stakeholder einzubeziehen.

• Bequeme Führung durch Einfluss statt direkte Autorität.

Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen

• Produkt & Lieferung: Discovery, Priorisierungs-Frameworks, Roadmapping, Business-Case-Entwicklung und ROI-Artikulation.

• Technisch fließend: genug Tiefe in AI/LLM-Tooling, Integrationsmustern und sicherer Bereitstellung, um solide Kompromisse mit IT und Sicherheit zu erzielen.

• Governance & Risiko: Datenklassifizierung, Sicherheits- und Compliance-Bewusstsein in einem geregelten Umfeld.

• Kommunikation: schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikation auf Führungsebene; internes Enablement und Change Management.

• Sprache: Englisch erforderlich; Französisch ein Vorteil.

Was wir anbieten

• Ein seltenes Gründungsmandat: der Spielraum, um die KI-Fähigkeit von UBP zu entwerfen und sie bis zum realen Einsatz umzusetzen.

DESCRIPTION DE L'EMPLOI
Chef de la plateforme AI
Posséder la plate-forme d'IA d'entreprise UBP : les outils, la gouvernance et l'adoption qui permettent à chaque division d'utiliser l'IA de manière sûre et efficace.
Titre du rôle
Chef de la plateforme AI

Fonction / Division
COI

Lieu
Londres, Genève, Zurich (voyage fréquent à Genève si Londres ou Zurich

Contrat
Permanent, à temps plein

Date de début
Dès que possible

À propos de l'UBP

Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) est l'une des plus grandes banques privées de Suisse, spécialisée dans la gestion de patrimoine et d'actifs pour les clients privés et institutionnels.
Fondée il y a plus de 50 ans, l'UBP est passée à plus de 240 milliards de dollars en actifs sous gestion, ce qui en fait l'un des plus grands groupes bancaires familiaux au monde. La banque combine la mentalité de propriété à long terme, l'indépendance et l'agilité d'une organisation entrepreneuriale avec la crédibilité, la résilience et l'ampleur d'une institution financière mondiale.
UBP dessert des particuliers de grande valeur, des bureaux familiaux et des investisseurs institutionnels dans plus de 20 endroits dans le monde, dont Londres, Genève, Dubaï, Singapour, Hong Kong et Shanghai.
Pour plus d'informations, visitez ubp.com .
Sur le rôle

La demande interne d'IA à l'UBP augmente rapidement dans chaque division. Ce rôle existe pour aller de l'avant: construire une véritable capacité d'IA, mettre les bons outils en toute sécurité entre les mains des gens, et transformer les expériences dispersées en résultats que l'entreprise peut mesurer. C'est un rôle fondateur, avec la possibilité de façonner le fonctionnement de la banque avec l'IA pour les années à venir.
En tant que Chef de la Plateforme AI, vous possédez l'IA comme produit. Plutôt que d'exécuter chaque cas d'utilisation vous-même, vous construisez et gérez la plate-forme habilitante (l'outillage sanctionné, le cadre de classification des données et la gouvernance) qui permet à chaque division d'adopter l'IA rapidement et en toute sécurité dans ses propres contraintes de sensibilité aux données. Vous définissez la stratégie, priorisez où nous investissons, et travaillez main dans la main avec l'informatique, la sécurité et la conformité pour développer et expédier des solutions réelles et à fort impact dans tout le groupe tout en protégeant nos clients, nos gens et la banque.
C'est un rôle de grande visibilité avec une ligne directe aux cadres supérieurs le mandat de façonner la stratégie d'IA de l'UBP et la responsabilité de la transformer en valeur démontrable dans une banque mondiale.

Principales responsabilités

• Stratégie et vision : définir, harmoniser et communiquer la vision et la stratégie d'IA de l'UBP, différenciées par division et par domaine (p. ex., Conformité, Gestion des actifs, Gestion des relations) et la tenir à jour au fur et à mesure que la technologie évolue.

• Plateforme & investissement: définir et prioriser les investissements nécessaires pour tenir debout et exploiter la plate-forme AI (modèle et accès aux outils, options de déploiement, garde-corps et compétences réutilisables), travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'informatique et la sécurité pour s'assurer que les données sont traitées dans le cadre du contrôle UBP.

• Accès différencié par domaine : établir une approche claire de classification des utilisateurs afin que les employés reçoivent les bons outils pour leur accès aux données (p. ex., outillage adapté au domaine pour les équipes orientées vers le client ou capacité plus large où seules des données non confidentielles sont impliquées).

• L'adoption et l'activation : favoriser l'adoption ascendante à travers les divisions par la communication, la formation et l'activation.

• Mise en oeuvre et gouvernance des cas d'utilisation : o mettre en place un processus transparent d'admission et de hiérarchisation des cas d'utilisation à haut impact (en fonction de l'impact, de l'effort et du risque), présenter des analyses de rentabilisation financées et des preuves de conception, et appuyer un comité directeur de la plateforme d'IA pour l'alignement et les décisions budgétaires.

• Gestion des parties prenantes: agir comme le tissu conjonctif entre l'entreprise, les TI, la sécurité, la conformité et la gestion, menant par l'influence et une hiérarchisation claire.

Votre profil

• Expérience éprouvée de gestion de produits, offrant idéalement des capacités de plate-forme ou de produit interne.

• Forte expérience en matière de hiérarchisation, de gestion des parties prenantes et d'appropriation des résultats dans une organisation complexe.

• Expérience éprouvée de la technologie moderne de l'IA (LLM, systèmes d'agents et d'outils) et de la façon dont elle est déployée en toute sécurité dans une entreprise, suffisante pour gagner en crédibilité auprès des équipes techniques et de risque.

• L'approche pratique et orientée vers les solutions, en entrant dans le détail pour trouver des réponses pratiques et débloquer les problèmes à travers la technologie, les données et la conformité, en gardant la livraison en mouvement plutôt que de gérer à distance.

• Connaissance des contraintes d'un environnement réglementé et sensible aux données; l'expérience des services financiers est un avantage important.

• Excellent communicateur, capable de traduire entre les entreprises, la technologie et les publics à risque et d'engager des intervenants de haut niveau.

• Une conduite confortable par influence plutôt que par autorité directe.

Compétences

• Produit & livraison: découverte, cadres de priorisation, feuille de route, développement business-case et articulation ROI.

• Compétence technique: suffisamment de profondeur dans l'outillage AI/LLM, les modèles d'intégration et le déploiement sécurisé pour faire des compromis solides avec l'informatique et la sécurité.

• Gouvernance et risques : classification des données, sécurité et sensibilisation à la conformité dans un cadre réglementé.

• Communication : communication écrite et verbale au niveau de la direction; habilitation interne et gestion du changement.

• Langue: anglais requis; français un avantage.

Ce que nous offrons

• Un mandat fondateur rare : la portée de concevoir la capacité d'IA de l'UBP et de la voir jusqu'au déploiement réel.

• Parrainage des cadres là où il compte : prêt à investir dans des analyses de rentabilisation élevées et l'autorité d'aller rapidement.

• Une véritable autonomie pour définir la stratégie, choisir les outils et façonner une nouvelle fonction, soutenue par une banque avec l'indépendance d'investir pour le long terme.

• Impact visible dans l'ensemble du Groupe : travail dont les résultats sont ressentis dans chaque division et dont les résultats sont communiqués aux cadres supérieurs.

• Un régime concurrentiel de rémunération et d'avantages sociaux.

• Mission
As a Senior Legal Advisor specialized in investment funds, you will play a central role within UBP Management Company, UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A. You will be involved in a broad range of fund related legal and regulatory matters, including regulatory compliance, fund governance, and structuring of new products.
You will work closely with all stakeholders of the Management Company, providing legal expertise to support the company’s strategic and operational activities. You will also collaborate daily with our Product Management team and actively contributing to the structuring, management, and evolution of investment products. This key role will allow you to work on diverse projects and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams in a dynamic and international environment.
You will also be in charged of the corporate governance of the _Management Company and its branches.

• Your main responsibilities will be:

• Legal Advice :
• Provide legal advice on the company’s activities, particularly in corporate law, investment fund law, and financial law.

• Ensure the company’s activities comply with local and European regulations (CSSF, AIFMD, UCITS, etc.).

• Draft, review, and negotiate contracts, partnership agreements, management mandates, and other legal documents.

• Collaboration with the Product Management Team:
• Work closely with the Product Management team on the structuring, implementation, and management of investment products.

• Provide legal support for the development of new products and the update of existing ones.

• Fund Management:
• Oversee the creation, structuring, and legal management of investment funds (UCITS, AIF, SICAV, FIS, RAIF, etc.).

• Prepare and update legal documentation for funds (prospectus, articles of association, management regulations, etc.).

• Manage relationships with regulatory authorities (CSSF) and follow up on regulatory requests.

• Compliance and Regulatory Monitoring :
• Conduct legal and regulatory monitoring to anticipate legislative changes and their impact on the company’s activities.

• Collaborate with the compliance team to ensure adherence to legal and regulatory obligations.

• Litigation Management :
• Handle potential disputes in collaboration with external law firms.

• Defend the company’s interests in litigation or judicial proceedings.

• Training and Support:
• Train and raise awareness among internal teams about regulatory developments and best legal practices.

• Provide legal support to various departments within the company.

• Your Profile:

• Master’s degree in Business Law, Corporate Law, or Financial Law.

• Specialization in investment fund law or financial law is an asset.

• 5 to 10 years of experience as a legal counsel in a Management Company, law firm, or financial institution in Luxembourg.

• Proved experience in managing investment funds (UCITS, AIF, etc.).

• Excellent knowledge of corporate law, investment fund law, and Luxembourg and European financial regulations (CSSF, AIFMD, UCITS, etc.).

• Proficiency in the processes of structuring and managing investment funds.

• Ability to draft and negotiate complex contracts in both French and English.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Excellent analytical and synthesis skills.

• Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with multidisciplinary teams.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Discretion and respect for confidentiality (knowledge of German or Luxembourgish is an asset).

Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is a family-owned company, driven by an entrepreneurial vision, innovation and independence. UBP is one of the most strongly-capitalised private banks.
By joining UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A. you will embrace a team of supportive high qualified professionals in Private Banking that will lead you to develop your career to the top level. We encourage continuous learning, development and knowledge sharing. We foster a culture of Agility, Conviction, Dedication and high degree of Responsibility.
UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A encourages all suitable qualified and eligible candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity or expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation, disability or neurodiversity.
In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, retained candidate will be required to provide an extract from their criminal record as a part of UBP screening process.

Associate

Talent Manager

Head of HR

No

No

No

Febuary 2026

Main Responsibilities
This role is primarily responsible for UBP UK's Talent Acquisition, learning and development, training.

Role Duties

Recruitment Lead
• Talent Acquisition Strategy: Develop and execute a recruitment strategy to attract top-tier talent.
• Candidate Sourcing & Selection: Source, screen, and interview candidates for a variety of roles across UBP UK,
ensuring a seamless and professional candidate experience.
• Recruitment Partnerships: Manage relationships with external recruitment agencies, including maintaining and
optimising the preferred supplier list, negotiating terms, and ensuring service level agreements are met.
• Collaboration with HR Business Partners: Work closely with HRBPs to understand workforce planning needs,
provide market insights, and deliver tailored recruitment solutions.
• Benchmarking & Market Analysis: Conduct market research and benchmarking to ensure competitive
compensation and benefits for open positions.
• Recruitment Tools & Systems: Utilise our new tool Oracle HCM to post job openings, manage candidate
pipelines, and track recruitment metrics. Delegate tasks to the HR Administrative team as appropriate.
• Graduate Programme: lead and oversee UBP UK's graduate programme, working closely with colleagues in
Genova.

Learning & Development
• Learning Strategy: Design and implement a learning and development strategy that aligns with UBP UK's
business objectives and promotes a culture of continuous learning.
• Training Needs: Partner with business leaders and HRBPs to identify skill gaps and training needs.
• Training: Develop, source, and implement training programmes, workshops, and e-learning solutions to address
identified needs, collaborating with Geneva L&D team where training is organised centrally.
• Mandatory training: work with Compliance, Risk and other teams to issue mandatory training for staff on a biannual
basis, reviewing training from our system LRN and working with them to amend where appropriate.
Union Bancaire Privée, UBP SA I Human Resources I Job Description I October 2023 1 3

UNION BANCAIRE PRIVÉE
• Vendor Management: Identify, evaluate, and manage external training providers.
• Training Delivery: Facilitate and deliver, or support the delivery of training sessions, workshops, and leadership
development programmes as needed.
• Evaluation & Reporting: Measure the effectiveness of training initiatives through feedback, assessments, and
performance metrics, and use insights to continuously improve programmes. Monitor training hours, study leave,
and completion records of mandatory training.
• Corporate title & promotions: Manage the annual process for promotions nominations, working closely with the
HRBPs.

Other
• Diversity & Inclusion: Collaborate with leadership to develop and implement initiatives that promote diversity,
equity, and inclusion.
• Employee Engagement: Design and execute engagement initiatives to promote a positive and inclusive workplace
culture.
• Succession planning and talent management: Work with HRBPs and leadership to deliver succession planning
and talent management for key roles, ensuring key action plans are in place to address any gaps or support further
development.
Conduct Rules
This role is required to comply with the Financial Conduct Authority’s (FCA) Individual Conduct Rules, which are:

• To act with integrity;

• To act with due skill, care and diligence;

• To be open and cooperative with the FCA, the Prudential Regulation Authoritity (PRA) and other regulators;

• To pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly; 5. To observe proper standards of market conduct; and 6. To act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers.

Person Specification
Knowledge, Skills & Experience

Strong experience in recruitment and learning and development.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with internal and
external stakeholders.
• Strategic thinker with the ability to align talent strategies with business objectives.
• Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
• Experience in designing and delivering training programmes.
• Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and provide actionable insights.

• Mission Within the COO division, part of the Group Operations, the Cash Services Department covers the following areas: - Transfers & payments; - Cash counter, Clients’ safes and Client care center (CCC); - The Money Market & FX transactions; - The Cards activity. The mission of the department is to make sure that the bank’s, contractual or regulatory, obligations are fulfilled, in line with its policies and procedures, especially in a more and more strict and complex environment but also bearing in mind the excellence in the service to clients. The mission of the Head of Cash Services is to provide proper guidance and support to the teams to achieve this goal.
• Main responsibilities
• Coordinate and organise the work of the department
• Delegate appropriately the tasks to each team leader.
• Provide guidance based on the top management direction.
• Make sure, with a clear communication of the bank’s policies and procedures, that a correct risk assessment is made and, if need be, escalation is timely done according to the level of risk.
• Implement relevant monitoring and controls framework
• Identify any risk (operational and regulatory)
• Identify, implement and report quantitative and qualitative reporting
• Challenge procedures and routines.
• Coordinate with internal or external counterparties
• Act as an advisor and coordinator vis-à-vis branches and subsidiaries across the Group, sharing best practices, standardising processes and controls when possible.
• Maintain good relationship with all stakeholders of the bank to provide support and advise.
• Develop a network of professionals with other institutions to keep abreast of systems and regulations evolutions.
• Continuously improve the set up
• Be actively involved in all projects impacting the department from TOM definition to tests and implementation
• Propose measures to increase efficiency, quality and productivity.
• Provide team leadership and coaching
• Lead by example: behaviour consistent with words
• Adopt change with a positive attitude. Express opinions and criticism in a constructive way
• Communicate effectively and be able to take decisions including in difficult situations
• Coach and help develop team members: identify good and low performers and take appropriate actions to develop them or solve dysfunctional behaviour
• Your Profile
• Strong knowledge in Cash Services activities and processes
• MS Office and major banking software
• Experience and proven success in running similar position
• English is a requirement, other languages a plus Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.en:
Within our Wealth Management Division, you will join our WM Greece Team in Zurich , which is in charge of substantial international client relationships, providing superior quality level of banking services. The Team is composed of experienced Relationship Managers, Advisors and Assistants.
 Contribute to the Team success by assisting the Relationship Managers in opening new relationships and serving clients, in compliance with the bank’s internal regulations and guidelines.

Main responsibilities:

• Prepare the necessary documentation for client meetings and business trips

• Handle and monitor stock exchange orders, forex transactions, fiduciary relationships, loans, payment orders and credit card applications

• Cash Management

• Assist in AML clarifications and prepare clients KYC and related updates

• Provide administrative support to the Team

• Direct interactions with clients by phone, e-mail and occasionally in meetings

• Prepare and monitor account openings, closing mutations

• Maintain records in compliance with internal and external regulation. For example: Portfolio reviews, AML, KYC, etc.

• Various administrative tasks. For example: Preparing presentations, travel arrangements, support clients with various requests - banking and non-banking, etc.

• Deputizing of other Team assistants

Requirements:

• Degree/Diploma in a related field or further education; Banking Apprenticeship, Bachelor, Master, CYP, CWMA, or similar.

• Work experience as a Relationship Manager Assistant in banking is required

• Excellent command of German and English is mandatory (C1) / French is a strong asset for this role

• Demonstrate a strong ambition and enthusiasm for contributing to the success of a high-performing international Team by delivering exceptional client satisfaction, with a particular focus on clients in the Eastern Europe region

• Motivated and hardworking personality, highly service- and client-oriented, strong interpersonal and communication skills

• Good priority setting, ability to cope with pressure and high volumes

This is a 100% role located in Zurich.
 Start: asap
