descriptionByLocale.it:
• Main Responsibilities
• The banking operations officer is responsible for the day-to-day activity, control and oversight of the BAU activity as directed by their reporting line.
• The role requires the candidate to support the banking operations department across numerous activities as required by their manager, to deliver high quality standards of work. This presents the opportunity to demonstrate existing knowledge, in addition to being presented with the opportunity to upskill on other areas within the department.
• It is critical to remain positive and proactive in this role, supporting colleagues and having a desire to increase their own knowledge and support others.
• Support of constant improvement initiatives and projects will be required from time to time.
• Role Duties
• The local Banking Operation department is divided into two separate teams as detailed below :
• Banking & Treasury
• UK Domestic payments (Sterling)
• Direct Debits & Standing orders
• Cheque clearing
• Treasury support activities
• Client reporting, online banking & Debit cards
• Client reporting, including valuations and mailings
• Individual Savings Account controls - ISA
• Client debit card support and helpline
• Online banking support and helpline
• Management of physical documents (mail / archives)
• The successful candidate will initially join an area which makes best use of their skillset and experience, with a later consideration to crosstrain as required by the bank.
• Important to support colleagues within banking operations and work with a one team approach.
• Proactively manage Risks and Issues arising within the banking operations scope
• Produce KPI’s for banking operations and provide periodic reporting against KPI’s for Senior Management as defined
• Support the business with development of operational solutions for new products or services in conjunction with the Operational teams at Union Bancaire Privee SA
• Ensure operational functions meet relevant regulatory requirements at all times
• Perform all duties in accordance with the principles outlined in the UBP UK Code of Conduct, as well as the policies and procedures relevant to the role, adhering to a culture that focuses on minimising risks and delivering value
• Ensure adherence to UBP Internal controls standards, systems and procedures that appropriate standards are maintained in all aspects of operational risk and compliance which are endorsed by subsequent audits.
• The job description is not exhaustive and may include other duties as assigned from time to time by management.
• Committee Membership
• None
• Conduct Rules
• This role is required to comply with the Financial Conduct Authority’s (FCA) Individual Conduct Rules, which are:
•
• To act with integrity;
• To act with due skill, care and diligence;
• To be open and cooperative with the FCA, the Prudential Regulation Authoritity (PRA) and other regulators;
• To pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly;
• To observe proper standards of market conduct; and
• To act to deliver good outcomes for retain customers.
•
• Person Specification
• Knowledge, Skills & Experience
• At least 8 years working in a similar operational role, able to demonstrate technical knowledge across banking operations.
• A min of 3 years working with critical outsource/service providers.
• Able to engage at all levels and build strong relationships across jurisdictions.
• Proactive, positive and solutions focused.
• Competencies and Values Required Level
•
• Shows the drive to perform and be successful 5 Persistent in following up on issues 5 Upholds the legal, regulatory and ethical standard of the UBP Group 4 Good product knowledge 4 Knowledge of legal regulatory and industry requirements 4 Business Development 4 Communication - listening, written and verbal with clients 4 Influencing 4 Knowledge of Products and Services 4 Relationship Building - internal and external 4 Strategic & commercial awareness 4 Planning & organising 4 Ethics and values 4 Customer focus 4
• Explanation: 1: low level of competence / skill required, 2-3: average level of competence / skill required, 4-5: high level of competence skill required •

• Mission We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Tax Specialist to join our Client Documentation and Tax Services Department. As part of the Fiscal Reporting team, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy and quality of our clients’ tax statements, while collaborating with various departments and external providers. This is a unique opportunity to grow in a fast-paced, stimulating environment and contribute to impactful projects across the bank.
• Main responsibilities
• Tax Statement Review & Validation
• Review and validate tax statements for over 20 international jurisdictions, including Switzerland, France, Portugal, Mexico, and others.
• Ensure that tax documents comply with local and international regulations before being sent to clients.
• Data Quality Assurance
• Collaborate with our external provider to ensure the quality and accuracy of tax data before statement production.
• Identify and correct anomalies or inconsistencies in the data to ensure reliable reporting.
• Client Support & Front Office Interaction
• Address inquiries and requests from the Front Office regarding tax statements, providing clear and precise explanations.
• Manage tax document orders in coordination with internal teams and external providers.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Work closely with Compliance, Operations, Front Office, and IT teams to ensure smooth management of tax processes.
• Actively participate in cross-functional projects involving process improvements, regulatory updates, or strategic initiatives.
• Project Management
• Contribute to side projects related to tax data, information systems, and operational processes.
• Participate in the continuous improvement of tools and processes in collaboration with IT and other departments.
• Regulatory Compliance & Reporting
• Stay updated on tax regulatory changes across the covered jurisdictions.
• Prepare detailed reports and maintain comprehensive documentation to meet audit and regulatory requirements.
• Your Profile
• Experience : Minimum 2 years in banking, with a focus on tax services.
• Skills : Strong knowledge of financial instruments (Equities, Bonds, Structured Products, Derivatives – Listed or OTC) and their specific characteristics. Familiarity with European income and gains taxation is a plus. Proficiency in Microsoft Office is essential.
• Languages : Fluency in French and English is required; German, Italian, Spanish, or Portuguese is a plus.

• Mission
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Tax Specialist to join our Client Documentation and Tax Services Department.
As part of the Fiscal Reporting team, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy and quality of our clients’ tax statements, while collaborating with various departments and external providers.
This is a unique opportunity to grow in a fast-paced, stimulating environment and contribute to impactful projects across the bank.

• Main responsibilities
• Tax Statement Review & Validation
• Review and validate tax statements for over 20 international jurisdictions, including Switzerland, France, Portugal, Mexico, and others.

• Ensure that tax documents comply with local and international regulations before being sent to clients.

• Data Quality Assurance
• Collaborate with our external provider to ensure the quality and accuracy of tax data before statement production.

• Identify and correct anomalies or inconsistencies in the data to ensure reliable reporting.

• Client Support & Front Office Interaction
• Address inquiries and requests from the Front Office regarding tax statements, providing clear and precise explanations.

• Manage tax document orders in coordination with internal teams and external providers.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Work closely with Compliance, Operations, Front Office, and IT teams to ensure smooth management of tax processes.

• Actively participate in cross-functional projects involving process improvements, regulatory updates, or strategic initiatives.

• Project Management
• Contribute to side projects related to tax data, information systems, and operational processes.

• Participate in the continuous improvement of tools and processes in collaboration with IT and other departments.

• Regulatory Compliance & Reporting
• Stay updated on tax regulatory changes across the covered jurisdictions.

• Experience : Minimum 2 years in banking, with a focus on tax services.

• Mindset : Proactive, solution-oriented, and eager to learn. Strong problem-solving skills, ability to work quickly and efficiently, and a team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

• Work in a challenging yet rewarding environment.

• Develop your expertise and grow your career in a leading financial institution.

title: Compliance Officer Sanctions & Corporate Due Diligence

titleByLocale.it: Compliance Officer Sanzioni & Corporate Due Diligence

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Missione
• Sostenere il Capo Gruppo di Sanzioni & Corporate due diligence nello sviluppo e nell'attuazione di un quadro di controllo forte per conti aziendali e di spedizione.
• Partecipano a progetti e iniziative volte a migliorare il quadro generale delle sanzioni della banca.
• Assist Group Sanctions and Corporate due diligence team nelle loro attività quotidiane (due diligence su clienti nuovi e esistenti, recensioni ad-hoc e monitoraggio di transazioni specifiche).
• Principali responsabilità
• Partecipa attivamente ai progetti della Banca relativi al quadro delle sanzioni globali.
• Esegui recensioni approfondite di conti commerciali da una prospettiva AML, Tax e Sanction.
• Assicurare il rispetto dei programmi di sanzioni internazionali a livello del Gruppo UBP preparando istruzioni/guida di lavoro, garantendo e sviluppando strumenti e processi adeguati.
• Eseguire valutazioni periodiche di specifici clienti, prodotti e/o servizi del Gruppo per identificare eventuali rischi di sanzioni e intraprendere azioni correttive se del caso.
• Assicurare l’orologio della Sanzione, tra cui principalmente i regimi SECO, EU e OFAC per il Gruppo UBP.
• Valutare l'impatto di nuovi regimi di sanzioni in tutto il Gruppo UBP e coordinare con altri dipartimenti / stakeholder come richiesto.
• Assistere e consigliare i team di monitoraggio delle transazioni per qualsiasi domanda relativa a sanzioni e conti commerciali.
• Partecipazione a progetti di manutenzione e configurazione/iniziativa di strumenti di sanzioni di Gruppo.
• Indagare e segnalare transazioni sospette alle autorità competenti, assicurando il rispetto delle norme AML (Anti-Money Laundering) e sanzioni.
• Fornisci consulenza quotidiana ai colleghi in conformità, BRM e Front Office sul quadro interno relativo ai conti commerciali.
• Partecipazione alla revisione del quadro normativo interno che disciplina il monitoraggio delle attività transazionali dei conti commerciali.
• Sostenere le entità del Gruppo nella revisione dei conti commerciali aperti nei loro libri.
• Il tuo profilo
• Laurea magistrale.
• Sono preferiti certificazioni professionali come CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist/Sanctions Specialist) o CAS in Financial Services.
• Minimo di 5 anni di esperienza in AML, sanzioni, tasse o conformità all'interno del settore dei servizi finanziari, idealmente in banche universali.
• Forte conoscenza dei requisiti normativi relativi a AML & Sanctions, comprese le specificità legate alle industrie di trasporto e finanza commerciale.
• Eccellente capacità analitiche e attenzione ai dettagli.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di articolare complesse questioni regolamentari a vari stakeholder.
• Lavorare in modo indipendente e come parte di un team in un ambiente frenetico. Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori dell’azienda: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agility e Responsabilità - Rispetto dei regolamenti e delle direttive interne
descriptionByLocale.en:
• Mission
• Support the Group Head of Sanctions & Corporate due diligence in the development and implementation of a strong control framework for corporate & shipping accounts.

• Participate in projects and initiatives aimed at enhancing the bank's overall sanctions framework.

• Assist Group Sanctions and Corporate due diligence teams in their daily tasks (due diligence on new and existing clients, ad-hoc reviews and monitoring of specific transactions).

• Main responsibilities
• Participate actively to Bank’s projects related to the global sanctions’ framework.

• Perform in-depth reviews of commercial accounts from an AML, Tax and Sanction perspective.

• Ensure compliance with international sanctions programs at UBP Group level by preparing work instructions/ guidance, ensuring and developing suitable tools and processes.

• Perform periodic assessments of specific Group clients, products and/or services to identify any sanctions risks and take corrective actions if appropriate.

• Ensure the Sanction’s watch including mainly SECO, EU and OFAC regimes for UBP Group.

• Assess the impacts of new sanctions regimes across UBP Group and coordinate with other departments/ stakeholders as required.

• Assist and advice transaction monitoring teams for any question related to sanctions and commercial accounts.

• Participate to maintenance and configuration projects/initiatives of Group sanctions tools.

• Investigate and report suspicious transactions to the relevant authorities, ensuring compliance with AML (Anti-Money Laundering) and sanctions regulations.

• Provide day-to-day advice to colleagues in Compliance, BRMs and Front Office on the internal framework related to commercial accounts.

• Participation in reviewing the internal regulatory framework governing the monitoring of transactional activities of commercial accounts.

• Support the Group’s entities in reviewing commercial accounts opened in their books.

• Your Profile
• Master's degree.

• Professional certifications such as CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist/Sanctions Specialist) or CAS in Financial Services are preferred.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in AML, Sanctions, Tax or compliance within the financial services industry, ideally in universal banks.

• Strong knowledge of regulatory requirements related to AML & Sanctions, including specificities linked to shipping and trade finance industries.

• Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex regulatory issues to various stakeholders.

• Work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives
descriptionByLocale.de:
• Mission
• Unterstützen Sie den Group Head of Sanctions & Corporate Due Diligence bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung eines starken Kontrollrahmens für Corporate & Shipping Accounts.
• Teilnahme an Projekten und Initiativen zur Verbesserung des allgemeinen Sanktionsrahmens der Bank.
• Unterstützung von Gruppensanktionen und Corporate Due Diligence Teams bei ihren täglichen Aufgaben (Due Diligence bei neuen und bestehenden Kunden, Ad-hoc-Bewertungen und Überwachung bestimmter Transaktionen).
• Hauptzuständigkeiten
• Beteiligen Sie sich aktiv an Projekten der Bank im Zusammenhang mit dem globalen Sanktionsrahmen.
• Führen Sie eingehende Überprüfungen der kommerziellen Konten aus einer AML-, Steuer- und Sanktionsperspektive durch.
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung internationaler Sanktionsprogramme auf Ebene der UBP-Gruppe durch die Erstellung von Arbeitsanweisungen und Anleitungen sowie durch die Sicherstellung und Entwicklung geeigneter Werkzeuge und Prozesse.
• Führen Sie regelmäßige Bewertungen bestimmter Kunden, Produkte und/oder Dienstleistungen der Gruppe durch, um etwaige Sanktionsrisiken zu identifizieren, und ergreifen Sie gegebenenfalls Korrekturmaßnahmen.
• Gewährleistung der Überwachung der Sanktion, einschließlich der Systeme SECO, EU und OFAC für die UBP Group.
• Beurteilen Sie die Auswirkungen neuer Sanktionsregelungen in der UBP-Gruppe und stimmen Sie sich bei Bedarf mit anderen Abteilungen/Stakeholdern ab.
• Unterstützung und Beratung von Transaktionsüberwachungsteams bei Fragen zu Sanktionen und Geschäftskonten.
• Beteiligen Sie sich an Wartungs- und Konfigurationsprojekten / -initiativen von Sanktionsinstrumenten für Gruppen.
• Untersuchung und Meldung verdächtiger Transaktionen an die zuständigen Behörden, um die Einhaltung der Vorschriften zur Bekämpfung der Geldwäsche (AML) und Sanktionen zu gewährleisten.
• Tägliche Beratung von Kollegen in Compliance, BRMs und Front Office zum internen Rahmen für kommerzielle Konten.
• Beteiligung an der Überprüfung des internen Rechtsrahmens für die Überwachung der Transaktionstätigkeiten von Geschäftskonten.
• Unterstützen Sie die Unternehmen der Gruppe bei der Überprüfung von Geschäftskonten, die in ihren Büchern eröffnet wurden.
• Ihr Profil
• Master-Abschluss.
• Professionelle Zertifizierungen wie CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist/Sanctions Specialist) oder CAS in Financial Services werden bevorzugt.
• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in AML, Sanktionen, Steuern oder Compliance in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche, idealerweise in Universalbanken.
• Kenntnis der regulatorischen Anforderungen im Zusammenhang mit AML und Sanktionen, einschließlich der Besonderheiten im Zusammenhang mit der Schifffahrts- und Handelsfinanzbranche.

Mission
As a Wealth Management Assistant, you will play a vital role in our organization, offering administrative and operational support to our Senior Relationship Managers. Your work will directly contribute to the success of our wealth management division, ensuring smooth operations and exceptional client experiences. By joining our team, you'll be part of a dynamic and collaborative environment, working closely with experienced professionals to deliver the highest standards of service.

Main responsibilities
Administrative support to Relationship Managers:

• Prepare and organize client‑meeting packs, presentations, and briefing notes.

• Monitor account‑opening processes end‑to‑end, coordinating outstanding items and approvals.

• Collect, validate, and maintain KYC/CDD documentation; track renewals and trigger periodic reviews.

• Update CRM/client records and ensure documentation is audit‑ready.

Transaction and operations execution:

• Follow up and process client cash movements, stock market orders, deposits, loan instructions... in an accurate and prompt manner.

• Coordinate with Operations, Compliance, and Front Office to ensure timely settlement and issue resolution.

• Apply regulatory requirements and internal procedures; escalate exceptions and maintain proper controls.

• Reconcile transactions and maintain logs/SOPs for audit and MI reporting.

Client service and inquiry management:

• Serve as a primary contact for day‑to‑day queries; provide quick, clear updates on requests and cases.

• Proactively communicate status on onboarding, KYC, and transaction execution.

• Identify and address service gaps; contribute to continuous improvement of client experience.

• Uphold high service levels (SLAs, TATs, and quality metrics).

Your profile

• Higher education in Banking, Finance or Wealth Management.

• A previous experience, of 3-5 years, in WM (front-office and facing clients) is required.

• Committed team player with good capacities of working autonomously.

• Client focused with a deep sense of discretion/confidentiality and problem-solving attitude.

• Excellent communication capabilities.

• Being bilingual in English and Portuguese is a must. Knowledge of French is an important asset.

• Good knowledge of Administrative IT tools [MS Office].

By joining Union Bancaire Privée (Europe), S.A in Lisbon you will embrace a team of supportive high qualified professionals in Private Banking that will lead you to develop your career to the top level. We encourage continuous learning, development and knowledge sharing. We foster a culture of Agility, Conviction, Dedication and high degree of Responsibility.
Union Bancaire Privée (Europe), S.A. encourages all suitable qualified and eligible candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity or expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation, disability or neuro diversity.
In accordance with the current regulations, the retained candidate will be required to provide an extract from their criminal record as a part of UBP screening process.

descriptionByLocale.en:
As a member of the Client Documentation Team , the Client Documentation Specialist plays a key
role in ensuring:
• A smooth end‑to‑end document process flow across the bank’s departments, especially in
cases of changes in circumstances
• The quality, coherence, and accuracy of client data across the bank’s systems
• The relevance and validity of client instructions by performing signature control
• Efficient and responsive support to other bank departments and branches

Responsibilities:
Day-to-Day Operations
- Review client-provided documentation for changes in circumstances or account closures,
ensuring compliance with local and international regulations (e.g., CDB20, CRS, FATCA/QI) and
internal directives and procedures:

signatures present
o Consistency checks: alignment of data across IDs, corporate documents and bank forms
- Verify that data entered by Wealth Management Teams in the bank’s systems is complete and
consistent with the signed documentation

control quality

o delivering clear, accurate feedback on errors or missing documents
o Responding promptly and professionally to queries related to your scope

Coordination & Stakeholder Management

Compliance, IT, Wealth Management), maintaining an efficient and consistent communication
flow
- Serve as a business partner by contributing expertise and practical guidance on:
o Complex client documentation cases
o Implementation of new regulations or internal decisions
o Departmental or bank-wide projects impacting documentation processes
- Coordinate cross-functional efforts to streamline processes and continuously seek
improvements
- Foster a collaborative environment built on trust, open communication and cohesive team
effort; facilitate problem solving across Teams

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) required

• Relevant work experience in a similar role in the finance industry is required

• Proficiency with Microsoft tools, particularly Excel

• Excellent English skills required; German, Italian, French, or another additional language is a
strong plus

descriptionByLocale.it:
Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) è una società leader nella gestione della ricchezza Private Bank dedicata a fornire soluzioni finanziarie su misura per una clientela diversificata. L'analisi dei dati è fondamentale per come serviamo i clienti e gestiamo il business. Come Interno di Analista di dati WM, estrarrete, trasformerete e visualizzerete i dati, principalmente in Microsoft Power BI, per approfondimenti su temi chiave di gestione della ricchezza. Se si valuta un ambiente in rapida evoluzione con un processo decisionale chiaro, UBP è il posto per voi. svilupperai soluzioni intelligenti e basate sui dati trasformando e aggregando i dati in visualizzazioni attuabili per la gestione senior. Durante il vostro stage, sarete guidati dal responsabile del WM Reporting & Dashboards nel nostro ufficio di Zurigo, con occasionali viaggi a Ginevra se necessario. Principali responsabilità:
• Estrarre, trasformare e caricare i dati dai sistemi interni utilizzando SQL e/o Python
• Costruisci report e dashboard Power BI intuitivi e ben modellati utilizzando DAX e Power Query
• Fornire analisi e commento approfonditi per la gestione, tra cui l'analisi della tendenza e il tracciamento KPI
• Collabora con gli stakeholder per raccogliere i requisiti, iterare sui prototipi e garantire l'adozione del cruscotto
• Contribuisci ai controlli di qualità dei dati e alla documentazione, e supporta le iniziative di dati ad-hoc assegnate dal team lead Requisiti:
• Attualmente perseguire un master o tenere un diploma di laurea in scienza dei dati, informatica, o un campo correlato
• Esperienza precedente nell'analisi bancaria o aziendale, workshop, bootcamps è vantaggioso
• Le competenze tecniche in SQL, Power BI e Python, la disponibilità e la capacità di imparare sono essenziali
• Fluente in inglese; la competenza in tedesco o francese è altamente auspicabile
• Forte capacità analitiche e di ricerca, con una curiosità naturale e un approccio strutturato e organizzato
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, sia scritta che verbale, con una mentalità assertiva e costruttiva
• Un giocatore di squadra proattivo, adattabile e fiducioso che prospera nel affrontare nuove sfide
• Automotivata e orientata verso l'obiettivo, con una mentalità "Problem-Action-Results" Si tratta di un tirocinio al 100% in loco di 6 mesi a Zurigo senza possibilità di lavoro remoto. La data di inizio preferita è il 1 ° ottobre 2026. I candidati idonei non devono aver completato il loro master entro la data di inizio del tirocinio. Inoltre, i candidati devono essere iscritti a un'università o prendere un anno di gap tra gli studi di laurea e master.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is a premier wealth management Private Bank dedicated to delivering tailored financial solutions to a diverse clientele. Data analytics is central to how we serve clients and run the business. As a WM Data Analyst Intern, you will extract, transform, and visualize data, primarily in Microsoft Power BI, to surface insights on key wealth management topics. If you value a fast-moving environment with clear decision-making, UBP is the place for you. You will develop intelligent, data-driven solutions by transforming and aggregating data into actionable visualizations for senior management. During your Internship, you will be mentored by the Head of WM Reporting & Dashboards in our Zurich office, with occasional travel to Geneva if required. Main responsibilities:
• Extract, transform, and load data from internal systems using SQL and/or Python
• Build intuitive, well-modelled Power BI reports and dashboards using DAX and Power Query
• Deliver insight-driven analysis and commentary for management, including trend analysis and KPI tracking
• Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, iterate on prototypes, and ensure dashboard adoption
• Contribute to data quality checks and documentation, and support ad-hoc data initiatives as prioritized by the team lead Requirements:
• Currently pursuing a master’s degree or holding a bachelor’s degree in data science, computer science, or a related field
• Previous experience in banking or corporate business analytics, workshops, bootcamps is advantageous
• Technical skills in SQL, Power BI, and Python, willingness and ability to learn are essential
• Fluent in English; proficiency in German or French is highly desirable
• Strong analytical and research skills, with a natural curiosity and a structured, organized approach
• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with an assertive and constructive mindset
• A proactive, adaptable, and confident team player who thrives on tackling new challenges
• Self-motivated and goal-oriented, with a "Problem-Action-Results" mindset This is a 100% on-site, 6-month Internship in Zurich with no possibility for remote work. The preferred start date is 1st of October 2026. Eligible applicants must not have completed their master’s degree by the start date of the Internship. Additionally, candidates must be enrolled at a university or taking a gap year between their bachelor's and master’s studies.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) est une banque privée de premier plan dédiée à la fourniture de solutions financières adaptées à une clientèle diversifiée. L'analyse des données est essentielle à la façon dont nous servons les clients et gérons l'entreprise. En tant que stagiaire de WM Data Analyst, vous allez extraire, transformer et visualiser des données, principalement dans Microsoft Power BI, pour faire ressortir des idées sur des sujets clés de gestion de patrimoine. Si vous appréciez un environnement en évolution rapide avec une prise de décision claire, UBP est l'endroit pour vous. Vous développerez des solutions intelligentes et axées sur les données en transformant et en regroupant les données en visualisations actionnables pour la haute direction. Pendant votre stage, vous serez encadré par le responsable de WM Reporting & Dashboards dans notre bureau de Zurich, avec des voyages occasionnels à Genève si nécessaire. Principales responsabilités:
• Extraire, transformer et charger les données des systèmes internes en utilisant SQL et/ou Python
• Construire des rapports et des tableaux de bord Power BI intuitifs et bien modélisés en utilisant DAX et Power Query
• Fournir des analyses et des commentaires axés sur les points de vue pour la gestion, y compris une analyse des tendances et un suivi de l'ICP
• Collaborer avec les intervenants afin de recueillir les exigences, d'adopter des prototypes et d'assurer l'adoption du tableau de bord.
• Contribuer aux vérifications et à la documentation de la qualité des données, et appuyer les initiatives de collecte de données ponctuelles, selon la priorité accordée par le chef d'équipe Exigences:
• En cours de maîtrise ou de baccalauréat en sciences des données, en informatique ou dans un domaine connexe
• Expérience antérieure en analyse bancaire ou d'entreprise, ateliers, bootcamps est avantageux
• Les compétences techniques en SQL, Power BI et Python, la volonté et la capacité d'apprendre sont essentielles
• La maîtrise de l'anglais; la maîtrise de l'allemand ou du français est hautement souhaitable
• Fortes compétences en analyse et en recherche, avec une curiosité naturelle et une approche structurée et organisée
• Excellentes compétences en communication, écrites et verbales, avec un état d'esprit affirmé et constructif
• Un joueur d'équipe proactif, adaptable et confiant qui prospère à relever de nouveaux défis
• Automotivé et orienté vers l'objectif, avec un état d'esprit "Problème-Action-Résultats" Il s'agit d'un stage de 6 mois 100% sur place à Zurich sans possibilité de travail à distance. La date de début préférée est le 1er octobre 2026. Les candidats admissibles ne doivent pas avoir terminé leur maîtrise avant la date de début du stage. En outre, les candidats doivent être inscrits dans une université ou prendre une année d'écart entre leurs études de baccalauréat et de maîtrise.

titleByLocale.it: Cyber Risk Manager (Controlli di seconda linea)
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire des risques cybernétiques (contrôles de deuxième ligne)

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission Operating in a highly regulated banking environment (FINMA, EBA, DORA, etc.) and amid accelerating digital transformation – including the expansion of e-banking and mobile banking services, the Group Risk Department is seeking a senior cybersecurity specialist to carry out second-line control activities. Independent of first-line operational teams, the role holder contributes to ensuring the effectiveness, consistency, and regulatory compliance of the Bank’s cybersecurity framework.
• Main responsibilities
• Execute the second-line control plan across the full cybersecurity perimeter: IAM, PAM, endpoints, cloud, networks, e-banking and mobile banking.
• Conduct periodic and thematic controls on security processes and measures implemented by first-line operational teams, to ensure that information security risks are identified, assessed, treated, and reported to relevant stakeholders.
• Verify compliance with banking regulatory requirements (e.g., FINMA, EBA, DORA, etc.).
• Produce well-documented control reports, issue actionable recommendations, and monitor the progress of remediation plans.
• Contribute to maintaining cyber risk indicators (KRI/KPI), and feed reporting to the Head of Cyber Risk Control.
• Maintain a regulatory watch specific to the banking sector, and flag impacts on the control framework.
• Work collaboratively with Internal audit and Group Security, within a three lines of defense model.
• Support first-line teams in understanding control requirements and fostering a cyber risk culture tailored to the banking sector.
• Your Profile
• Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems Engineering, or a business school with a specialization in security
• Minimum 7 to 12 years of experience in cybersecurity, ideally in a banking institution
• Good command of frameworks and working knowledge of FINMA circular on operational resilience, DORA, EBA Guidelines on ICT and Security Risk.
• Good understanding of technical architecture (network, cloud, IAM, AD, fraud prevention).
• Ability to document findings clearly and communicate them to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Analytical rigor, autonomy, and a collaborative working style.
• Proficiency in French and English, both written and spoken.
• Core Competencies
• Critical thinking and objectivity in assessing control frameworks.
• Ability to work cross-functionally with diverse stakeholders.
• Proactiv, solution-orient mindset when facing identified risks.
• Professional integrity and respect for confidentiality.
• Appetite for regulatory watch, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing.
• Others
• Swiss Residence Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mission A creative role at the heart of investment. Within Investment Marketing, we are looking for a talented designer. You will be a full member of the Investment Management team, helping define how our investment thinking is structured, articulated, and presented to Wealth Management, to clients, to investors. At the intersection of portfolio management, strategy and other business lines, you transform complex financial expertise into clear, structured and visually compelling materials. You ensure that investment communication is rigorous, compliant with regulatory requirements, and fully aligned with the identity and standards of an international investment group.
• You design the materials that shape how investment specialists communicate their conviction.
• Your output has immediate visibility with investment digital platforms.
• You have real influence over the visual and editorial standards of the Investment Management team Key Responsibilities
• Investment Content Structure and formalise investment views Translate complex financial analysis into clear, pedagogical narratives Ensure consistency between investment philosophy and client communication Contribute to multi-asset strategy articulation and portfolio frameworks
• Editorial & Visual Design Lead the design of strategic presentations, outlook publications and investment solutions documentation Maintain high visual standards aligned with private banking expectations Build clear message hierarchies and rigorous visual architecture Ensure coherence across asset classes and publication formats
• Digital Integration Oversee content production in Adobe InDesign, related design tools and adapt for digital platforms Contribute to the investment content distribution strategy Enhance client experience across digital investment platform
• Governance & Standards Coordinate cross-functional initiatives within Investment Management Ensure regulatory soundness of all materials in close collaboration with Compliance Drive continuous improvement of production, validation and deployment processes Define and harmonise editorial and visual standards at group level Profile
• Experience Background in private banking, asset management or investment banking Demonstrated ability to structure complex investment content Experience in a regulated financial communication environment Strong interest in the digital evolution of investment content
• Education Higher education in finance, economics or a related discipline. A background in graphic communication or design is considered a strong advantage.
• Languages French - fluent or native English - fluent, written and spoken Additional languages are an advantage
• Technical skills Advanced proficiency in Adobe InDesign — essential Illustrator and Photoshop — an advantage Familiarity with regulated financial communication requirements Experience adapting investment materials for digital platforms Understanding of multi-asset reporting frameworks Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

title: Head of Risk, Monitoring, and Policy

titleByLocale.en: Head of Risk, Monitoring, and Policy

descriptionByLocale.en:
Introduction
 The Risk and Compliance Monitoring Team is a Second Line of Defence function responsible for assessing the adequacy and effectiveness of the arrangements that the business has put in place to facilitate compliance with their regulatory obligations and manage their operational risks.
 Its activity is defined by the annual Compliance Monitoring Plan (CMP) and Controls framework which are based on the key risks identified during the Compliance Risk Assessment (CRA) process, and other risk indicators such as operational loss events and business unit risk and control assessments (RCSA). The plans include a combination of thematic reviews, validation testing, controls testing, and mandatory controls and monitoring driven by specific regulatory requirements or internal undertakings.
 The Monitoring team is responsible for the governance and oversight of the firms policy framework to ensure that UBP UK has in place the appropriate policies to govern the business.

Main Responsibilities

• Run the Compliance Risk Assessment (CRA) and the annual, risk-based Compliance Monitoring Plan (CMP) in addition to overseeing the control framework on a transversal basis for UBP UK< its branches and the UBP SA Jersey branch of UBP SA.

• Collaboration with the Compliance teams and the business to proactively identify key emerging compliance risks across Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) UK and UBP SAJ and engage effectively with business unit contacts and management to incorporate into the CRA and Monitoring plan and activities.

• Manage and track identified actions resulting from monitoring issues to resolution.

• Assist senior management in ensuring that the firm establishes and maintains appropriate policies, procedures, systems, and controls to meet its regulatory obligations and requirements.

• Design, developmentment and maintenance of the periodic monitoring controls undertaken by the Compliance Monitoring team across the remit of Compliance.

• Manage and oversee the UBP UK Policy framework including responsibility for the policy committee and policy approval process

• Ensure that the organsation can maintain accurate and complete records in accordance with Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) UK policies and procedures, ensuring strong version control and detailed recordkeeping

• Support UBP UK in complying with all relevant legislation, rules, regulations, and codes of conduct.

• Safeguard the reputation of Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) UK.

Role Duties

• Ongoing ownership and maintenance of the Compliance Risk Assessment (CRA) and the annual, risk-based Compliance Monitoring Plan (CMP).

• Act as the point of contact and Subject Matter Expert for Compliance monitoring activities executed by the Compliance Monitoring Team.

• Manage and maintain the Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) UK Key Compliance Risk (KCR) library and Mandatory Monitoring List.

• Ownership and oversight for maintaining rule mapping documents for UBP UK entities and UBP SAJ branch of UBP SA.

• Maintain the annual CMP, including management of requests to update or amend the CMP throughout the year to accommodate any additional regulatory changes and/or other trigger events which may occur. This includes ensuring that the appropriate approvals at Audit Committee have been obtained.

• Maintaining the policies, desk-top procedures and templates required to undertake both periodic and thematic monitoring reviews.

• Manage and coordinate periodic CRA “Check Points” and updates

• Design, developmentand and maintenance of the periodic monitoring controls undertaken by the Compliance Monitoring team across the remit of Compliance in collaboration with the Head of Regulatory Compliance and the Head of Financial Crime Compliance. This includes the amendment, addition or removal of controls as required, these amendments may be the result of changes in regulations, business strategy, products/services or findings from monitoring or internal audit reviews.

• Oversight of the control framework and the controls undertaken by 1LOD and 1LODB

• Publish monitoring reports for these activities to the relevant Registered Compliance Officers, Money Laundering Reporting Officers and/or Money Laundering Compliance Officers and key stakeholders

• Complete the above points for UBP UK and branches across Guernsey Jersey and Gibraltar

• Assist the Chief Compliance Officer in providing regular management reporting in respect of the Compliance Monitoring plan, findings and actions to the relevant executive committees.

• Assist the Chief Compliance Officer in providing regular management reporting in respect of the the firms policies to the relevant executive committees

• Chairing the firms policy committee to ensure UBP UK policies are approved in line with the documented governance process.

• Firm standard requirement of 4 days in the office per week however need to be flexible depending on tasks.

The job description is not exhaustive and may include other duties as assigned from time to time by management.

Committee Membership

• TBD

Conduct Rules
 This role is required to comply with the Financial Conduct Authority’s (FCA) Individual Conduct Rules, which are:

• To act with integrity;

• To act with due skill, care and diligence;

• To be open and cooperative with the FCA, the Prudential Regulation Authoritity (PRA) and other regulators;

• To pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly;

• To observe proper standards of market conduct; and

• To act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers.

Person Specification
 Knowledge, Skills & Experience

• Significant financial services experience including a good understanding of the Financial Services activities performed by UBP UK entities in the UK, Channel Islands and Gibraltar (banking, investment management, wealth management and Asset Management)

• Factual analysis and report writing skills

• Ability to assess and analyse changes in laws and regulations

• Attention to detail and focus

• Good written and communication skills

• Strong project management and team leadership skills

• Team Spirit and Collaboration

• High level of competence in Microsoft Office packages, notably Excel.

• Good project / change management skills

• Knowledge of products services and front office

• Good knowledge and understanding of control and reporting tools

• Excellent interpersonal skills, to deal with staff of all levels.

• Education to degree level preferred.
 Competencies and Values Required Level

Shows the drive to perform and be successful 4
 Persistent in following up and through on issues 4
 Upholds the legal, regulatory and ethical standard of the UBP Group 4
 Good product knowledge 4
 Knowledge of legal regulatory and industry requirements 5
 Business Development 4
 Communication - listening, written and verbal with clients 5
 Influencing 4
 Flexibility 4
 Relationship Building - internal and external 4
 Strategic & commercial awareness 4
 Planning & organising 5
 Ethics and values 4
 Customer focus 4

Explanation: 1: low level of competence / skill required, 2-3: average level of competence / skill required, 4-5: high level of competence skill required
descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione
 Il Risk and Compliance Monitoring Team è una funzione Second Line of Defence responsabile della valutazione dell'adeguatezza e dell'efficacia delle disposizioni che l'azienda ha messo in atto per facilitare il rispetto dei propri obblighi normativi e gestire i propri rischi operativi.
 La sua attività è definita dal piano annuale di monitoraggio della conformità (CMP) e dal quadro di controllo che si basano sui rischi chiave identificati durante il processo di valutazione del rischio di conformità (CRA), e altri indicatori di rischio come eventi di perdita operativa e le valutazioni di rischio e di controllo delle unità aziendali (RCSA). I piani includono una combinazione di recensioni tematiche, test di validazione, test di controllo, controlli obbligatori e controlli guidati da specifici requisiti normativi o imprese interne.
 Il team di monitoraggio è responsabile per la governance e la supervisione del quadro di politica delle imprese per garantire che UBP UK abbia posto le politiche appropriate per governare l'azienda.

Principali responsabilità

• Eseguire il Compliance Risk Assessment (CRA) e l'annuale, basato sul rischio Compliance Monitoring Plan (CMP) oltre a supervisionare il quadro di controllo su una base trasversale per UBP UK

• Collaborazione con i team Compliance e l'azienda per identificare in modo proattivo i principali rischi di conformità emergenti attraverso Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) UK e UBP SAJ e impegnarsi efficacemente con i contatti e la gestione delle unità aziendali per incorporare nel piano e attività CRA e Monitoring.

• Gestire e monitorare le azioni identificate derivanti da problemi di monitoraggio alla risoluzione.

• Assistere la gestione senior nel garantire che l'azienda stabilisce e mantiene politiche, procedure, sistemi e controlli adeguati per soddisfare i suoi obblighi e requisiti normativi.

• Progettazione, sviluppo e manutenzione dei controlli periodici intrapresi dal team Compliance Monitoring attraverso l'impegno di Compliance.

• Gestire e supervisionare il quadro della politica UBP UK, compresa la responsabilità del comitato politico e del processo di approvazione della politica

• Assicurarsi che l'organizzazione possa mantenere registrazioni accurate e complete in conformità con le politiche e le procedure del Regno Unito Union Bancaire Privée (UBP), assicurando un controllo della versione forte e una registrazione dettagliata

• Supporto UBP UK nel rispetto di tutte le leggi, regole, regolamenti e codici di condotta pertinenti.

• Salvaguardare la reputazione di Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) UK.

Role Duties

• Proprietà in corso e manutenzione del Compliance Risk Assessment (CRA) e del Piano di monitoraggio annuale basato sul rischio (CMP).

• Agire come punto di contatto e Oggetto Matter Expert per le attività di monitoraggio della conformità eseguite dal Compliance Monitoring Team.

• Gestisci e mantieni la libreria Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) UK Key Compliance Risk (KCR) e la lista di monitoraggio obbligatori.

• Proprietà e supervisione per il mantenimento dei documenti di mappatura delle regole per le entità UBP UK e UBP SAJ ramo di UBP SA.

• Mantenere il CMP annuale, compresa la gestione delle richieste di aggiornamento o modifica del CMP durante tutto l'anno per soddisfare eventuali modifiche normative aggiuntive e/o altri eventi di trigger che possono verificarsi. Ciò include la garanzia che siano state ottenute le opportune autorizzazioni al comitato di controllo.

• Mantenere le politiche, le procedure da scrivania e i modelli necessari per intraprendere sia revisioni periodiche e tematiche di monitoraggio.

• Gestire e coordinare periodici CRA “Check Points” e aggiornamenti

• Progettazione, sviluppo e manutenzione dei controlli periodici effettuati dal team Compliance Monitoring attraverso l'impegno di Compliance in collaborazione con il responsabile della conformità normativa e il responsabile della conformità finanziaria. Ciò include la modifica, l'aggiunta o la rimozione dei controlli secondo le necessità, questi emendamenti possono essere il risultato di modifiche delle normative, della strategia aziendale, dei prodotti/servizi o dei risultati delle revisioni di controllo o di audit interno.

• Supervisione del quadro di controllo e dei controlli effettuati da 1LOD e 1LODB

• Pubblicare report di monitoraggio per queste attività ai relativi Ufficiali di Compliance Registrati, Money Laundering Reporting Officers e/o Money Laundering Compliance Officers e stakeholder chiave

• Completa i punti sopra indicati per UBP UK e i rami attraverso Guernsey Jersey e Gibilterra

• Assistere il Chief Compliance Officer nel fornire report di gestione regolari per il piano di Compliance Monitoring, i risultati e le azioni ai comitati esecutivi competenti.

• Assistere il Chief Compliance Officer nel fornire report di gestione regolari per le politiche delle imprese ai comitati esecutivi competenti

• La presidenza del comitato di politica delle imprese per garantire che le politiche UBP UK siano approvate in linea con il processo di governance documentato.

• Il requisito standard solido di 4 giorni in ufficio a settimana tuttavia deve essere flessibile a seconda delle attività.

La descrizione del lavoro non è esaustiva e può includere altre funzioni assegnate di volta in volta dalla gestione.

Commissione

Regole di condotta
 Questo ruolo è tenuto a rispettare le regole di condotta individuale dell’Autorità di conduzione finanziaria (FCA) che sono:

• agire con integrità;

• agire con la dovuta abilità, cura e diligenza;

• Per essere aperta e cooperativa con la FCA, l'Autorita` del Regolamento prudenziale (PRA) e altri regolatori;

• pagare a causa degli interessi dei clienti e trattarli correttamente;

Specificazione della persona

descriptionByLocale.de:
Einleitung
 Das Risiko- und Compliance-Überwachungsteam ist eine Second Line of Defense-Funktion, die für die Beurteilung der Angemessenheit und Wirksamkeit der Vereinbarungen verantwortlich ist, die das Unternehmen getroffen hat, um die Einhaltung seiner regulatorischen Verpflichtungen zu erleichtern und seine operationellen Risiken zu managen.
 Ihre Tätigkeit wird durch den jährlichen Compliance Monitoring Plan (CMP) und den Kontrollrahmen definiert, die auf den wichtigsten Risiken basieren, die während des Compliance Risk Assessment (CRA)-Prozesses identifiziert wurden, sowie anderen Risikoindikatoren wie Betriebsverlustereignissen und Risikobewertungen von Geschäftseinheiten (RCSA). Die Pläne umfassen eine Kombination aus thematischen Überprüfungen, Validierungsprüfungen, Kontrollprüfungen und obligatorischen Kontrollen und Überwachungen, die auf spezifischen regulatorischen Anforderungen oder internen Unternehmen beruhen.
 Das Monitoring-Team ist für die Governance und Überwachung des politischen Rahmens der Firma verantwortlich, um sicherzustellen, dass UBP UK über die geeigneten Richtlinien zur Steuerung des Geschäfts verfügt.

Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Führen Sie die Compliance Risk Assessment (CRA) und den jährlichen, risikobasierten Compliance Monitoring Plan (CMP) durch und überwachen Sie den Kontrollrahmen auf transversaler Basis für UBP UK und die UBP SA Jersey Niederlassung von UBP SA.

• Zusammenarbeit mit den Compliance-Teams und dem Unternehmen, um die wichtigsten aufkommenden Compliance-Risiken in der gesamten Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) UK und UBP SAJ proaktiv zu identifizieren und effektiv mit den Kontakten und dem Management der Geschäftsbereiche zusammenzuarbeiten, um sie in den CRA und den Monitoring-Plan und die Aktivitäten einzubeziehen.

• Verwalten und verfolgen Sie identifizierte Aktionen, die sich aus der Überwachung von Problemen bis zur Lösung ergeben.

• Unterstützung der Geschäftsleitung bei der Sicherstellung, dass das Unternehmen geeignete Richtlinien, Verfahren, Systeme und Kontrollen einrichtet und aufrechterhält, um seine regulatorischen Verpflichtungen und Anforderungen zu erfüllen.

• Konzeption, Entwicklung und Pflege der vom Compliance-Monitoring-Team im gesamten Verantwortungsbereich durchgeführten regelmäßigen Überwachungskontrollen.

• Verwalten und Beaufsichtigen des UBP UK Policy Framework einschließlich der Verantwortung für den Policy Committee und den Policy Approval Prozess

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Organisation genaue und vollständige Aufzeichnungen in Übereinstimmung mit den Richtlinien und Verfahren der Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) UK führen kann, um eine strenge Versionskontrolle und detaillierte Aufzeichnung zu gewährleisten

• Unterstützung von UBP UK bei der Einhaltung aller relevanten Gesetze, Regeln, Vorschriften und Verhaltenskodizes.

• Schützen Sie den Ruf der Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) UK.

Rollenaufgaben

• Laufendes Eigentum und Pflege der Compliance Risk Assessment (CRA) und des jährlichen, risikobasierten Compliance Monitoring Plan (CMP).

• Handeln Sie als Ansprechpartner und Subject Matter Expert für Compliance-Überwachungsaktivitäten, die vom Compliance-Monitoring-Team durchgeführt werden.

• Verwalten und pflegen Sie die Bibliothek der Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) UK Key Compliance Risk (KCR) und die Mandatory Monitoring List.

• Eigentum und Aufsicht über die Aufrechterhaltung von Regelmapping-Dokumenten für UBP UK-Unternehmen und UBP SAJ-Niederlassung von UBP SA.

• Aufrechterhaltung des jährlichen CMP, einschließlich der Verwaltung von Anträgen auf Aktualisierung oder Änderung des CMP im Laufe des Jahres, um etwaigen zusätzlichen regulatorischen Änderungen und / oder anderen auslösenden Ereignissen Rechnung zu tragen. Dazu gehört auch, dass die entsprechenden Genehmigungen im Audit Committee eingeholt wurden.

• Beibehaltung der Strategien, desk-top-Verfahren und Vorlagen, die für die Durchführung regelmäßiger und thematischer Überprüfungen erforderlich sind.

• Verwalten und Koordinieren Sie periodische CRA "Check Points" und Updates

• Konzipierung, Entwicklung und Aufrechterhaltung der vom Compliance-Monitoring-Team in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Head of Regulatory Compliance und dem Head of Financial Crime Compliance durchgeführten periodischen Kontrollen. Dies umfasst die Änderung, Hinzufügung oder Aufhebung von Kontrollen, wenn erforderlich, diese Änderungen können das Ergebnis von Änderungen in den Vorschriften, Geschäftsstrategie, Produkte / Dienstleistungen oder Erkenntnisse aus der Überwachung oder interne Revision sein.

• Überwachung des Kontrollrahmens und der von 1LOD und 1LODB durchgeführten Kontrollen

• Veröffentlichung von Überwachungsberichten für diese Aktivitäten an die zuständigen Registrierten Compliance-Beauftragten, die Meldepflichtigen für Geldwäsche und/oder die Compliance-Beauftragten für Geldwäsche und die wichtigsten Stakeholder

• Füllen Sie die oben genannten Punkte für UBP UK und Niederlassungen in Guernsey Jersey und Gibraltar aus.

• Unterstützung des Chief Compliance Officer bei der regelmäßigen Berichterstattung des Managements über den Plan, die Feststellungen und Maßnahmen zur Compliance-Überwachung an die zuständigen Exekutivausschüsse.

• Unterstützung des Chief Compliance Officer bei der regelmäßigen Berichterstattung des Managements in Bezug auf die Firmenpolitik an die zuständigen Exekutivausschüsse

• Vorsitz im Politikausschuss des Unternehmens, um sicherzustellen, dass die Politik von UBP UK im Einklang mit dem dokumentierten Governance-Prozess genehmigt wird.

• Feste Standardanforderung von 4 Tagen im Büro pro Woche muss jedoch je nach Aufgaben flexibel sein.

Die Stellenbeschreibung ist nicht erschöpfend und kann andere Aufgaben umfassen, die von Zeit zu Zeit vom Management zugewiesen werden.

 Diese Rolle ist erforderlich, um die individuellen Verhaltensregeln der Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) einzuhalten, die folgende sind:

• Bedeutende Erfahrung mit Finanzdienstleistungen, einschließlich eines guten Verständnisses der Finanzdienstleistungsaktivitäten von UBP UK-Unternehmen in Großbritannien, den Kanalinseln und Gibraltar (Banking, Investment Management, Vermögensverwaltung und Asset Management)

• Fähigkeit, Änderungen in Gesetzen und Vorschriften zu bewerten und zu analysieren

• Aufmerksamkeit für Details und Fokus

• Starkes Projektmanagement und Team Leadership Fähigkeiten

• Kenntnis der Produkte Dienstleistungen und Front Office

• Gute Kenntnisse und Verständnis von Kontroll- und Berichtsinstrumenten

• Hervorragende zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, um mit Mitarbeitern aller Ebenen umzugehen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Présentation
 L'Équipe de surveillance des risques et de la conformité est une fonction de deuxième ligne de défense chargée d'évaluer la pertinence et l'efficacité des arrangements que l'entreprise a mis en place pour faciliter le respect de ses obligations réglementaires et gérer ses risques opérationnels.
 Son activité est définie par le Plan annuel de surveillance de la conformité et le cadre de contrôle, qui sont fondés sur les principaux risques cernés au cours du processus d'évaluation des risques de conformité (ECR), ainsi que d'autres indicateurs de risque tels que les événements liés aux pertes opérationnelles et les évaluations des risques et des contrôles des unités opérationnelles. Les plans comprennent une combinaison d'examens thématiques, d'essais de validation, d'essais de contrôles, de contrôles obligatoires et de surveillance fondés sur des exigences réglementaires spécifiques ou des entreprises internes.
 L'équipe de suivi est responsable de la gouvernance et de la supervision du cadre de politique des entreprises pour s'assurer que UBP UK a mis en place les politiques appropriées pour gouverner l'entreprise.

Principales responsabilités

• Exécuter l'évaluation des risques liés à la conformité (ARC) et le plan annuel de surveillance de la conformité (CMP) fondé sur les risques, en plus de superviser le cadre de contrôle sur une base transversale pour UBP UK< ses succursales et la branche UBP SA Jersey de UBP SA.

• Collaboration avec les équipes de conformité et l'entreprise afin d'identifier de façon proactive les principaux risques de conformité émergents à l'échelle de l'Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) Royaume-Uni et de l'UBP SAJ et de collaborer efficacement avec les contacts et la direction des unités opérationnelles afin de les intégrer au plan et aux activités de l'ARC et de surveillance.

• Gérer et suivre les actions identifiées découlant des problèmes de surveillance jusqu'au règlement.

• Aider la haute direction à s'assurer que l'entreprise établit et maintient des politiques, des procédures, des systèmes et des contrôles appropriés pour respecter ses obligations et ses exigences réglementaires.

• Conception, mise au point et mise à jour des contrôles de surveillance périodiques entrepris par l'équipe de surveillance de la conformité dans l'ensemble de la mission de conformité.

• Gérer et superviser le cadre politique de l'UBP UK, y compris la responsabilité du comité politique et du processus d'approbation des politiques

• Veiller à ce que l'organisation puisse tenir des dossiers exacts et complets conformément aux politiques et procédures de l'Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) au Royaume-Uni, en assurant un contrôle rigoureux des versions et une tenue de dossiers détaillée

• Aider UBP UK à se conformer à toutes les lois, règles, règlements et codes de conduite pertinents.

• Protéger la réputation de l'Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) UK.

Fonctions

• La propriété et le maintien permanents de l'évaluation des risques liés à la conformité (ECR) et du Plan annuel de surveillance de la conformité axé sur les risques.

• Agir en tant que point de contact et expert en la matière pour les activités de surveillance de la conformité exécutées par l'Équipe de surveillance de la conformité.

• Gérer et tenir à jour la bibliothèque de l'Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) UK Key Compliance Risk (KCR) et la Liste de surveillance obligatoire.

• Propriété et surveillance de la gestion des documents de cartographie des règles pour les entités de l'UBP UK et la filiale de l'UBP SAJ d'UBP SA.

• Maintenir le CMP annuel, y compris la gestion des demandes de mise à jour ou de modification du CMP tout au long de l'année pour tenir compte de tout changement réglementaire supplémentaire et/ou autre événement déclencheur qui pourrait survenir. Cela comprend de s'assurer que les approbations appropriées au Comité de vérification ont été obtenues.

• Maintenir les politiques, les procédures administratives et les modèles nécessaires pour entreprendre des examens périodiques et des examens thématiques.

• Gérer et coordonner périodiquement l'ARC.

• Conception, élaboration et mise à jour des contrôles de surveillance périodiques entrepris par l'équipe de surveillance de la conformité dans l'ensemble de la mission de conformité, en collaboration avec le chef de la conformité réglementaire et le chef de la conformité en matière de criminalité financière. Cela comprend la modification, l'ajout ou la suppression des contrôles au besoin, ces modifications peuvent être le résultat de changements apportés aux règlements, à la stratégie opérationnelle, aux produits/services ou aux constatations découlant de la surveillance ou des vérifications internes.

• Surveillance du cadre de contrôle et des contrôles effectués par 1LOD et 1LODB

• Publier des rapports de surveillance pour ces activités aux agents de conformité enregistrés, aux agents de déclaration du blanchiment d'argent et/ou aux agents de conformité du blanchiment d'argent et aux principaux intervenants

• Compléter les points ci-dessus pour UBP UK et les succursales de Guernesey Jersey et Gibraltar

• Aider le dirigeant principal de la conformité à présenter régulièrement des rapports de gestion sur le plan, les constatations et les mesures de surveillance de la conformité aux comités exécutifs pertinents.

• Aider le dirigeant principal de la conformité à fournir régulièrement des rapports de gestion sur les politiques des entreprises aux comités exécutifs concernés

• Présidence du comité de politique des entreprises pour s'assurer que les politiques de l'UBP UK sont approuvées conformément au processus de gouvernance documenté.

• L'exigence standard ferme de 4 jours dans le bureau par semaine doit cependant être flexible selon les tâches.

La description de travail n'est pas exhaustive et peut comprendre d'autres tâches assignées de temps à autre par la direction.

Composition du Comité

• À déterminer

Règles de conduite
 Ce rôle est requis pour se conformer aux règles de conduite individuelle de l'Autorité de conduite financière (AFC), qui sont les suivantes :

• Agir avec intégrité;

• Agir avec la compétence, le soin et la diligence nécessaires;

• être ouvert et coopérer avec la FCA, l'autorité de réglementation prudentielle (ARP) et d'autres organismes de réglementation;

• De tenir dûment compte des intérêts des clients et de les traiter équitablement;

• Respecter les normes de conduite du marché;

• Agir pour obtenir de bons résultats pour les clients de détail.

Spécification de la personne
 Connaissances, compétences et expérience

• Expérience importante en matière de services financiers, y compris une bonne compréhension des activités de services financiers menées par les entités britanniques de l'UBP au Royaume-Uni, aux îles Channel et à Gibraltar (banques, gestion des investissements, gestion du patrimoine et gestion des actifs)

• Analyse factuelle et rédaction de rapports

• Capacité d ' évaluer et d ' analyser les modifications apportées aux lois et règlements

• Attention aux détails et focalisation

• Bonnes compétences en écrit et en communication

• Compétences solides en gestion de projet et en leadership d'équipe

• Esprit d'équipe et collaboration

• Niveau élevé de compétence dans les paquets Microsoft Office, notamment Excel.

• Bonnes compétences en gestion de projet / changement

• Connaissance des services de produits et de la réception

• Bonne connaissance et compréhension des outils de contrôle et de rapport

• Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles, pour traiter avec le personnel de tous les niveaux.

• Éducation au niveau de diplôme préféré.
 Compétences et valeurs Niveau requis

Affiche le lecteur pour effectuer et réussir 4
 Résistant au suivi et au suivi des questions 4
 Respecte les normes juridiques, réglementaires et éthiques du groupe UBP 4
 Bonne connaissance du produit 4
 Connaissance des exigences réglementaires et industrielles 5
 Développement des entreprises 4
 Communication - écoute, écrite et verbale avec les clients 5
 Influencer 4
 Flexibilité 4
 Relation Bâtiment - interne et externe 4
 Sensibilisation stratégique et commerciale 4
 Planification et organisation 5
 Éthique et valeurs 4
 Orientation client 4

Explication: 1: faible niveau de compétence / compétence requise, 2-3: niveau moyen de compétence / compétence requise, 4-5: niveau élevé de compétence requise

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you ready to join a fast-growing, dynamic, and internationally Private Bank in Zurich? We are looking for an Investment Advisor to join our Eastern Europe Team in Zurich. The Investment Advisor is responsible for delivering tailored investment advice and portfolio strategies to high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth individuals. Working closely with Relationship Managers (RMs), the IA ensures client receive comprehensive, risk-appropriate investment solutions aligned with their goals, profile, and the Bank’s values. Main responsibilities:
• Analyze portfolios and provide customized investment advice based on clients’ objectives, risk appetite, and market conditions.
• Construct and optimize investment portfolios using a broad range of the Bank’s Preferred Investment Universe asset classes and the Bank’s products and services.
• Conduct regular portfolio reviews, provide rebalancing recommendations, and monitor performance.
• Act as the trusted investment contact for existing clients, in partnership with RMs:
• Present investment strategies clearly and transparently, including expected returns, risks, and associated costs.
• Manage direct client relationships on investment topics with full autonomy, review clients’ risk appetite (Client Account Risk Profile (CARP), K&E), and execute transactions with pre-trade controls (investor protection).
• Support the deepening of client relationships and enhance retention through proactive investment insights, as well as promote discretionary portfolio management services.
• Assist in client meetings, prepare proposals, and contribute to the acquisition and onboarding of new clients, as well as to business retention.
• Stay abreast of macroeconomic trends, financial markets, and geopolitical developments.
• Work closely with internal teams; Investment Management, Tax, Wealth Planning, Legal, etc. to align with the Bank’s investment strategy and core values.
• Promote and explain investment products to RMs and relevant target advisory client groups.
• Ensure full compliance with Swiss and foreign regulatory frameworks. Requirements:
• University degree in finance, economics, or a related field.
• Perfectly fluent in English and Russian ; any additional language skills are an asset.
• At least 5 years of experience in a similar position in private banking or at a financial institution.
• CFA, CIIA, CWMA, or a similar certification is a strong asset.
• Strong knowledge of investment products and the ability to execute trades in equities, derivatives, fixed income, bonds, warrants, and mutual funds (multi-asset).
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, client focus, reliability, flexibility, and stress resilience.
• Good command of the MS Office suite, portfolio analysis tools, and banking software.
• Ability to work in an agile organization. Start: asap Location: Zurich
