titleByLocale.fr: Assistant à la gestion du patrimoine (M/F/X)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione In qualità di assistente alla gestione della ricchezza, svolgerai un ruolo vitale nella nostra organizzazione, offrendo supporto amministrativo e operativo ai nostri responsabili delle relazioni senior. Il vostro lavoro contribuirà direttamente al successo della nostra divisione di gestione della ricchezza, garantendo operazioni fluide e esperienze client eccezionali. Unendo il nostro team, sarete parte di un ambiente dinamico e collaborativo, lavorando a stretto contatto con professionisti esperti per fornire i più elevati standard di servizio. Principali responsabilità Supporto amministrativo ai responsabili delle relazioni:
• Preparare e organizzare pacchetti client-meeting, presentazioni e note di briefing.
• Monitorare i processi di apertura account end-to-end, coordinando gli elementi e le approvazioni eccezionali.
• Raccogliere, convalidare e mantenere la documentazione KYC/CDD; tracciare rinnovi e attivare recensioni periodiche.
• Aggiorna i record CRM/client e assicurati che la documentazione sia pronta all'audit. Esecuzione di operazioni e operazioni:
• Seguire e elaborare movimenti di cassa del cliente, ordini di mercato azionario, depositi, istruzioni di prestito... in modo preciso e tempestivo.
• Coordinate con le operazioni, la conformità e l'ufficio anteriore per garantire la risoluzione tempestiva di regolamento e di emissione.
• Applicare i requisiti normativi e le procedure interne; escalare le eccezioni e mantenere i controlli adeguati.
• Reconcile transazioni e mantenere log/SOP per la verifica e la segnalazione MI. Servizio clienti e gestione delle richieste:
• Servire come contatto primario per domande quotidiane; fornire aggiornamenti rapidi e chiari su richieste e casi.
• Proattivamente comunicare lo stato a bordo, KYC e l'esecuzione delle transazioni.
• Identificare e affrontare le lacune del servizio; contribuire al miglioramento continuo dell'esperienza del cliente.
• Sostenere alti livelli di servizio (SLA, TAT e metriche di qualità). Il tuo profilo
• Istruzione superiore in Gestione bancaria, finanza o ricchezza.
• Una precedente esperienza, di 3-5 anni, in WM (front-office e clienti di fronte) è richiesta.
• Giocatore di squadra con buone capacità di lavorare autonomamente.
• Il cliente si è concentrato con un profondo senso di discrezione/confidenzialità e atteggiamento di problem solving.
• Ottima capacità di comunicazione.
• Essere bilingue in inglese e francese è un must. La conoscenza di una terza lingua (portoghese, italiano...) è un bene considerato.
• Buona conoscenza degli strumenti informatici amministrativi [MS Office]. Unendo Union Bancaire Privée (Europa), S.A. in Lussemburgo si abbraccia un team di professionisti altamente qualificati di supporto in Private Banking che vi porterà a sviluppare la vostra carriera al livello superiore. Incoraggiamo l'apprendimento continuo, lo sviluppo e la condivisione delle conoscenze. Adottiamo una cultura di Agility, Convizione, Dedicazione e alto grado di Responsabilità. Union Bancaire Privée (Europa), S.A. incoraggia tutti i candidati qualificati e idonei ad applicare indipendentemente dalla loro identità di genere o espressione, età, sfondo razziale, etnico e culturale, religione e credenze, orientamento sessuale, disabilità o diversità neuro. Ai sensi delle disposizioni della legge lussemburghese del 23 luglio 2016 che modifica la legge del 29 marzo 2013, il candidato conservato sarà tenuto a fornire un estratto dal loro registro penale come parte del processo di screening UBP.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission As a Wealth Management Assistant, you will play a vital role in our organization, offering administrative and operational support to our Senior Relationship Managers. Your work will directly contribute to the success of our wealth management division, ensuring smooth operations and exceptional client experiences. By joining our team, you'll be part of a dynamic and collaborative environment, working closely with experienced professionals to deliver the highest standards of service. Main responsibilities Administrative support to Relationship Managers:
• Prepare and organize client‑meeting packs, presentations, and briefing notes.
• Monitor account‑opening processes end‑to‑end, coordinating outstanding items and approvals.
• Collect, validate, and maintain KYC/CDD documentation; track renewals and trigger periodic reviews.
• Update CRM/client records and ensure documentation is audit‑ready. Transaction and operations execution:
• Follow up and process client cash movements, stock market orders, deposits, loan instructions... in an accurate and prompt manner.
• Coordinate with Operations, Compliance, and Front Office to ensure timely settlement and issue resolution.
• Apply regulatory requirements and internal procedures; escalate exceptions and maintain proper controls.
• Reconcile transactions and maintain logs/SOPs for audit and MI reporting. Client service and inquiry management:
• Serve as a primary contact for day‑to‑day queries; provide quick, clear updates on requests and cases.
• Proactively communicate status on onboarding, KYC, and transaction execution.
• Identify and address service gaps; contribute to continuous improvement of client experience.
• Uphold high service levels (SLAs, TATs, and quality metrics). Your profile
• Higher education in Banking, Finance or Wealth Management.
• A previous experience, of 3-5 years, in WM (front-office and facing clients) is required.
• Committed team player with good capacities of working autonomously.
• Client focused with a deep sense of discretion/confidentiality and problem-solving attitude.
• Excellent communication capabilities.
• Being bilingual in English and French is a must. Knowledge of a third language (Portuguese, Italian...) is a considered asset.
• Good knowledge of Administrative IT tools [MS Office]. By joining Union Bancaire Privée (Europe), S.A in Luxembourg you will embrace a team of supportive high qualified professionals in Private Banking that will lead you to develop your career to the top level. We encourage continuous learning, development and knowledge sharing. We foster a culture of Agility, Conviction, Dedication and high degree of Responsibility. Union Bancaire Privée (Europe), S.A. encourages all suitable qualified and eligible candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity or expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation, disability or neuro diversity. In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, retained candidate will be required to provide an extract from their criminal record as a part of UBP screening process.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Mission Als Wealth Management Assistant spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle in unserer Organisation und bieten unseren Senior Relationship Managern administrative und operative Unterstützung. Ihre Arbeit wird direkt zum Erfolg unserer Vermögensverwaltungsabteilung beitragen und einen reibungslosen Betrieb und außergewöhnliche Kundenerfahrungen gewährleisten. Wenn Sie unserem Team beitreten, werden Sie Teil einer dynamischen und kollaborativen Umgebung und arbeiten eng mit erfahrenen Fachleuten zusammen, um den höchsten Servicestandard zu bieten. Hauptzuständigkeiten Administrative Unterstützung für Relationship Manager:
• Bereiten und organisieren Sie Client-Meeting-Packs, Präsentationen und Briefing-Notizen.
• Überwachung der End-to-End-Eröffnungsprozesse und Koordinierung der ausstehenden Punkte und Genehmigungen.
• Sammeln, validieren und pflegen Sie die KYC/CDD-Dokumentation; verfolgen Sie Erneuerungen und lösen Sie periodische Überprüfungen aus.
• Aktualisieren Sie CRM / Client-Aufzeichnungen und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Dokumentation auditbereit ist. Transaktion und Ausführung des Geschäfts:
• Follow-up und verarbeiten Kunden Bargeldbewegungen, Börsenaufträge, Einlagen, Kreditanweisungen ... in einer genauen und prompten Weise.
• Koordination mit Operations, Compliance und Front Office, um eine rechtzeitige Abwicklung und Problemlösung zu gewährleisten.
• Anwendung regulatorischer Anforderungen und interner Verfahren; Eskalation von Ausnahmen und Aufrechterhaltung ordnungsgemäßer Kontrollen.
• Abgleich von Transaktionen und Pflege von Logs/SOPs für Audits und MI-Berichte. Kundenservice und Anfragemanagement:
• Als primärer Ansprechpartner für tägliche Anfragen dienen; schnelle, klare Updates zu Anfragen und Fällen bereitstellen.
• Proaktiv kommunizieren Status auf Onboarding, KYC und Transaktionsausführung.
• Servicelücken identifizieren und beheben; zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Kundenerfahrung beitragen.
• Hohe Service Levels (SLAs, TATs und Qualitätsmetriken) beibehalten. Dein Profil
• Hochschulbildung in Banking, Finance oder Wealth Management.
• Eine vorherige Erfahrung von 3-5 Jahren in WM (Front-Office und konfrontierte Kunden) ist erforderlich.
• Engagierter Teamplayer mit guten Fähigkeiten, autonom zu arbeiten.
• Der Kunde konzentrierte sich auf ein tiefes Gefühl der Diskretion / Vertraulichkeit und Problemlösungshaltung.
• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
• Zweisprachigkeit in Englisch und Französisch ist ein Muss. Kenntnisse einer dritten Sprache (Portugiesisch, Italienisch...) gelten als Aktivposten.
• Gute Kenntnisse der administrativen IT-Tools [MS Office]. Wenn Sie zu Union Bancaire Privée (Europe), S.A. in Luxemburg kommen, werden Sie ein Team von hochqualifizierten Fachkräften im Private Banking unterstützen, das Sie dazu bringt, Ihre Karriere auf höchstem Niveau zu entwickeln. Wir fördern kontinuierliches Lernen, Entwicklung und Wissensaustausch. Wir fördern eine Kultur der Agilität, Überzeugung, Hingabe und ein hohes Maß an Verantwortung. Union Bancaire Privée (Europe), S.A. ermutigt alle geeigneten qualifizierten und berechtigten Kandidaten, sich unabhängig von ihrer Geschlechtsidentität oder -ausdruck, Alter, Rasse, ethnischen und kulturellen Hintergrund, Religion und Weltanschauung, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Neurodiversität zu bewerben. Gemäß den Bestimmungen des luxemburgischen Gesetzes vom 23. Juli 2016 zur Änderung des Gesetzes vom 29. März 2013 müssen die ausgewählten Kandidaten im Rahmen des UBP-Screenings einen Auszug aus ihrem Strafregister vorlegen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission En tant qu'adjoint à la gestion de patrimoine, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans notre organisation, offrant un soutien administratif et opérationnel à nos gestionnaires principaux des relations. Votre travail contribuera directement au succès de notre division de gestion de patrimoine, assurant des opérations en douceur et des expériences clients exceptionnelles. En vous joignant à notre équipe, vous ferez partie d'un environnement dynamique et collaboratif, travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des professionnels expérimentés pour offrir les plus hautes normes de service. Principales responsabilités Soutien administratif aux gestionnaires de relations :
• Préparer et organiser des trousses de réunions, des présentations et des notes d'information.
• Surveiller les processus d'ouverture de compte de bout en bout, coordonner les éléments en suspens et les approbations.
• Recueillir, valider et tenir à jour la documentation sur les CYK/CDD; suivre les renouvellements et déclencher des examens périodiques.
• Mettre à jour les dossiers CRM/client et s'assurer que la documentation est prête à être vérifiée. Exécution des transactions et opérations:
• Suivre et traiter les mouvements de trésorerie des clients, les ordres boursiers, les dépôts, les instructions de prêt... de manière précise et rapide.
• Coordonner avec les Opérations, la Conformité et le Front Office afin d'assurer un règlement et un règlement en temps opportun.
• Appliquer les exigences réglementaires et les procédures internes; intensifier les exceptions et maintenir les contrôles appropriés.
• Reconcile les transactions et tient à jour les registres et les PON pour les rapports de vérification et de GI. Services à la clientèle et gestion des demandes de renseignements :
• Servir de contact principal pour les demandes quotidiennes; fournir des mises à jour rapides et claires sur les demandes et les cas.
• Communiquer proactivement le statut à bord, KYC et l'exécution de la transaction.
• Identifier et combler les lacunes en matière de services; contribuer à l'amélioration continue de l'expérience des clients.
• Maintenir des niveaux de service élevés (SLA, TAT et métriques de qualité). Votre profil
• Enseignement supérieur en banque, finance ou gestion de patrimoine.
• Une expérience antérieure, de 3 à 5 ans, en WM (avant-poste et clients faisant face) est requise.
• Joueur d'équipe engagé avec de bonnes capacités de travail autonome.
• Le client s'est concentré sur un sentiment profond de discrétion/confidentialité et d'attitude de résolution de problèmes.
• Excellentes capacités de communication.
• Être bilingue en anglais et en français est un must. La connaissance d'une troisième langue (portugais, italien...) est considérée comme un atout.
• Bonne connaissance des outils informatiques administratifs [Bureau du SM]. En rejoignant l'Union Bancaire Privée (Europe), S.A au Luxembourg, vous allez embrasser une équipe de professionnels hautement qualifiés en Private Banking qui vous mènera à développer votre carrière au plus haut niveau. Nous encourageons l'apprentissage continu, le développement et le partage des connaissances. Nous favorisons une culture de l'agilité, de la condamnation, de la dédicace et du haut degré de responsabilité. Union Bancaire Privée (Europe), S.A. encourage tous les candidats qualifiés et admissibles à présenter une demande quelle que soit leur identité ou expression de genre, leur âge, leur origine raciale, ethnique et culturelle, leur religion et leurs croyances, leur orientation sexuelle, leur handicap ou leur neurodiversité. Conformément aux dispositions de la loi luxembourgeoise du 23 juillet 2016 modifiant la loi du 29 mars 2013, le candidat retenu sera tenu de fournir un extrait de son casier judiciaire dans le cadre du processus de contrôle UBP.

titleByLocale.fr: Assistant à la gestion du patrimoine (M/F/X)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mission By joining Union Bancaire Privée (Europe) S.A. wealth management division as an Assistant you will provide administrative and operational support the Senior Relationship Managers and customers according to our quality standards and banking regulations. Main responsibilities
• Administrative support to Relationship Managers:
• Prepare and organize client‑meeting packs, presentations, and briefing notes.
• Monitor account‑opening processes end‑to‑end, coordinating outstanding items and approvals.
• Collect, validate, and maintain KYC/CDD documentation; track renewals and trigger periodic reviews.
• Update CRM/client records and ensure documentation is audit‑ready.
• Transaction and operations execution:
• Follow up and process client cash movements, deposits, and loan instructions accurately and promptly.
• Coordinate with Operations, Compliance, and Front Office to ensure timely settlement and issue resolution.
• Apply regulatory requirements and internal procedures; escalate exceptions and maintain proper controls.
• Reconcile transactions and maintain logs/SOPs for audit and MI reporting.
• Client service and inquiry management:
• Serve as a primary contact for day‑to‑day queries; provide quick, clear updates on requests and cases.
• Proactively communicate status on onboarding, KYC, and transaction execution.
• Identify and address service gaps; contribute to continuous improvement of client experience.
• Uphold high service levels (SLAs, TATs, and quality metrics). Your profile
• Higher education in Banking, Finance or Wealth Management.
• A previous experience, of 3-5 years, in WM (front-office and facing clients) is required.
• Committed team player with good capacities of working autonomously.
• Client focused with a deep sense of discretion/confidentiality and problem-solving attitude.
• Excellent communication capabilities.
• Being bilingual in English and French is a must. Knowledge of German is a considered asset.
• Good knowledge of Administrative IT tools [MS Office]. By joining Union Bancaire Privée (Europe), S.A in Luxembourg you will embrace a team of supportive high qualified professionals in Private Banking that will lead you to develop your career to the top level. We encourage continuous learning, development and knowledge sharing. We foster a culture of Agility, Conviction, Dedication and high degree of Responsibility. Union Bancaire Privée (Europe), S.A. encourages all suitable qualified and eligible candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity or expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation, disability or neuro diversity. In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, retained candidate will be required to provide an extract from their criminal record as a part of UBP screening process.

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission : As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will play a crucial role in managing and improving our Microsoft/Citrix based systems and infrastructure. Your expertise will be essential in ensuring high availability, performance, and security of our IT services. Challenges:
• Evolve in a challenging, regulated environment for a fast and growing Private Bank.
• Main responsibilities:
• Design, implementation, and management of Microsoft-related technologies, including but not limited to Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Microsoft PKI, DFS, MS Teams.
• Design, implementation, and management of the Exchange infrastructure
• Monitor and optimize email server performance, storage, and capacity planning
• Manage the Archiving solution, based on Enterprise Vault, ensure retention and compliance rules are applied
• Prepare and operate the transition to the Cloud Solution
• Design, implementation, and management of Citrix-related technologies,
• Provide production support for our Microsoft environments, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.
• Manage and resolve complex incidents and problems, minimizing downtime and mitigating impacts on business operations.
• Implement and maintain system monitoring solutions to pre-emptively identify potential issues (SCOM / NIMSOFT).
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams for system enhancements and integration of new technologies.
• Ensure compliance with security policies and procedures, including regular system audits and updates.
• Conduct root cause analysis for major incidents and lead problem management processes.
• Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations, procedures, and service records.
• Be part of an on-call service rotation one week per month (24/24-7j/7)
• Must have with strong expertise in :
• Microsoft Infra (AD, DHCP, SCOM)
• Exchange 2019 and email security solutions
• SCCM
• Powershell scripting
• MS Team
• Ansible
• Nice to have :
• M365
• Intune
• Citrix
• AirWatch MDM Mobility plateform
• Others
• Swiss Residence
• Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission:
• Team leader of the IT Compliance unit ensuring the delivery and operations of all the services used by the bank Compliance entities at Group and Branch levels
• In charge of managing a team of 11 IT specialists composed of business analysts and project managers
• Key responsibilities:
• Manage the daily operations of the team and the related services to meet the expected level of quality
• Manage the portfolio of projects and ensure the proper delivery on time by meeting the business requirements within the approved budget
• Manage the team OPEX and CAPEX budgets within the approved envelopes
• Manage the team resources by setting individual objectives and developing their career path
• Specific Competencies and other Skills/Abilities:
• Master Degree in IT Engineering or equivalent.
• A minimum of 10 years’ experience as IT Team Lead in a banking organization
• Functional knowledge of Compliance, KYC, AML and regulatory reporting topics in the context of Private Banking
• Technical knowledge of the IMTF AML and risk scoring solutions
• Capacity to deal with several matters simultaneously
• Ability to work independently, take decisions and set priorities
• Pragmatic and solution oriented
• Strong leadership, analytical and communication skills, ability to interact at management level with key bank stakeholders
• Fluent in French and English; additional languages are considered an asset
• Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility
• Others
• Swiss Residence Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission Ensure the accurate and timely execution of client fund orders across Mutual Funds, Hedge Funds, and Private Equity Funds for all UBP branches, while maintaining strict compliance with internal processes and regulatory requirements. Deliver exceptional service to clients to ensure seamless end-to-end fund order processing.
• Main responsibilities Execute client fund orders across Mutual Funds, Hedge Funds, Private Equity. Mutual funds are processed primarily via SWIFT through a global custodian while Alternatives (HF/PE) are placed directly with fund administrators, including completion of required subscription/redemption documentation and KYC/AML. Coordinate funding, settlement, and confirmations; manage pre-funding, notice periods, and specific terms (gates/lock-ups).
• Your Profile
• Education and Technical Skills
• Bachelor’s degree in Economics (or equivalent).
• Proficient in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, Outlook, VBA a plus).
• Familiarity with fund order workflows and transfer agent processes environments is an asset
• Personal Skills
• Think in “Problem–Action–Results” terms; proactive and driven.
• Strong client service ethic; clear and professional communicator.
• Highly organized with excellent attention to detail; able to manage tight deadlines and work under pressure in a high-volume setting.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify issues, propose solutions, and follow through to completion.
• Constructive, collaborative, and committed to continuous learning.
• Adaptable, self-motivated, and a team player.
• Sound understanding of operational risks in fund execution with disciplined control and timely escalation.

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission The candidate will be part of the Data Intelligence & Digitalisation team within Wealth Management and will take part in the development of the digital platform for private bankers. The Wealth Management is currently enhancing its digital platform with the objectives to better integrate data and services for bankers and clients. The candidate will have to work in a complex environment involving technical and business challenges with many stakeholders.
• Main responsibilities
• Participate in the development effort of the digital platform
• By integrating existing web services into a new user experience
• Develop screens and navigation in the intranet Portal
• Design and implement new features across the existing software stack
• Define and challenge upcoming features from a technical perspective
• Navigate through a large set of existing databases and write optimized queries against them
• Work closely with business and quantitative analysts to ensure that technical solutions are feasible and meet the needs of the business
• Your Profile
• 3 to 5 years experience
• Excellent computing and analytical skills. In particular, the ability to drill-down in existing code in the absence of any documentation
• Proactive and user-focused, with a genuine interest in the functional as well as technical aspects of each challenge encountered
• Full-stack development across .NET 8.0 (C#) and legacy .NET Framework applications, plus JavaScript (Vue.js)
• Knowledge of web-based application development. Interest in UI/UX. Knowledge of PrimeVue and AG grid will be a plus
• Broad experience of databases. SQL (Oracle) will be used as well as Entity Framework
• Knowledge of continuous integration/continuous deployment (ideally with Azure Devops, Ansible, Jenkins and GIT)
• The ability to adapt to and learn new skills and techniques in a very dynamic and changing environment Nice to have
• Worked in an Agile development environment with Jira
• Knowledge of finance and banking is a plus
• Others
• Swiss Residence Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
SECURITIES TRANSFER OFFICER - 6 MONTHS MISSION Mission Ensure the clients' assets delivery/receipt for all the activities associated with the transfer of securities to a different financial establishment or within the Bank. This includes all type of assets with expertise primarily required in alternative assets such as mutual funds, Private Equities and Hedge Funds Effective date : ASAP. Main responsibilities
• Crossed analysis of the received information: custodian’s swifts, agent prospectus, contract notes and financial providers such as: Bloomberg, Telekurs.
• Perform control of reconciliation of holdings, entitlements determination, pending positions management.
• Be able to manage and control securities transfer instructions received from Wealth Management and external parties (transfer IN/OUT/Internal and funds registration process).
• Control transmission of the deposits to our correspondents/Transfer Agents/Administrators and control of their safe delivery and acceptance.
• Follow-up of the topics and issues over the lifecycle of the securities transfer activities.
• Good understanding of the risks inherent in the Corporate Actions environment related to ongoing securities transfers and demonstrate good discipline around control and escalation.
• Ensure daily follow up in respect of pending issues and take appropriate measures for resolution. Your Profile
• Education : Master Degree
• Languages : french and english
• Others
• Swiss Residence Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you ready to join a fast-growing, dynamic, and international Private Bank in Zurich? We are looking for a dedicated and detail-oriented HR Officer to join our Zurich HR Team. In this role, you will provide essential support to the HR Manager for our Zurich, Basel, and Lugano branches, ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of all HR administrative activities. Main responsibilities:
• HR administration and lifecycle support
• Oversee complete employee lifecycle administration, covering onboardings (pre-employment screening), offboarding (final work certificates), internal transfers and lifecycle events (interim certificates, anniversaries, marriages, births, etc.)
• HR data and system management
• Maintain and update employee data ins HR systems
• Time management system
• Serve as first-line support for time and attendance queries (leave, overtime, absences) and provide guidance on policies and system use
• Monitor data quality in the time management system; follow up on discrepancies
• E-performance tool support
• Act as the primary contact for the e-performance tool; guide employees and managers on workflows, deadlines, and troubleshooting basics
• Cross-site HR collaboration (Geneva)
• Coordinate with HR colleagues in Geneva on salary administration, pension fund, insurance, and related topics; ensure timely data exchange and documentation
• Maintain trackers for shared tasks and follow through on agreed actions
• Payroll administration support
• Prepare a consolidated monthly overview of all payroll-relevant changes and submit it to the Payroll Manager
• Internal HR events and engagement coordination
• Plan and organize HR events (e.g., Nationaler Zukunftstag, Welcome Days, learning sessions) including scheduling, communications, logistics, and vendor coordination
• HR administration and records management
• Coordinate end-to -end HR document management (scan, e‑file, archive) for employees’ electronic files
• Prepare and issue standard and ad-hoc HR letters and confirmations Requirements:
• HR-Assistant diploma
• HR-Fachfrau/HR-Fachmann (eidg. Fachausweis) is a strong advantage for this role
• 2-4 years of experience in a comparable HR support role, ideally within the financial industry
• Comfortable collaborating with senior stakeholders
• Very good German and English skills (minimum C1 level) required. French proficiency and additional languages are a strong advantage
• Strong IT user skills; confident working with HR systems and MS Office/Google Workspace
• High level of independence, responsibility, and reliability; diligent and detail oriented
• Excellent organizational and time-management skills; able to prioritize and manage multiple tasks and deadlines Start: asap Location: Zurich / Due to the responsibilities in this role, working from home is not available; position is fully on-site Please note that we only accept direct applications submitted through our online tool. Applications via email or through recruitment agencies cannot be considered. We look forward to receiving your complete application (CV, motivation letter, diplomas, relevant certificates/references), including your earliest start date and salary expectations. Apply now and become part of our UBP journey!

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission As part of the Client Documentation team, the Client Documentation Specialist is a key element to ensure:
• A smooth documents process flow between the different departments of the bank, especially regarding change in circumstances
• The quality, coherence and the accuracy of the client's data in the bank's systems
• The relevance of clients' instructions by performing control signature
• An efficient support to the other departments of the bank and the branches
• Main responsibilities Day to day business
• Review the documentation received from the clients for certain change in circumstances on an existing account or an account closing and verify that it complies with the local and international regulations (e.g. CDB20, Common Reporting Standards (CRS) and FATCA/QI rules) and the Bank's directives and procedures from (i) a formal point of view (e.g. the correct version of the document is signed, all the required fields have been completed) and (ii) that the information is consistent across the documents provided by the clients (IDs, corporate documents, bank's forms, etc…)
• Verify that the information entered in the Bank's systems by the Wealth Management is complete according to the documentation signed
• Perform 4 eyes controls and regular internal controls to ensure respect of the procedures
• Ensure a good quality of service by providing accurate feedback to the Wealth Management on any error, missing document and answering in a timely manner to any query related to his/her mission and duties Coordination and central point of contact
• Build a bridge and create synergy within the Client Documentation team and other key players (Legal, Compliance, IT…), create/maintain an efficient flow of communication that ensures all remain aware of important information and that it is consistent
• Act as a business partner by bringing his/her expertise and the relevant support and input to the other departments of the bank (Wealth Management, Compliance, Legal…) when required (on a complex situation, on the implementation of new regulations or bank's decisions, new projects)
• Coordinate efforts to help a smooth flow in the processes and always seek for improvements
• Facilitate problem solving and collaboration
• Create an environment oriented to trust, open communication and cohesive team effort Projects and Change management
• Be up to date on any changes in the regulations, perform the assessment for internal changes, communicate with the relevant departments involved and to the team, implement them or launch projects, requests to IT as needed
• Participate in any project impacting the team, either required by a new regulation or initiated by the Bank, hence participate to workshops, meetings, upon the management delegation (for defining the business requirements, performing the testings, and any other required tasks)
• Involve the other team members as required
• Participate in the change management within the team by communicating proactively on the various projects and accompany the team in the change
• Make sure that the procedures and processes are updated accordingly and communicated to all stakeholders, including the Client Documentation teams within the different branches.
• Your Profile
• Education: Bachelors Degree
• Experience Technical skills: At ease with Microsoft tools, especially Excel
• Languages: English is a requirement, German/Italian or other language is a plus
• Personal skills : Client service oriented, Curiosity and good interpersonal skills
• Swiss Residence mandatory Core Competencies :
• Open mind and team orientation: Be open to other's ideas. / Balance personal & team interests. / Express opinion and criticism in a constructive way.
• Innovation and development: Seek opportunities to improve the existing. / Be a continuous learner. / Adopt change with a positive attitude.
• Professional business culture: Think in 'Problem-Action-Results' terms. / Walk the extra mile. / Be proactive and driven. / Show strong client service ethic. / Build lasting client relationships.
• Quality, internal & external regulations: Consistently comply with internal & external regulations. / Seek opportunities to improve quality in all features of the work environment.
• Analytical Ability : Ability to assimilate procedures and to implement them. / Ability to identify issues and raise them in a structured way. / Ability to make process improvements. / Attention to detail.
• Solid organization and time management skills: Ability to organize the tasks efficiently based on priorities with anticipation of events. / Reaction and decision-making ability in face of unforeseen circumstances.
• Communication: Ability to raise issues via the right channel and in a constructive way. / Ability to expose constraints and opportunities. / Express opinions and criticism in a constructive way.
• Adaptability: Ability to change, be flexible. / Maintain quality standards despite schedule pressures.
• Team Spirit : Ability to proactively help the others. / Ability to finalize the common goal.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mission As part of a team of eight, the Compliance Control specialist will help to implement the control plan, which covers all compliance-related activities. Challenges To contribute to the achievement of the Bank’s objective of maintaining a risk control framework of the highest standard. Role Description
• Review the design and effectiveness of controls in place for various compliance-related activities (financial crime, anti-money laundering, know-your-customer, sanctions, investor protection, cross-border operations, etc.)
• Lead or participate in control reviews by conducting diagnostics and carrying out detailed testing.
• Identify areas for improvement and recommend corrective actions.
• Monitor the timely implementation of recommendations and action plans.
• Work closely with Compliance, Business Risk & Controls Departments to ensure execution of controls and resolution of issues.
• Produce high quality working papers and control reports in accordance with the CCRM methodology. Your Profile Education: University Degree (Business / Law) Year of Experience: 3-7 years Skills & Requirements: Compliance, Audit, Internal control Languages: French: Fluent English: Fluent Swiss residence: Mandatory Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mission The WM Business Reporting & Analytics department focuses on data analysis and reporting, transforming large volumes of data into actionable insights to drive business decisions and success. We’re looking for a motivated Business Reporting & Analytics intern to join our team with the opportunity to work with SQL, Power BI, and analytical tools. This 6-month internship offers hands-on experience across reporting, data exploration, lightweight modeling prototypes, and data storytelling This 6 months internship offers hands-on learning and participation in impactful projects in the field of analytics and reporting. You will play a key role in supporting our reporting efforts by analyzing large datasets, developing impactful reports, and driving data-informed decision-making. This internship offers a unique opportunity for aspiring professionals to gain practical experience in data analytics and reporting, while contributing to meaningful business outcomes. Main responsibilities
• Contribute to the design and architecture of data models to improve reporting efficiency
• Write and optimize SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and analysis
• Assist in managing and analyzing large datasets to support reporting needs
• Collaborate with the team to define metrics, KPIs, and analytical requirements aligned with business goals
• Implement data quality checks (completeness, consistency, duplicates) and support data cleaning
• Support the team in ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and quality
• Develop and maintain dashboards and reports using Power-BI Your Profile
• University degree (Bachelor or Master) or a qualification considered equivalent
• SQL: basic-intermediate (joins, CTEs, aggregations, simple window functions).
• Power BI: basic-intermediate (dashboard development, data modeling, Power Query, basic DAX)
• Up to 0-2 years of experience
• Good command of MS Office
• Fluent in English and French, an additional language is an added value
• Solution oriented team player, capable of working independently
• Stress resistant, reliable, and flexible
• Eager to learn and develop new skills in an agile organization Others
• Swiss Residence Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

titleByLocale.it: Programma di laurea - Servizi di investimento

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Permanent position with a 12-months rotational program within different Investment Services teams to discover different activities, as well as build expertise and professional skills. Rotation will be arranged for the graduate within IS organization including but not limited to - Fixed Income / Equity / Funds / Private Markets research and Advisory - Investment Advisory and Discretionary Portfolio Management Services - Product Governance and management.
• During the program, under supervision of various Team Leaders / Heads as mentor , the Graduate is expected to gain exposure to the following functional areas: - Private banking investment advisory framework - Discretionary Portfolio Management Investment Process and portfolio construction. - Equity / Fixed Income / external fund manager selection process - Building blocks of investment portfolios - Product risk classification and client suitability frameworks for private banks
• At the end of all rotations, the Graduate is expected to be trained in: - Asset class knowledge - gain some understanding and application of the basic process of screening investment products for opportunities. - Portfolio Management and Construction - gain some understanding and application of the basic process of portfolio management and construction - Market profiling – support the development of marketing pitches, as well as propositions for new product. - Market Research and Analysis – continuously develop investment acumen in the context of investing for high-net-worth individuals and entities. - Product Management - gain some understanding of the Product control landscape integral to the product governance framework.
• Performing regulated activities -As part of the integration of the Graduate into the Investment Services team and his/her development to eventually specialise in at least one asset class or service, he/she is expected to take part in regulated activities conducted by the specialists, advisors and Portfolio managers across asset classes. -These activities will be conducted under the supervision of the respective team heads, and include but are not limited to: - Assisting RMs and Advisors to explain particular investment propositions in key client pitches and meetings. - Arranging of timely and regular updates of key instruments held by clients to RMs as part of the comprehensive “after- sales” advisory service. - Assisting in the development and production of investment proposals and presentations to clients and prospects - Working with Portfolio managers on portfolio construction and re-balancing. - Assisting asset class specialist in their activities pertain to research as well as preparation of research / marketing materials. - Contribute to strategic and tactical trading ideas suitable for the bank’s client base.
• Other expected tasks - Assist product specialists monitoring investment product exposure to provide necessary performance update to clients and front office teams - Perform market analysis across coverage sectors and companies in the UBP product universe and provide research communication to front office teams. - Coordinate with business management, compliance, middle office team, and other key stakeholders to ensure investment product offerings, discretionary and advisory services are in compliant with UBP policy. - Monitor client portfolios to update front office teams for any house view changes, performance alert, investment opportunities, portfolio rebalancing needs, and etc. - Participate implementation of investment campaign and global launches providing necessary marketing supports to front office teams including product training, marketing materials, order taking, client meetings, joint calls, and etc. Rationale – Why Investment Services? We are a Singapore-based team comprising of various investment teams on the Wealth Management platform that offers Clients the access to UBP’s institutional expertise. Our mission consists of leveraging the UBP local and global investment expertise to propose best in class and timely conviction-driven investment opportunities. Combining Wealth Management Specialist, discretionary and Advisory expertise, our integrated team brings consistently prudent analysis and conviction-driven, in-depth guidance to our clients. Our thought leadership is channelled through our internal and Client-friendly materials including House View, Advisory/Market updates, Macro outlook and Asset Allocation pitches. Candidates may consider applying if they are eager to contribute and develop a career as an Investment specialist (multi-asset or an individual asset class / service) who will eventually be responsible to offer investment advice, help manage portfolios and / or handle technical areas, such as the evaluation, development and implementation of Investment product strategy for our Clients and the UBP organisation. Skills
• Basic knowledge in excel VBA / at least a programming language e.g. Javascript, Python and C++, will be a plus
• Proficiency in Mandarin would be a plus

titleByLocale.fr: Événement client et contenu numérique UK

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mission We are looking for a new Events & Marketing Manager to join the Communications & Marketing team in the UK. In this role, the individual will
• Contribute to & implement UK marketing and events strategy to establish a distinctive trusted brand
• Leverage off communication and engagement channels with clients, prospects and professional introducers to increase qualified referrals
• Define content and marketing collateral for clients, prospects and business introducers to strengthen brand visibility
• Plan and organise events for clients, prospects and professional introducers
• Define event ROI tracking and follow up process
• Generate marketing-led opportunities through co creation of content and events with external partners
• Support AM in marketing initiatives and events Responsible for:
• Implement UK marketing and business development strategy across digital and traditional channels aligned to business objectives and brand positioning.
• Lead audience segmentation and value proposition development for clients, prospects, and professional introducers.
• Establish a robust measurement framework with monthly and quarterly reporting.
• Create marketing collateral (brochures, presentations, one-pagers, factsheets, pitch decks) with clear value propositions.
• Plan and execute integrated campaigns and measure content performance
• Partner with front office to qualify leads, lead routing, and SLAs; build lead-nurture workflows.
• Oversee website optimisation (UX, SEO, conversion rate optimisation), landing pages, and marketing automation journeys.
• Establish and manage communication and engagement programs for clients, prospects, and introducers (e.g., tailored newsletters, updates, co-marketing).
• Set up feedback loops and engagement forums with introducers to identify content needs and joint opportunities.
• Track and report on introducer pipeline influence, referral volumes, conversion rates, and revenue attribution.
• Help build the annual events calendar with formats, themes, budgets, and target KPIs (registrations, attendance rate, pipeline influence).
• Develop post-event follow-up and measure impact on pipeline.
• Define and track KPIs across brand, engagement, acquisition, and revenue influence Core competencies
• Solid Investment / background - Minimum of 5-10 years' relevant experience in WM/ AM
• Ability to engage with Senior executives , manage expectations, provide guidance
• Long experience with media relations – minimum of 5 years in dealing with media requests and existing network of journalists in the UK
• Proactively promote relevant content in selected media.
• Be result driven and ability to develop impactful initiatives and develop KPI’s
• Project management – The ability to articulate complex projects with different stakeholders; good experience to lead the planning, development, and execution of specific projects
• Content editing Copywriting – Excellent written communications skills; experience to write, rewrite or edit complex /investment communications with a strong command of English;
• Teamwork and Inclusion - Collaborates with other team members and contributes productively to the team's work and output. Flexible, dedicated, respectful, team-player
• Work under pressure - Ability to juggle many projects and meet deadlines in a high-energy, fast-paced environment
• Knowledge of client marketing and compliance guidelines
• Legal understanding of intellectual property issues related to brand usage In addition to the minimum responsibilities please tick any of the following responsibilities that apply to the role: [ X ] Comply with all Risk and regulatory obligations where relevant [ ] Responsibility to act within agreed risk limit (credit/market, etc...) [X ] Responsibility for ensuring that you are fully aware of and adhere to internal Policies that relate to you, your business or other businesses for which you have any level of responsibility [X ] Responsibility for reading, understanding and complying with the Company's Conduct and Standards and corresponding regulations. You will be notified of changes to policies in a timely manner through announcements and/or intranet updates Financial Conduct Authority & Prudential Regulation Authority Conduct Rules Individual Conduct Rules - All staff covered by Code of Conduct rules are reminded of their obligation to adhere fully to these codes of conduct and failure will be considered as an act of gross misconduct RULE 1 You must act with integrity RULE 2 You must act with due skill, care and diligence RULE 3 You must be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators RULE 4 You must pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly RULE 5 You must observe proper standards of market conduct RULE 6 You must act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers* * This rule applies to all staff subject to the conduct rules who carry on activity which involves a direct retail client, or end-retail client, and which is in scope of the FCA’s Consumer Duty.

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission
• Manage a high-volume, high-standard French/English switchboard (additional languages are an asset), administer the VOIP system (AGILE), and handle CFF travel arrangements.
• Join a private bank and interact with a wide range of stakeholders: various departments, VIPs, and senior executives.
• Main responsibilities
• CISCO VOIP system management:
• Handle external and internal calls with strict confidentiality and exceptional courtesy.
• Rigorously enforce security standards, particularly regarding phishing attempts and malicious calls.
• Manage call transfers and message taking using the Samwin operator console.
• Cover Executive Management calls during assistants’ breaks and absences, as well as for certain management groups.
• CFF travel management:
• Provide support and advice for domestic CFF travel.
• Process requests for international travel.
• Manage the renewal of CFF subscriptions.
• Ticketing and facilities requests:
• Administer the ticketing system for facility management requests (e.g., ventilation).
• Coordinate with relevant stakeholders, ensure follow-up, and close action items.
• Your Profile
• Experience: At least 5 years of experience in a similar role within a highly demanding environment is required Technical skills
• Languages:
• French and English must be mastered perfectly (minimum C1 level).
• Any additional language is an asset.
• Personal skills:
• Motivated, dynamic, proactive, and compassionate professional with a service mindset.
• Natural aptitude for pedagogy, able to make technical topics accessible and easy to understand.
• Active listening skills with both internal and external stakeholders.
• Strong stress management, maintaining composure in all circumstances.
• Discreet and tactful, exercising restraint and professionalism at all times.
• Team-oriented, committed to sharing knowledge, fostering collective intelligence, and learning from the surrounding experience. Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mission As Business Monitoring Officer you will manage EAM's onboarding at group level and ensure the completion of the yearly EAM control plan and keep it up to date. You will also deliver commercial, administrative and operational support to the Market Heads and the respective teams. Main responsibilities
• Performing first line of controls as per the EAM Control Plan and Management & Functional Controls framework
• Designing, implementing, and monitoring specific action plans and projects. Identifying areas for improvement in existing procedures and processes
• Ensuring relevant documentation is requested, obtained, and registered as part of the EAM on boarding
• Supporting the EAM teams on commercial, administrative, and operational day to day or exceptional requests
• Continuously improving and automating activity
• Delivering any other task required by Management relating to the Mission of the employee Your profile
• Degree in a related field (banking apprenticeship, CYP, banking internship or similar)
• Minimum 3 year in control tasks in a Swiss Banking environment
• Proficiency in Compliance and Regulatory matters surrounding External Asset Management
• Fluent in French and English. Any additional language is a plus
• High proficiency in MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, MS Power BI, SQL language, MS Power Query, SAP Business
• Ability to embrace a strategic vision and translate it in simple, pragmatic, and feasible solutions
• Strong analytical, naturally well-organized, and curious mindset with excellent research skills
• Assertive, open, and constructive communication, both written and verbal
• An open, flexible, and confident team-player who can quickly adapt to new challenges
• Self-disciplined, goal-oriented, having a "Problem-Action-Results" approach
• Openness to new ideas and be force of proposition Others
• Swiss Residence Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mission Your primary mission is to calculate retrocessions (commissions) payable to External Asset Managers (EAMs) and business introducers across the Group. Main responsibilities
• Receive, digitize, and file contracts.
• Enter base data into the dedicated commission system.
• Control and correct source data used in commission calculations.
• Verify calculations, including VAT computation.
• Interact with and respond to questions from Group Accounting, the EAM department, and Relationship Managers.
• Verify provisions related to retrocessions.
• Run simulation scenarios for retrocession calculations for new contracts.
• Enter and validate non-full-STP (non-automated) retrocession domains.
• Produce various reports (statistics, accounting entries creation, supporting documents dispatch). General competencies
• Consistently comply with internal and external regulations.
• Seek opportunities to improve the quality of the working environment at all levels.
• Maintain quality standards while meeting deadlines. Your Profile
• 5+ years’ experience desired in accounting or administration.
• Precision, flexibility, rigor, adaptability, strong sense of responsibility and service, stress resilience, and ability to meet deadlines.
• Strong organizational skills and discretion.
• Good command of standard office tools (Excel, Word; Business Objects is a plus). Knowledge of the
• Quartal Commission system is a strong advantage. Languages Native French or bilingual level; very good command of English (spoken and written). Personal skills
• Open and transparent communication.
• Critical thinking.
• Strong capacity for innovation (open to new ideas and continuous improvements).
• Firm and mature approach in challenging situations. Others
• Familiarity with commission processes and VAT rules in a financial institution is an asset.
• Comfort working with partial or non-automated workflows and validating edge cases. Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mission The Investment Advisor is responsible for delivering tailored investment advice and portfolio strategies to high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth individuals. Working closely with Relationship Managers (RMs), the IA ensures client receive comprehensive, risk-appropriate investment solutions aligned with their goals, profile, and the Bank’s values. Main responsibilities
• Provide customized investment advice based on client objectives, risk appetite and market conditions
• Construct and optimize investment portfolios using a broad range of asset classes
• Present investment strategies clearly and transparently, including expected returns, risks and associated costs
• Conduct regular portfolio reviews and rebalancing recommendations
• Act as the trusted investment contact for existing clients, in partnership with RMs
• Support in deepening client relationships and enhancing retention through proactive investment insight and performance monitoring
• Assist in client meetings, prepare proposals and contribute to the acquisition and onboarding of new clients as well as for business retention
• Stay abreast of macroeconomic trends, financial markets and geopolitical developments
• Work closely with internal teams to align with the Bank’s investment strategy and core values
• Promote and explain investment products to RMs and relevant target advisory client groups
• Ensure full compliance with Swiss regulatory frameworks Your Profile
• University degree in Finance, economics or related field, or a qualification considered equivalent
• CFA, CIIA, CWMA or similar certification is a strong asset
• Strong knowledge of investment products and ability to execute trades for equities, derivatives, fixed income, bonds, warrants and mutual funds
• Min 5 years of experience in a similar position in Private Banking or a Financial Institution
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, client focus, reliability, flexibility and stress resistant
• Good command of MS Office suite, portfolio analysis tools and banking software
• Perfectly fluent in French and English. Very good knowledge of Russian and any additional language skill would be an added value.
• Adaptability to work in an agile organization Others
• Swiss Residence Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission
• Support the Group Head of Sanctions & Corporate due diligence in the development and implementation of a strong control framework for corporate & shipping accounts.
• Participate in projects and initiatives aimed at enhancing the bank's overall sanctions framework.
• Assist Group Sanctions and Corporate due diligence teams in their daily tasks (due diligence on new and existing clients, ad-hoc reviews and monitoring of specific transactions).
• Main responsibilities
• Participate actively to Bank’s projects related to the global sanctions’ framework.
• Perform in-depth reviews of commercial accounts from an AML, Tax and Sanction perspective.
• Ensure compliance with international sanctions programs at UBP Group level by preparing work instructions/ guidance, ensuring and developing suitable tools and processes.
• Perform periodic assessments of specific Group clients, products and/or services to identify any sanctions risks and take corrective actions if appropriate.
• Ensure the Sanction’s watch including mainly SECO, EU and OFAC regimes for UBP Group.
• Assess the impacts of new sanctions regimes across UBP Group and coordinate with other departments/ stakeholders as required.
• Assist and advice transaction monitoring teams for any question related to sanctions and commercial accounts.
• Participate to maintenance and configuration projects/initiatives of Group sanctions tools.
• Investigate and report suspicious transactions to the relevant authorities, ensuring compliance with AML (Anti-Money Laundering) and sanctions regulations.
• Provide day-to-day advice to colleagues in Compliance, BRMs and Front Office on the internal framework related to commercial accounts.
• Participation in reviewing the internal regulatory framework governing the monitoring of transactional activities of commercial accounts.
• Support the Group’s entities in reviewing commercial accounts opened in their books.
• Your Profile
• Master's degree.
• Professional certifications such as CAMS (Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist/Sanctions Specialist) or CAS in Financial Services are preferred.
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in AML, Sanctions, Tax or compliance within the financial services industry, ideally in universal banks.
• Strong knowledge of regulatory requirements related to AML & Sanctions, including specificities linked to shipping and trade finance industries.
• Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail.
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex regulatory issues to various stakeholders.
• Work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

Job description Head of Internal Audit, UBP UK NAME: CORPORATE JOB TITLE: Head of Internal Audit, London CORPORATE TITLE: TBC REPORTS TO: CEO, UBP UK & Group Head of Internal Audit & Head of the Audit Committee (Member of the Board of Directors) SENIOR MANAGEMENT FUNCTION (YES/NO): Yes PRESCRIBED RESPONSBILITY: SMF 5 MATERIAL RISK TAKER (YES/NO): Yes CERTIFIED (YES/NO): No CERTIFIED FUNCTIONS: LAST UPDATED: March 2026 Main Responsibilities This role will hold overall responsibility for Internal Audit across the UBP UK, providing risk-based objective assurance, advice and insight. UBP Internal Audit follows the standards of the profession, as well as the regulatory requirements and UBP Group policies and procedures. The Head of Internal Audit is responsible for independent and objective audits reviews of all UBP UK activities, aiming at providing the Group with assurance as to how effectively it is controlling its operations, advises on improvements. The role also assesses the quality of risk management within an audited scope, the appropriateness and effectiveness of the permanent control framework, the risk sensitivity of management and compliance with codes of conduct and expected professional practices. Role Duties
• The Head of Audit is responsible for managing, planning, and administering the internal audit function in the UK, Channel Islands and Gibraltar regions for all activities of UBP UK.
• Plan, supervise and take part in audits across all activities of UBP UK including financial, regulatory, compliance, operational audits as needed.
• Develop and maintain good relationships with the head and key management personnel of all activity pillars across UBP UK.
• Make recommendations for organisational and internal controls improvements of UBP UK.
• Prepare Audit reports, and summaries of findings and audit reports and recommendations to the Group Audit department, as well as key management stakeholders of UBP UK.
• Follow-up of Audit Recommendations until their implementation.
• Make recommendations for improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the audit process.
• Managing and engaging with various stakeholders across all departments of UBP UK at a senior level.
• Liaise with external auditors and regulators. The job description is not exhaustive and may include other duties as assigned from time to time by management. Management and Supervision
• Current line management responsibility for one Internal Audit Manager.
• Set goals and objectives for all staff under direct supervision, complete performance appraisals and arrange appraisal interviews and ensure that the UBP UK guidelines are appropriately updated and communicated to staff. Statements of Responsibility Prescribed Responsibilities and Local Responsibilities for the Head of Internal Audit are set out in the Statements of Responsibility which is maintained as a separate document. Conduct Rules This role is required to comply with the Financial Conduct Authority’s (FCA) Individual Conduct Rules, which are:
• To act with integrity;
• To act with due skill, care and diligence;
• To be open and cooperative with the FCA, the Prudential Regulation Authoritity (PRA) and other regulators;
• To pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly;
• To observe proper standards of market conduct; and
• To act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers. In addition, this role must also comply with the Senior Manager Conduct Rules, which are:
• To take reasonable steps to ensure that the business of the firm for which you are responsible is controlled effectively.
• To take reasonable steps to ensure that the business of the firm for which you are responsible complies with the relevant requirements and standards of the regulatory system.
• To take reasonable steps to ensure that any delegation of your responsibilities is to an appropriate person and that you oversee the discharge of the delegated responsibility effectively.
• To disclose appropriately any information of which the FCA or PRA would reasonably expect notice. Person Specification Knowledge, Skills & Experience Qualifications
• Qualifications: Professional Audit/Accounting qualification or Degree is preferred (ACA, ACCA, CIA, etc.)
• Good knowledge of accounting principles and professional audit standards.
• Solid experience at a Head of Internal Audit or Senior Audit Manager level with an audit firm or a financial institution.
• Working experience in both wealth management (essential) and asset management industries (preferred).
• Experience managing audits across a broad range of activities, including financial, compliance, regulatory, operational, systems, etc.
• Able to influence senior stakeholders whilst maintaining objectivity and independence
• Written skills for preparing and delivering quality audit reports, as well as strong relationship building and communication skills to ensure the best outcome.
• Knowledge of UK banking legislation, regulations and rules (PRA/FCA)
• Excellent communicator and able to build relationships with internal and external stakeholders including regulators
• Ability to influence senior stakeholders
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex situations and make sound decisions.
• Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing compliance policies, and procedures.
• On-going CPD (Continuous Professional Development) to ensure that adequate knowledge of the UK regulatory environment is maintained.
• Suitably qualified to hold SMF 5. Competencies and Values Required Level Shows the drive to perform and be successful 5 Persistent in following-up and through on issues 5 Upholds the legal, regulatory and ethical standard of the UBP Group 5 Good product knowledge 4 Knowledge of legal regulatory and industry requirements 5 Business Development 3 Communication - listening, written and verbal with clients 5 Influencing 5 Relationship Building - internal and external 5 Strategic & commercial awareness 4 Planning & organising 4 Ethics and values 5 Customer focus 5 Explanation: 1: low level of competence / skill required, 2-3: average level of competence / skill required, 4-5: high level of competence skill required

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission We are seeking an experienced Fixed Income Execution Trader to join our team in Geneva. For this full-time position, a solid background in bond markets, advanced execution skills and the ability to perform in a fast-paced environment is requested. Individual’s role will focus on day-to-day execution of fixed income orders in primary and secondary markets, optimizing execution strategies, and contributing to the automation of order workflows. The candidate is expected to be learning and supporting execution in other asset classes and take part to late shift coverage for US markets (up to 22:00).
• Main responsibilities
• Efficient and accurate trade execution (voice and electronic) in secondary markets (Credit IG and HY, Rates, Emerging Markets, Money Markets).
• Oversee full bookbuilding processes in primary markets (publish new issues, collect subscriptions, distribute allocations)
• Play an integral part of a ‘value added’ basis to investment process by leveraging market knowledge and counterparty contacts to improve performance and influence outcomes
• Monitor and share market news and liquidity conditions with Wealth Management teams and build trust-based internal relationships
• Develop and maintain strong, transparent and constructive relationships with brokers and counterparties to obtain the best service for the bank’s clients
• Run and optimize electronic execution and RFQs via Bloomberg (e.g., IB/TSOX), MarketAxess, and Tradeweb
• Develop and implement Fixed Income execution strategies to optimize trading performance and client outcomes
• Contribute to the automation of bond order workflows and the integration of trading technologies
• Late-shift coverage (up to 22:00): mandatory multi-asset execution across Fixed Income, Equities, and ETDs
• Ensure strict compliance with internal policies and external regulatory requirements (e.g., best execution, record-keeping)
• Your Profile
• Experience : Minimum of 5 years trading experience in Fixed Income primary and secondary markets with a proven track record
• Product Knowledge : Deep understanding of Fixed Income products and market structure, liquidity dynamics, RFQ protocols, and new issue processes
• Trading Venues and Platforms : Hands-on experience executing via Bloomberg (IB/TSOX), MarketAxess, and Tradeweb; extensive use of InvestorAccess and DirectBooks for new issues
• Execution Skills: Strong voice trading and e-trading capabilities; familiarity with auto-routing, dealer selection, and best-ex filters.
• Languages: Fluency in English and French is a prerequisite.
• Technology: Advanced Excel; VBA and/or Python are a strong advantage, particularly for automating bond workflows and reporting.
• Versatility: Willingness to learn and execute another asset class as needed; ability to switch between tools and processes.
• Stress Management: Ability to perform under pressure in a high-stakes, fast-paced environment.
• Attention to Detail: Exceptional accuracy in execution, allocations, and post-trade reporting.
• Passion for Markets: Genuine enthusiasm for Fixed Income and trading innovation.
• Core Competencies
• Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility.
• Strong commitment to compliance with regulations and internal directives.
• Proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and team collaboration.
• Others
• Swiss Residence is required

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission As part of the Tax Services team, the Tax Specialist is a key element to ensure the quality and accuracy of the reporting done by the Bank, as a regulatory obligation, in an environment which is subject to constant changes and evolutions. Within the Daily Regulatory Reporting team, the employee’s mission also includes constant monitoring and reconciliation of the data to be reported. The tax and regulatory topics include MIFID II/ EMIR / FMIA / FINFRAG / Duty to disclose.
• Main responsibilities
• Daily monitoring and control of regulatory reporting (MIFID II / EMIR / FMIA / FINFRAG) sent to the reporting platform(s) (i.e. locals regulators)
• Monthly reconciliations, quality control and statistics of the data reported
• Manage inquiries and investigate questions and issues about the taxes or regulatory reporting from other departments of the Bank or from external counterparties
• Understand regulatory risk sensitivity and has an end-to-end view of the Bank’s flow/process
• Correction of consistency issues, update reporting tool’s database
• Liaising and coordinating with the department responsible for the underlying data for the necessary corrections, explanations, data input and resubmission of the corrected report(s)
• Communication with the reporting engine providers (ARM, APA, TR)
• Performing regular and ad-hoc reporting related to statistics for internal and external parties
• Contribute to all testing linked to regulatory and reporting updates
• Active participation in EMIR/MIFID/DTD projects (Audit inquiries, Provider specifications changes & Regulator inquiries) including data mining and in-depth investigation
• Open mind and team orientation: Be open to other’s ideas. Express and accept constructive criticism.
• Innovation and development: Propose and seek improvement of the current tools and processes. Be positive towards change and seek opportunities to improve the quality of the working environment. Conitunuously work on knowledge improvement.
• Corporate culture: Be ‘solution oriented’ and have a strong sense of customer services. Be proactive and driven. Developp and maintain a relationship network within the various Bank departments. Comply consistently with internal and external regulations.
• Your Profile
• Good knowledge of the financial products and associated transactions
• 3-5 years of experience in banking or financial services
• Project management experience
• Strong Excel, Access skills
• Strong analytical skills, able to make complex data reconciliation
• Ability to efficiently manage priorities
• Be able to work independently but also as a team
• Seek opportunities to improve the existing set-up
• Go beyond specific assignments, walk the extra mile
• Consistently comply with internal & external regulations
• Maintain quality standards despite schedule pressures
• Fluent in French and English
• Others
• Swiss Residence Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

Mission Based in our main office in Geneva, you will join the Global Service Desk team, providing first-line support to approximately 3,000 Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) colleagues worldwide. Main responsibilities
• Answer to the Global Service Desk phone line for all UBP users worldwide.
• Manage emails sent to Global Service Desk.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mission Assist the relationship manager(s) in opening new relationships and serving clients, in compliance with the Bank’s internal regulations and guidelines within the Eastern Europe region. Main responsibilities
• Prepare the necessary documentation for client meetings and business trips for relationship managers
• Execute and monitor stock exchange orders, forex transactions, fiduciary relationships, loans, payment orders and credit card applications
• Provide administrative support to the Team Head
• Cash Management
• Assist in AML clarifications and prepare clients KYC and related updates with direct line contact
• Direct interaction with clients by phone, e-mail and, occasionally in meetings
• Prepare and monitor account openings, closings and mutations
• Maintain records in compliance with internal and external regulation (for example: portfolio reviews, AML, KYC, etc.)
• Perform other administrative tasks as needed (for example: preparing presentations, travel arrangements, helping clients with any requests, banking and non-banking, etc.)
• Deputy of other assistants if needed Your Profile
• Degree in a related field (banking apprenticeship, CYP, banking internship or similar)
• Private Banking certificate, CWMA or other equivalent certification a plus
• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar role in a Private Bank
• Strong banking and KYC knowledge
• Strong team spirit, inter-personal skills, open-minded, highly service and client oriented as well as excellent communication skills
• Fluent in French and English. Russian would be a strong added value Others
• Swiss Residence mandatory Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mission Through the Asset Management division, we offer to institutional clients’ investment management capabilities organised across the business lines Long-Only Platform, Alternative Investment Solutions, Private Markets Group, Partnerships, Asset Allocation & DPM. The Institutional Client Service Team serves as the primary contact for large and complex institutional clients globally, supporting sales teams in engaging institutional and wholesale clients. The team plays a vital role in enhancing profitability and driving growth within the Asset Management business. We are seeking a dynamic candidate with a strong interest in Asset Management to join the Institutional Client Service team in Frankfurt . This role involves close collaboration with the German sales team, reporting locally to the Head of Wholesale EMEA and centrally to the COO - Institutional Clients & Head of the Client Service Team. The position covers activities with both institutional and wholesale clients in the DACH region (Germany, German-speaking Switzerland, and Austria) This position is for 12 months, but it may be renewed or offer other opportunities. Main responsibilities
• Assist Asset Management Sales teams in supporting German-speaking client-base.
• Manage, execute, and follow up on client requests and inquiries.
• Collaborate with internal teams throughout the client lifecycle to ensure client satisfaction and retention.
• Coordinate the onboarding process and oversee the end-to-end transition.
• Involve in the implementation and monitoring of the local sales strategy.
• Support the team in their prospecting initiatives, including the preparation of marketing materials and conducting market research.
• Contribute to the optimization of processes through the application of AI technologies.
• Act as the local CRM champion, supporting and training the sales team to meet Salesforce requirements and ensure data accuracy.
• Organise local events and roadshows.
• Perform office management tasks. Your Profile
• Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, or a related field is beneficial.
• Excellent organizational skills and capability to work independently.
• Accuracy and attention to detail.
• Advanced skills in standard IT applications (MS Office).
• Mother tongue German and fluency in English is a “MUST”; French is a “nice to have”. Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is a family-owned company, driven by an entrepreneurial vision, innovation and independence. UBP is one of the most strongly-capitalised private banks. By joining UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A. you will embrace a team of supportive high qualified professionals in Private Banking that will lead you to develop your career to the top level. We encourage continuous learning, development and knowledge sharing. We foster a culture of Agility, Conviction, Dedication and high degree of Responsibility. UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A encourages all suitable qualified and eligible candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity or expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation, disability or neurodiversity. In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, retained candidate will be required to provide an extract from their criminal record as a part of UBP screening process.
