descriptionByLocale.it: Job Description This unique 12-month graduate program is based in London and offers a permanent contract. The exceptional opportunity for a recent master’s graduate is designed to provide in-depth, practical exposure to various areas of the business within a renowned Private Bank. Created as a comprehensive learning experience, enabling you to gain valuable insights into the finance industry and develop essential skills for a successful career in private banking. The program is structured around two rotations of 6 months – in the CSO (Client Strategy Office) team and Banker’s support as Assistant Relationship Manager – after which the candidate will join the bank on a permanent basis. This program is specifically focused on young graduates holding a master’s degree, with a maximum of 12 months of professional experience since graduation. Upon successful completion, you will have the opportunity to transition into a permanent role within one of the team, continuing your career with the bank and applying the knowledge, networks, and experience gained during the programme in a role aligned to your strengths and interests. Role Description: The role will have a broad remit: • In the CSO team the successful candidate will report to the Head of Client Strategy Office and will get exposure to Wealth Management Teams: You will work on • Sales & Performance: Build KPIs/dashboards, track banker metrics, manage pipeline, support budgeting, and prepare senior management materials. • Pricing & Strategy: Support on the pricing tool, ensure profitability, and provide insights; partner with Team leaders on client targeting and campaigns. • Project Management: Lead commercial initiatives, close audit points, ensure regulatory compliance, develop front-office tools, and track actions vs. the strategic plan. • As part of the ARMs team, the successful candidate will gain exposure to the full client relationship cycle. You will be working with the relationship managers on: • Clients: Maintain relationships; be backup for RM; prep/run follow-ups. • Execution: Own cash management; execute/settle FX, cash, equities, FI. • Onboarding/Compliance: Open accounts end-to-end; deliver KYC/AML and reviews. • Credit: Prepare/administer loan and credit requests. • Growth: Spot cross-sell opportunities; support RM revenue. • Improvement: Streamline processes; keep product/market knowledge current. Requirements: • Educational Background: Recent graduate ( master’s degree) in Finance, Business, Marketing, Media and PR, Economics or Engineering from a highly recognised university. • Work Experience : Relevant initial work experience in the finance industry (internship) is an advantage but not mandatory. • Technical Skills: Strong knowledge of MS Office tools – Excel, Word, Power Point. • Language Proficiency: Fluency in English is required. • Key Skills: • Excellent verbal and written communication skills • Ability to engage and collaborate with people from different business areas • Strong analytical and data skills- comfortable working with data and numbers • Strong problem-solving skills, results-driven attitude, proactive mindset • Structured approach • You have a natural passion to deliver great client outcomes • Strong business development aptitude with the ability to spot opportunities for business growth through existing client circumstances ; • Work Authorization: Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK at the time of application. We do not offer sponsorship. **** Applications Process: We only accept online applications submitted through our official website. Ensure that your application includes the following documents: -CV -Motivation Letter -Grade Transcript & Diplomas -Reference Letters Key Dates: ■ Programme start date: 1st September 2026 ■ Duration of programme: 12 months (permanent contract) ■ Interviews Period: March to June 2026

descriptionByLocale.it: Missione ### Reception – Reception – Accoglienza calda e professionale per gli ospiti internazionali; servizio di portineria - Coordinamento con i dipendenti visitati; gestione del servizio bevande nelle sale/sale riunioni - Garantire la pulizia e la sicurezza delle persone e dei beni; far rispettare le procedure (sicurezza fisica, allarmi, controllo degli accessi) - Informare e consigliare i clienti; rispondere alle richieste del personale interno - Eventi di supporto (banchetti, cocktail) # ## Gestione delle sale - Mantenere aggiornata la documentazione; gestire gli orari delle prenotazioni e le presenze - Fornire supporto amministrativo/logistico (copie, taxi, prenotazioni, documentazione, IT/tecnologia) - Mantenere una pulizia impeccabile delle sale tra una visita e l'altra ## # Supporto logistico - Distribuire posta per piano e programma; consegnare attrezzature e materiali di consumo - Gestire l'inventario; ispezionare continuamente i locali e avvisare Logistica/Sicurezza/IT secondo necessità # ## Sicurezza – Riservatezza – Gestire le informazioni riservate secondo la politica interna - Completare e applicare la formazione sulla sicurezza bancaria (minacce, aggressioni, incendi, primo soccorso) - Informare immediatamente le reception/Sicurezza degli incidenti - Applicare tutte le procedure per l'apertura/chiusura e l'accesso all'edificio # ## Principali responsabilità - Partecipare alla copertura inter-edificio e alle rotazioni del sito - Soddisfare gli obiettivi di qualità del dipartimento; risolvere rapidamente i problemi in sospeso - Proporre e implementare miglioramenti; mantenere un ambiente professionale - Seguire le procedure e le direttive delle risorse umane - Aumentare in modo proattivo i casi urgenti/ad alto rischio/non di routine - Possedere formazione continua e permanenza
descriptionByLocale.en: • Mission Reception – Front Desk • Warm, professional welcome for international guests; concierge-level service. • Coordinate with visited employees; manage beverage service in lounges/meeting rooms. • Ensure cleanliness, safety of people and property; enforce procedures (physical security, alarms, access control). • Inform and advise clients; respond to internal staff requests. • Support events (banquets, cocktails). Lounge Management • Keep documentation current; manage reservation schedules and attendance. • Provide admin/logistics support (copies, taxis, bookings, documentation, IT/tech). • Maintain impeccable lounge cleanliness between visits. Logistical Support • Distribute mail by floor and schedule; deliver equipment and consumables. • Manage inventory; continuously inspect premises and alert Logistics/Security/IT as needed. Security – Confidentiality • Handle confidential information per internal policy. • Complete and apply bank security training (threats, aggression, fire, first aid). • Immediately inform receptions/Security of incidents. • Apply all procedures for opening/closing and building access. Main Responsibilities • Participate in inter-building coverage and site rotations. • Meet departmental quality targets; resolve pending issues swiftly. • Propose and implement improvements; maintain a professional environment. • Follow procedures and HR directives. • Proactively escalate urgent/high-risk/non-routine cases. • Own continuous training and stay current technically/organizationally. • Perform additional tasks essential to bank operations as assigned. • Act with discretion and tact in public areas. Your Profile • French and English: perfectly fluent. • Experience: 5+ years in reception or hospitality; immediate availability. • Personal skills: advanced service mindset, needs analysis, teamwork, strong interpersonal skills. • Core competencies: adherence to values (Dedication, Conviction, Agility, Responsibility); compliance with regulations and internal directives.
descriptionByLocale.de: Mission ### Rezeption – Warmer, professioneller Empfang für internationale Gäste; Concierge-Service - Koordination mit besuchten Mitarbeitern; Verwaltung des Getränkeservice in Lounges/Besprechungsräumen - Sauberkeit, Sicherheit von Personen und Eigentum gewährleisten; Verfahren (physische Sicherheit, Alarme, Zugangskontrolle) durchsetzen - Kunden informieren und beraten; auf interne Personalanfragen reagieren - Support-Events (Bankette, Cocktails) # ## Lounge-Management - Dokumentation aktuell halten; Reservierungspläne und Anwesenheit verwalten - Admin-/Logistikunterstützung (Kopien, Taxis, Buchungen, Dokumentation, IT/Tech) bereitstellen - Einwandfreie Sauberkeit der Lounge zwischen den Besuchen aufrechterhalten ### Logistische Unterstützung - Verteilen Etage und Zeitplan; Lieferung von Geräten und Verbrauchsmaterialien - Verwaltung des Inventars; kontinuierliche Inspektion der Räumlichkeiten und Alarmierung der Logistik/Sicherheit/IT nach Bedarf ## # Sicherheit – Vertraulichkeit - Umgang mit vertraulichen Informationen gemäß interner Richtlinie - Abschluss und Anwendung von Banksicherheitstrainings (Bedrohungen, Aggression, Feuer, Erste Hilfe) - Sofortige Information der Empfänge/Sicherheit von Vorfällen - Anwendung aller Verfahren für das Öffnen/Schließen und den Gebäudezugang ## # Hauptverantwortlichkeiten - Teilnahme an Gebäudeabdeckungen und Standortrotationen - Erfüllung der Qualitätsziele der Abteilung; rasche Lösung ausstehender Probleme - Vorschlag und Umsetzung von Verbesserungen; Aufrechterhaltung eines professionellen Umfelds - Befolgen von Verfahren und HR-Richtlinien - Proaktive Eskalation dringender/risikoreicher/nicht routinemäßiger Fälle - Eigene Weiterbildung und Aufenthalt
descriptionByLocale.fr: Mission ### Réception – Front Desk - Accueil professionnel chaleureux pour les invités internationaux; service de conciergerie - Coordination avec les employés visités; gestion du service de boissons dans les salons/salles de réunion - Assurer la propreté, la sécurité des personnes et des biens; faire respecter les procédures (sécurité physique, alarmes, contrôle d'accès) - Informer et conseiller les clients; répondre aux demandes du personnel interne - Événements de soutien (banques, cocktails) ### Gestion des salons - tenir la documentation à jour; gérer les horaires de réservation et la présence - fournir un soutien administratif/logistique (copies, taxis, réservations, documentation, TI/technologie) - maintenir une propreté impeccable des salons entre les visites #### Soutien logistique - distribuer le courrier par étage et calendrier; livrer du matériel et des consommables - gérer l'inventaire; inspecter en permanence les locaux et les alertes Logistique/Sécurité/TI au besoin ## Sécurité - gérer les besoins confidentiels par politique interne - remplir et appliquer la formation en matière de sécurité bancaire (menaces, agression, incendie, premiers soins) - informer immédiatement les réceptions/Sécurité des incidents - appliquer toutes les compétences pour l'ouvrir/ferme

descriptionByLocale.it: Missione Nell'ambito del team Tax Services, il Tax and Documentation Specialist è un elemento chiave per garantire la qualità e l'accuratezza della segnalazione degli Stati Uniti e del CRS effettuata dalla Banca, in un ambiente soggetto a costanti cambiamenti ed evoluzioni. La missione del dipendente comprende anche le indagini e seguire le richieste di revisori interni/esterni, autorità e responsabili delle relazioni. ## Mansioni principato - Partecipa alla preparazione e alla validazione dei dati per report come FATCA/CRS - QI/FATCA/CRS Controllo qualità dei dati, Riconciliazione e Reporting - Gestire la documentazione e indicia Dashboard per il WM. Fornire supporto, monitoraggio e miglioramenti IT richiesti. - Rispondere alle richieste in relazione alle imposte di mantenimento, tra cui QI/FATCA e CRS - Fornire supporto all'ufficio anteriore su QI/FATCA e CRS - Eseguire controlli regolari sulle transazioni e la codificazione nei nostri sistemi per garantire che l'imposta sia correttamente levied e segnalato. - Monitoraggio e controllo della documentazione dei clienti FATCA/CRS e cambiamento delle circostanze - Seguire le richieste di revisori interni/esterni, autorità ## Competenze chiave ## Skills & Abilities: - Buona conoscenza dei prodotti finanziari e delle transazioni associate - Conoscenza delle regole di reporting degli Stati Uniti e del CRS (opzionale) - 1-3 anni di esperienza nel team di Operazione fiscale o equivalente - Forte competenze analitiche, in grado di rendere complessa riconciliazione dei dati - Capacità Essere in grado di lavorare in modo indipendente ma anche come squadra - fluente in francese e inglese ## Apri la mente e l'orientamento di squadra: - Sii aperto alle idee altrui. - No. Sempre bilanciare gli interessi personali e di squadra tenendo presente che l’interesse della Banca è la priorità. - Esprimere e accettare critiche costruttive. ### Innovazione e sviluppo: - Proporre e cercare il miglioramento degli strumenti e dei processi attuali. - Siate positivi verso il cambiamento e cercate opportunità per migliorare la qualità dell'ambiente di lavoro. - Lavorare costantemente al miglioramento della conoscenza. #### Cultura aziendale: - Essere orientata alla soluzione e avere un forte senso dei servizi del cliente. - Sii proattivo e guidato. - Sviluppare e mantenere una rete di relazioni all'interno dei vari dipartimenti bancari. - Complessivamente con normative interne ed esterne.
descriptionByLocale.en: Mission As part of the Tax Services team, the Tax and Documentation Specialist is a key element to ensure the quality and accuracy of the US and CRS reporting done by the Bank, in an environment which is subject to constant changes and evolutions. The employee’s mission also includes investigation and follow up on requests from internal/external auditors, authorities and Relationship managers. Main duties • Participate in the Data preparation and validation for reportings such as FATCA/CRS • QI/FATCA/CRS Data quality control, Reconciliation and Reporting • Manage the documentation and indicia Dashboard for the WM. Provide relevant support, monitoring and required IT improvements. • Answer inquiries in relation to withholding taxes including QI/FATCA and CRS • Provide support to the front office about QI/FATCA and CRS • Perform regular controls on transactions and codification in our systems to ensure that the tax is properly levied and reported. • Monitoring and control of FATCA/CRS client documentation and change in circumstances • Follow up on requests from internal/external auditors, authorities Core competencies Skills & Abilities: • Good knowledge of the financial products and associated transactions • Knowledge of US and CRS reporting rules (Optional) • 1-3 years of experience in Tax Operation team or equivalent • Strong analytical skills, able to make complex data reconciliation • Ability to efficiently manage priorities • Be able to work independently but also as a team • Fluent in French and English Open mind and team orientation: • Be open to other’s ideas. • Always balance personal and team interests keeping in mind that the Bank’s interest are the priority. • Express and accept constructive criticism. Innovation and development: • Propose and seek improvement of the current tools and processes. • Be positive towards change and seek opportunities to improve the quality of the working environment. • Conitunuously work on knowledge improvement. Corporate culture: • Be ‘solution oriented’ and have a strong sense of customer services. • Be proactive and driven. • Developp and maintain a relationship network within the various Bank departments. • Comply consistently with internal and external regulations.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Missione Dans le cadre de l'équipe des Services fiscaux, le spécialiste de l'impôt et de la documentation est un élément clé pour assurer la qualité et l'exactitude des rapports des États-Unis et du CS Ex effectués par la Banque, dans un environnement qui est soumis à des changements et des évolutions constants. La mission de l'employé comprend également les enquêtes et le suivi des demandes des vérificateurs internes et externes, des autorités et des gestionnaires des relations. ## Mansioni principali - Participer à la préparation et à la validation des données pour les rapports tels que FATCA/CRS - QI/FATCA/CRS Contrôle de la qualité des données, rapprochement et rapports - Gérer la documentation et le tableau de bord Indicia pour le WM. Toujours équilibrer les intérêts personnels et d'équipe en gardant à l'esprit que les intérêts de la Banque sont la priorité. - Exprimer et accepter des critiques constructives. ### Innovation et développement: - Proposer et chercher à améliorer les outils et les processus actuels. - Soyez positif envers le changement et cherchez des occasions d'améliorer la qualité de l'environnement de travail. - Travailler ensemble à l'amélioration des connaissances. ### Culture d'entreprise: - Être orienté vers la solution et avoir un fort sens des services à la clientèle. - Soyez proactif et motivé. - Développer et maintenir un réseau de relations au sein des différents services de la Banque. - Respecter les règlements internes et externes.

descriptionByLocale.en: Mission We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Tax Specialist to join our Client Documentation and Tax Services Department. As part of the Fiscal Reporting team, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy and quality of our clients’ tax statements, while collaborating with various departments and external providers. This is a unique opportunity to grow in a fast-paced, stimulating environment and contribute to impactful projects across the bank. Main Responsibilities Tax Statement Review & Validation - Review and validate tax statements for over 20 international jurisdictions, including Switzerland, France, Portugal, Mexico, and others. - Ensure that tax documents comply with local and international regulations before being sent to clients. Data Quality Assurance - Collaborate with our external provider to ensure the quality and accuracy of tax data before statement production. - Identify and correct anomalies or inconsistencies in the data to ensure reliable reporting. Client Support & Front Office Interaction - Address inquiries and requests from the Front Office regarding tax statements, providing clear and precise explanations. - Manage tax document orders in coordination with internal teams and external providers. Cross-Functional Collaboration - Work closely with Compliance, Operations, Front Office, and IT teams to ensure smooth management of tax processes. - Actively participate in cross-functional projects involving process improvements, regulatory updates, or strategic initiatives. Project Management - Contribute to side projects related to tax data, information systems, and operational processes. - Participate in the continuous improvement of tools and processes in collaboration with IT and other departments. Regulatory Compliance & Reporting - Stay updated on tax regulatory changes across the covered jurisdictions. - Prepare detailed reports and maintain comprehensive documentation to meet audit and regulatory requirements. Key Skills & Qualifications • Tax Expertise : In-depth knowledge of international tax regulations. • Analytical Skills : Ability to analyze complex data and identify anomalies. • Client Orientation : Excellent communication skills to address Front Office and client inquiries. • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Experience working with multidisciplinary teams (Compliance, IT, Operations, etc.). • Project Management : Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines. What We're Looking For • Experience : Minimum 2 years in banking, with a focus on tax services. • Skills : Strong knowledge of financial instruments (Equities, Bonds, Structured Products, Derivatives – Listed or OTC) and their specific characteristics. Familiarity with European income and gains taxation is a plus. Proficiency in Microsoft Office is essential. • Languages : Fluency in French and English is required; German, Italian, Spanish, or Portuguese is a plus. • Mindset : Proactive, solution-oriented, and eager to learn. Strong problem-solving skills, ability to work quickly and efficiently, and a team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment. Why Join Us? • Be part of a collaborative and innovative team. • Work in a challenging yet rewarding environment. • Develop your expertise and grow your career in a leading financial institution. If you’re ready to take on this exciting challenge and make a long-term impact, we’d love to hear from you!

descriptionByLocale.it: MISSION E MAIN RESPONSABILITÀ: Il ruolo generale del monitoraggio e del controllo delle imprese (BMC) è quello di garantire che le operazioni in atto siano il più efficace ed efficiente possibile. Ciò può comportare la revisione dei processi in atto e la valutazione per determinare i modi possibili del loro miglioramento. In qualità di Business Monitoring & Control Officer (BMC), sarai responsabile dell'implementazione e del mantenimento di misure di controllo robuste in diverse funzioni aziendali. La vostra esperienza sarà fondamentale per mitigare i rischi, garantire la conformità alle normative e migliorare continuamente. Potrai collaborare a stretto contatto con diversi dipartimenti, offrendo preziose informazioni e raccomandazioni per migliorare le prestazioni aziendali globali e mantenere la nostra reputazione come fornitore di servizi finanziari di fiducia. BMC-ufficiali considerano nel loro lavoro come garantire che l'azienda opera in modo che soddisfi le esigenze dei propri clienti in modo efficace e in linea con la governance della Banca. Essi controlleranno se la prima linea di compiti di difesa è stata eseguita correttamente e riferirà regolarmente alla seconda linea di difesa. Essi formano il legame tra i responsabili delle relazioni (RM) e gli organi di governo (ad esempio, Comitato di gestione e Consiglio di amministrazione) e altre unità. Un BMC-ufficiale svolgerà compiti amministrativi e contabili organizzando e coordinando i servizi bancari. TUO PROFILE: Istruzione: Laurea magistrale in finanza, bancario o economia, o esperienza equivalente. Esperienza: 3-5 anni di esperienza in un istituto di gestione della ricchezza nel monitoraggio e nei controlli operativi. Competenze tecniche: Buona conoscenza della conformità normativa e MiFID. Fluente in inglese e francese, lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio. L'utente avanzato di MS Office Pack e principali prodotti software finanziari. Competenze personali: mentalità orientata al business e orientata alla soluzione, proattiva con estrema riservatezza. Mindset analitico, profonda rigorositÃ, consapevolezza del rischio e attenzione ai dettagli. descriptionByLocale.en: MISSION AND MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES : The general role of Business Monitoring & Control (BMC) is to ensure that the operations in place are as effective and efficient as possible. This can involve reviewing the processes in place and assessing to determine possible ways of their improvement. As a Business Monitoring & Control Officer (BMC), you will be responsible for implementing and maintaining robust control measures across various business functions. Your expertise will be instrumental in mitigating risks, ensuring compliance with regulations, and driving continuous improvement. You will collaborate closely with different departments, offering valuable insights and recommendations to enhance overall business performance and maintain our reputation as a trusted financial services provider. BMC-officers consider in their work how to ensure that the business operates in a way that meets the needs of their customers effectively and in line with the governance of the Bank. They will control if the 1st line of defense duties has been correctly performed and will report on regular basis to the 2nd line of defense. They form the link between the relationship managers (RMs) and the governing bodies (e.g., Management Committee and Board of Directors) and other units. A BMC-officer will carry out administrative and accounting duties by organizing and coordinating banking services. YOUR PROFILE : Education: • Master’s degree in finance, banking or economics, or equivalent experience. Experience : • 3-5 years’ experience in a wealth management institution in operational monitoring and controls. Technical Skills: • Good knowledge of regulatory compliance and MiFID. • Fluent in English and French, additional languages are an advantage. • Advanced user of MS Office Pack and main financial software products. Personal skills: • Business-oriented and solution-driven mindset, proactive with extreme confidentiality. • Analytical mindset, deep rigorousness, risk awareness, and attention to detail. • Ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple deadlines, and collaborate cross-functionally in a multicultural environment. • Strong communication skills, solid team spirit. • Being proactive and reactive, resilient to stress. • Sense of discretion and confidentiality, adherence to the company’s values. Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is a family-owned company, driven by an entrepreneurial vision, innovation and independence. UBP is one of the most strongly-capitalised private banks. By joining Union Bancaire Privée (Europe) S.A. in Luxembourg you will embrace a team of supportive high qualified professionals in Private Banking that will lead you to develop your career to the top level. We encourage continuous learning, development and knowledge sharing. We foster a culture of Agility, Conviction, Dedication and high degree of Responsibility. Union Bancaire Privée (Europe) S.A. encourages all suitable qualified and eligible candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity or expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation, disability or neurodiversity. In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, retained candidate will be required to provide an extract from their criminal record as a part of UBP screening process.
descriptionByLocale.de: MISSION UND MAIN RESPONSIBILITÄTEN : Die allgemeine Rolle von Business Monitoring & Control (BMC) besteht darin, sicherzustellen, dass die laufenden Operationen so effektiv und effizient wie möglich sind. Dabei kann es sich um eine Überprüfung der anstehenden Prozesse und eine Bewertung der möglichen Verbesserungsmethoden handeln. Als Business Monitoring & Control Officer (BMC) sind Sie für die Umsetzung und Aufrechterhaltung robuster Kontrollmaßnahmen in verschiedenen Geschäftsfunktionen verantwortlich. Ihr Know-how wird entscheidend sein, um Risiken zu mindern, die Einhaltung von Vorschriften zu gewährleisten und eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung zu erreichen. Sie arbeiten eng mit verschiedenen Abteilungen zusammen und bieten wertvolle Einblicke und Empfehlungen, um die allgemeine Geschäftsleistung zu verbessern und unseren Ruf als vertrauenswürdiger Finanzdienstleister zu erhalten. BMC-Angebote betrachten in ihrer Arbeit, wie sicherzustellen, dass das Unternehmen in einer Weise arbeitet, die den Bedürfnissen ihrer Kunden effektiv und im Einklang mit der Governance der Bank entspricht. Sie werden kontrollieren, ob die 1. Zeile der Verteidigungspflichten korrekt ausgeführt worden ist und regelmäßig der 2. Verteidigungslinie melden wird. Sie bilden die Verbindung zwischen den Beziehungsmanagern (RMs) und den Leitungsgremien (z.B. Vorstand und Verwaltungsrat) und anderen Einheiten. Ein BMC-Angebot wird Verwaltungs- und Rechnungswesen durch die Organisation und Koordination von Bankdienstleistungen durchführen. IHRE PROFILE : Ausbildung: Master-Abschluss in Finanzen, Bankwesen oder Wirtschaft oder gleichwertige Erfahrung. Erfahrung: 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer Vermögensverwaltungseinrichtung bei der operativen Überwachung und Kontrolle. Technische Fähigkeiten: Gute Kenntnisse der regulatorischen Compliance und MiFID. Fluent in Englisch und Französisch, zusätzliche Sprachen sind ein Vorteil. Erweiterter Benutzer von MS Office Pack und wichtigsten Finanzsoftware-Produkten. Persönliche Fähigkeiten: Business-orientiertes und lösungsorientiertes Mindset, proaktiv mit extremer Vertraulichkeit. Analytische Denkweise, tiefe Strenge, Risikobewusstsein und Liebe zum Detail. Fähigkeit, Aufgaben zu priorisieren, mehrere Fristen zu verwalten und interfunktionell in einer multikulturellen Umgebung zusammenzuarbeiten. Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, solider Teamgeist. Proaktiv und reaktionsfähig, belastbar. Sinn für Diskretion und Vertraulichkeit, Einhaltung der Werte des Unternehmens. Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) ist ein Familienunternehmen, das von einer unternehmerischen Vision, Innovation und Unabhängigkeit angetrieben wird. UBP ist eine der am stärkstenkapitalisierten Privatbanken. Durch den Beitritt zu Union Bancaire Privée (Europe) S.A. in Luxemburg werden Sie ein Team von unterstützenden hochqualifizierten Fachleuten in Private Banking, die Sie dazu führen, Ihre Karriere auf das höchste Niveau zu entwickeln. Wir fördern ständiges Lernen, Entwicklung und Wissensaustausch. Wir fördern eine Kultur von Agilität, Konviktion, Hingabe und hohe Verantwortung. Union Bancaire Privée (Europe) S.A. ermutigt alle geeigneten qualifizierten und förderfähigen Kandidaten, unabhängig von ihrer Geschlechtsidentität oder Ausdruck, Alter, Rasse, ethnischen und kulturellen Hintergrund, Religion und Überzeugungen, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Neurodiversität anzuwenden. Gemäß den Bestimmungen des luxemburgischen Gesetzes vom 23. Juli 2016 zur Änderung des Gesetzes vom 29. März 2013 ist ein fester Bewerber erforderlich, um einen Auszug aus seinem Strafregister als Teil des UBP-Screening-Prozesses bereitzustellen.
descriptionByLocale.fr: MISSION ET PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS : Le rôle général de la surveillance et du contrôle des entreprises (BMC) est de veiller à ce que les opérations en place soient aussi efficaces et efficientes que possible. Il peut s'agir d'examiner les processus en place et d'évaluer les moyens possibles d'améliorer ces processus. En tant qu'agent de surveillance et de contrôle des activités (BMC), vous serez responsable de la mise en oeuvre et du maintien de mesures de contrôle solides pour diverses fonctions opérationnelles. Votre expertise jouera un rôle déterminant dans l'atténuation des risques, l'observation des règlements et l'amélioration continue. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec différents ministères, en offrant des conseils et des recommandations utiles pour améliorer la performance globale de l'entreprise et maintenir notre réputation de fournisseur de services financiers fiable. Les agents de BMC examinent dans leur travail comment s'assurer que l'entreprise fonctionne de manière à répondre aux besoins de leurs clients de manière efficace et conforme à la gouvernance de la Banque. Ils contrôleront si la première ligne de fonctions de défense a été correctement effectuée et se présenteront régulièrement à la deuxième ligne de défense. Ils constituent le lien entre les gestionnaires de relations (GR) et les organes directeurs (par exemple, le comité de gestion et le conseil d'administration) et d'autres unités. Un agent du BMC exercera des fonctions administratives et comptables en organisant et en coordonnant les services bancaires. VOTRE PROFIL : Formation : Maîtrise en finance, banque ou économie, ou expérience équivalente. Expérience : 3-5 ans d'expérience dans une institution de gestion de patrimoine dans le contrôle opérationnel. Compétences techniques : Bonne connaissance de la conformité réglementaire et du MiFID. Fluent en anglais et en français, d'autres langues sont un avantage. Utilisateur avancé de MS Office Pack et des principaux logiciels financiers. Compétences personnelles : esprit orienté vers l'entreprise et orienté vers la solution, proactif avec une confidentialité extrême. L'état d'esprit analytique, la rigueur profonde, la sensibilisation aux risques et l'attention aux détails. Capacité de prioriser les tâches, de gérer plusieurs échéances et de collaborer de façon interfonctionnelle dans un environnement multiculturel. Forte capacité de communication, solide esprit d'équipe. Être proactif et réactif, résistant au stress. Sens de discrétion et de confidentialité, respect des valeurs de l'entreprise. Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) est une entreprise familiale, animée par une vision entrepreneuriale, l'innovation et l'indépendance. UBP est l'une des banques privées les plus fortement capitalisées. En rejoignant l'Union Bancaire Privée (Europe) S.A. au Luxembourg, vous allez embrasser une équipe de professionnels hautement qualifiés en Private Banking qui vous mènera à développer votre carrière au plus haut niveau. Nous encourageons l'apprentissage continu, le développement et le partage des connaissances. Nous favorisons une culture de l'agilité, de la condamnation, de la dédicace et du haut degré de responsabilité. Union Bancaire Privée (Europe) S.A. encourage tous les candidats qualifiés et éligibles à postuler indépendamment de leur identité ou expression de genre, de leur âge, de leur origine raciale, ethnique et culturelle, de leur religion et de leurs croyances, de leur orientation sexuelle, de leur handicap ou de leur neurodiversité. Conformément aux dispositions de la loi luxembourgeoise du 23 juillet 2016 modifiant la loi du 29 mars 2013, le candidat retenu sera tenu de fournir un extrait de son casier judiciaire dans le cadre du processus de contrôle UBP.

descriptionByLocale.it: Mission Costruire, migliorare e mantenere processi e applicazioni quantitativi a supporto: Modelli di rischio per strumenti Portfolio e gestione dei rischi di investimento Soluzioni di screening e proposte di investimento Ingegneria dei dati e gestione dei database Ti unirai a un team di analisi quantitativa e di rischio di 10 persone che serve sia Asset Management che Wealth Management. descriptionByLocale.en: Mission Build, enhance, and maintain quantitative processes and applications to support: • Instrument risk modelling • Portfolio and investment risk management • Financial screening and investment proposal solutions • Data engineering and database management • Quantitative reporting and analytics Main responsibilities You will join a 10-person Risk and Quantitative Analysis team serving both Asset Management and Wealth Management. You’ll leverage strong coding and financial skills to contribute to core functions across risk modeling, portfolio risk oversight, and quantitative infrastructure such as: • Investment Risk Management • Develop, calibrate, and automate risk models for client portfolio instruments, including derivatives and structured products. • Oversee portfolio risk across strategies and mandates; produce risk metrics, ensure daily data quality checks, manage exceptions. • Recommend portfolio adjustments based on risk optimization, style analysis, and stress scenarios. • Partner with portfolio managers to translate risk insights into actionable proposals. • Quant Infrastructure and Data • Maintain and extend the team’s data pipelines and tooling; collect, compute, and process market, reference, and portfolio data. Enforce data lineage, versioning, and audit trails. • Participate to the maintenance and development of instrument screening tools, across various asset classes. • Contribute to quantitative reporting for external and internal stakeholders. • Investment Proposal Tool • Participate to the maintenance and development of an investment proposal tool, for both discretionary mandates and institutional clients. Your Profile • Minimum 3-year experience in a similar role or equivalent • Degree in Quantitative Economics, Mathematics, IT, Finance, or equivalent. • Strong IT skills: Python, C#, SQL, VBA. Experience in developing APIs a plus. • Experience with external tools such as BQuant or APT a plus • Analytical mind with ability to explain technical subjects in a fluent way • Client orientated with an excellent service delivery • Team oriented with the capacity to work autonomously while reporting to the direct supervisor Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it: Missione La funzione è dedicata a un progetto trasversale relativo alle attività di rischio e di controllo, co-sponsorizzato dal Responsabile Gruppo di Gestione dei Rischi e dal Responsabile Gruppo di Compliance. Sarete membri del progetto per sostenere la sua distribuzione, in collaborazione con Group Compliance, QA e Group Risk Management. Group Risk Management (“GRM”) – come seconda linea di difesa, distribuisce metodologie dedicate ad esempio a valutazioni di rischio e di controllo, gestione degli incidenti e supporto giornaliero a Business attraverso quattro squadre situate a Ginevra, dedicate al Tesoro & Trading, Wealth Management, Asset Management e rischio operativo in generale. I team svolgono anche la supervisione delle attività della Banca attraverso le divisioni, considerando l’appetito di rischio del Gruppo, l’esposizione al rischio attuale ed emergente. Garanzia di qualità (“QA”) - Assicurare la qualità del sistema di controllo interno della Banca (ICS) e il rispetto / corretta esecuzione del quadro di controllo del gruppo. Condurre indagini in relazione alle questioni procedurali e di controllo e alle principali attività di bonifica associate. Compliance di Gruppo - come seconda linea di difesa - assicurarsi che la Banca conduca la propria attività in conformità con le leggi, i regolamenti e le politiche interne applicabili, e di gestire il rischio di sanzioni legali o regolamentari, la perdita finanziaria o la perdita di reputazione che la Banca può soffrire a causa del mancato rispetto di tali leggi, regolamenti e politiche. Responsabilità principali Sostegno 2a linea di difesa e divisioni incl. Funzioni aziendali come prima linea di difesa: Leader o partecipando a valutazioni di rischio e controllo regolari o dedicate con la prima linea di difesa della Banca, in linea con le metodologie di rischio e controllo definite da GRM e Group Compliance. Eseguire attività di test di controllo con GRM, Compliance di Gruppo e con i team di Quality Assurance, dalla distribuzione di controllo al controllo della presentazione dei risultati e del follow-up del piano d'azione. Monitoraggio dell'attuazione dei piani di bonifica per affrontare lacune identificate. Aggiornare le direttive e le procedure applicabili alla valutazione del rischio e del controllo, suggerire/partecipare al piano di comunicazione e al piano di formazione, quando applicabile. Partecipare a una regolare segnalazione da inviare e/o presentata internamente e al Regolatore. Il tuo profilo Gestione del rischio, Controllo interno, Audit e/o Compliance sfondo previsto. Un'esperienza minima di 3-4 anni necessaria nelle suddette attività. Forte capacità analitiche per valutare i rischi e i controlli e proporre strategie di mitigazione efficaci. Forte comprensione dei processi aziendali e delle regole e dei regolamenti del settore finanziario, preferibilmente all'interno di Private Banking; Forte capacità organizzativa e capacità di soddisfare le scadenze; Forte capacità di comunicazione; Interessi per la gestione del progetto; atteggiamento orientato alla soluzione e pronto alle attività di bordo per la prova di concetti; Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente mantenendo una forte coesione e comunicazione del team; capacità di gestire e accompagnare il cambiamento; eccellente francese e inglese. Competenze fondamentali: Aderenza ai valori dell’azienda: Dedicazione, Convizione, Agility e Responsabilità - Rispetto dei regolamenti e delle direttive interne
descriptionByLocale.en: Mission The function is dedicated to a transversal project related to risk and control activities, co-sponsored by the Group Head of Risk Management and by the Group Head of Compliance. You will be a member of the project to support its deployment, in cooperation with Group Compliance, QA and Group Risk Management. Group Risk Management (“GRM”) - as 2nd line of defence, deploys methodologies dedicated for example to risk and control assessments, incident managements as well as daily support to Business via four teams located in Geneva, dedicated to Treasury & Trading, Wealth Management, Asset Management and Operational risk in general. Teams also perform the oversight of the Bank’s activities across divisions, considering the Group risk appetite, current and emerging risk exposure. Quality Assurance (“QA”) - Ensure the quality of the Bank’s Internal Control System (ICS) and the respect / proper execution of of the group Control Framework. Conducting investigations in relation to procedural and control issues and leading associated remediation activity. Group Compliance - as 2nd line of defence - ensure that the Bank conducts its business in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies, and to manage the risk of legal or regulatory sanctions, financial loss, or loss to reputation the Bank may suffer as a result of failing to comply with such laws, regulations, and policies. Main responsibilities Support 2nd line of defence and Divisions incl. Corporate Functions as 1st line of defence by: Leading or participating to regular or dedicated risk and control assessments with Bank’s 1st line of defence, in line with risk and control methodologies defined by GRM and Group Compliance. Performing control testing activities with GRM, Group Compliance and with Quality Assurance teams, from control deployment to control results presentation and action plan follow-up. Monitoring the implementation of remediation plans to address identified gaps. Updating directives and procedures applicable to risk and control assessment, suggest/participate to communication plan and training plan, when applicable. Participating to regular reporting to be dispatched and/or presented internally as well as to the Regulator. Your Profile Risk management, Internal Control, Audit and/or Compliance background expected. A minimum of 3-4 years' experience required in the above activities. Strong analytical skills to assess risks and controls, and propose effective mitigation strategies. Strong understanding of business processes and rules and regulations of the financial sector, preferably within Private Banking; Strong organisational skills and ability to meet deadlines; Strong communication skills; Interest for project management; Solution-oriented attitude and ready to onboard tasks for proof-of-concepts; Ability to work independently while maintaining a strong team cohesion and communication; Capacity to manage and accompany change; Excellent French and English. Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives
descriptionByLocale.de: Mission Die Funktion ist einem transversalen Projekt im Zusammenhang mit Risiko- und Kontrolltätigkeiten gewidmet, das vom Konzernleiter Risikomanagement und vom Konzernleiter Compliance koordiniert wird. Darüber hinaus führen Teams die Aufsicht über die Aktivitäten der Bank im gesamten Geschäftsbereich durch, wobei die Risikobereitschaft der Gruppe, die aktuelle und die aufstrebende Risikoposition berücksichtigt werden. Hauptverantwortliche Unterstützung 2. Verteidigungslinie und Abteilungen inkl. Corporate Functions als 1. Ihr Profil Risikomanagement, interne Kontrolle, Audit und/oder Compliance Hintergrund erwartet. Mindestens 3-4 Jahre Erfahrung in den oben genannten Aktivitäten erforderlich. Starkes Verständnis von Geschäftsprozessen und Regeln und Vorschriften des Finanzsektors, vorzugsweise innerhalb von Private Banking; Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten und Fähigkeit, Termine zu erfüllen; Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten; Interesse an Projektmanagement; Lösungsorientierte Haltung und bereit an Bord von Aufgaben für Nachweise von Konzepten; Fähigkeit, selbständig zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig eine starke Teamkohäsion und Kommunikation zu erhalten; Kapazität, den Wandel zu verwalten und zu begleiten; Ausgezeichnet Französisch und Englisch. descriptionByLocale.fr: Mission La fonction est dédiée à un projet transversal lié aux activités de risque et de contrôle, coparrainé par le chef de groupe de la gestion des risques et par le chef de groupe de la conformité. Vous serez membre du projet pour soutenir son déploiement, en coopération avec Conformité de Groupe, QA et Gestion des Risques de Groupe. Gestion des risques de groupe (GRM) - en tant que 2e ligne de défense, déploie des méthodologies dédiées par exemple aux évaluations des risques et des contrôles, à la gestion des incidents ainsi qu'au soutien quotidien aux entreprises par l'intermédiaire de quatre équipes situées à Genève, dédiées au Trésorerie et Trading, à la gestion de patrimoine, à la gestion d'actifs et au risque opérationnel en général. Les équipes surveillent également les activités de la Banque dans toutes les divisions, compte tenu de l'appétit du Groupe pour les risques, de l'exposition actuelle et émergente aux risques. Assurance de la qualité - Assurer la qualité du système de contrôle interne (SCI) de la Banque et le respect/l'exécution correcte du cadre de contrôle du groupe. Mener des enquêtes sur les questions de procédure et de contrôle et diriger les activités d'assainissement connexes. En tant que deuxième ligne de défense, la conformité de groupe garantit que la Banque mène ses activités conformément aux lois, aux règlements et aux politiques internes applicables, et gère les risques de sanctions légales ou réglementaires, de pertes financières ou de perte de réputation que la Banque peut subir en ne se conformant pas à ces lois, règlements et politiques. Principales responsabilités Appuyer la 2e ligne de défense et les divisions, y compris : Fonctions de l'entreprise en tant que 1ère ligne de défense par: Diriger ou participer à des évaluations régulières ou spécifiques des risques et des contrôles avec la Banque 1ère ligne de défense, conformément aux méthodes de risque et de contrôle définies par GRM et Conformité de groupe. Effectuer des essais de contrôle avec des équipes de GRM, de conformité de groupe et d'assurance de la qualité, depuis le déploiement du contrôle jusqu'à la présentation des résultats et au suivi du plan d'action. Surveillance de la mise en oeuvre des plans d'assainissement pour combler les lacunes identifiées. Mettre à jour les directives et les procédures applicables à l'évaluation des risques et des contrôles, suggérer ou participer au plan de communication et au plan de formation, le cas échéant. Participer à des rapports réguliers qui seront envoyés et/ou présentés à l'interne et à l'organisme de réglementation. Votre profil Gestion des risques, contrôle interne, vérification et/ou conformité. Un minimum de 3-4 ans d'expérience requis dans les activités ci-dessus. Des compétences analytiques solides pour évaluer les risques et les contrôles et proposer des stratégies d'atténuation efficaces. Une bonne compréhension des processus et des règles et réglementations du secteur financier, de préférence dans le cadre de la banque privée; De solides compétences en communication; Intérêt pour la gestion de projet; attitude orientée vers la solution et prêt à être à bord des tâches pour la preuve des concepts; Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante tout en maintenant une solide cohésion d'équipe et de communication; Capacité de gérer et d'accompagner le changement; Excellent français et anglais. Compétences de base : Adhérence aux valeurs de l'entreprise : Dédicace, Conviction, Agilité et Responsabilité - Respect des règlements et des directives internes
